人类建造的最后一个人工智能：迈向真正的递归自我完善The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement

摘要Abstract

递归自我改进（RSI）使人工智能系统能够将经验和反馈转化为持续的变化，从而提高其能力和未来改进的过程。我们首先利用Headroom-Closed Index（HCI）来揭示现有LLM的问题，然后介绍RSI概念及其发展路线图：从改进执行自主、改进策略自主、经验获取自主、环境适应自主，到递归元改进。 接下来，我们跨场景（例如科学发现、具体智能、软件工程）检查 RSI，强调它们的独特需求和开发速度。我们借鉴不同的行业实践和初步经验证据，将 RSI 研究与实际系统联系起来，并确定实现真正 RSI 的关键挑战。Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement. We first use the Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) to reveal the problems of existing LLMs, then introduce the RSI concept and its development roadmap: from improvement-execution autonomy, improvement-strategy autonomy, experience-acquisition autonomy, and environment-adaptation autonomy, to recursive meta-improvement. Next we examine RSI across scenarios (e.g., scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering), highlighting their distinct requirements and development speeds. Drawing on diverse industry practices and preliminary empirical evidence, we connect RSI research with practical systems and identify key challenges to achieving genuine RSI.

1 简介Introduction

最近的前沿模型开发说明了改进管道中的几种扩展形式。 Kimi K3和Qwen3.8-Max分别包含2.8万亿和2.4万亿个参数，每个都支持大约一百万个令牌的上下文窗口Recent frontier-model development illustrates several forms of scaling in the improvement pipeline. Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8-Max contain 2.8 trillion and 2.4 trillion parameters, respectively, and each supports a context window of approximately one million tokensMoonshot AI [2026], Alibaba Cloud [2026]。开发进程也在不断扩大。 OpenAI 报告称，在 GPT-5.6 之前的六个月中，用于内部编码推理的研究计算份额增长了 100 倍，内部代理代币使用量增长了 22 倍，每个活跃研究人员的平均每日产出代币超过了之前 GPT-5.5 观察到的峰值的两倍. The development process is also expanding. During the six months preceding GPT-5.6, OpenAI reports that the share of research compute devoted to internal coding inference grew 100-fold and internal agentic token use grew 22-fold, and average daily output tokens per active researcher exceeded twice the previous peak observed with GPT-5.5OpenAI [2026a]。规模在训练运行、模型辅助实验、推理、评估和人工验证中积累。. Scale accumulates across training runs, model-assisted experiments, inference, evaluation, and human validation.

1.1 减轻模型开发的负担Scaling Burdens in Model Development

尽管越来越多地使用代理工具和基于 API 的自动化，但开发人员仍然必须确定要改进的内容、构建所需的资源，并确定每个更改是否有效Despite the growing use of agentic tools and API-based automation, developers must still determine what to improve, construct the required resources, and establish whether each change worksMoshkov et al. [2025], Meta Engineering [2026]。随着人工智能系统承担更艰巨的任务，扩展端到端开发流程的成本成为瓶颈. As AI systems take on more demanding tasks, the cost of scaling this end-to-end development process becomes a bottleneckPatwardhan et al. [2026], Phan et al. [2025], Jimenez et al. [2024], Yao et al. [2024]。以下三个挑战出现在模型生命周期的不同阶段并激励 RSI：. The following three challenges occur at different stages of the model lifecycle and motivate RSI:

∙\bullet 开发挑战1：资源密集型基础模型训练。Development challenge 1: Resource-intensive foundation-model training.基础模型开发在数据准备、架构设计、分布式优化和评估方面仍然需要大量资源。 Kimi K3 激活了 896 个专家中的 16 个，并报告称扩展效率比 Kimi K2 提高了大约 2.5 倍，而 Qwen3.8-Max 激活了 2.4 万亿个参数中的 950 亿个参数Foundation-model development remains resource-intensive across data preparation, architecture design, distributed optimization, and evaluation. Kimi K3 activates 16 of 896 experts and reports an approximate 2.5-fold improvement in scaling efficiency over Kimi K2, while Qwen3.8-Max activates 95 billion of its 2.4 trillion parametersMoonshot AI [2026], Alibaba Cloud [2026]。稀疏激活减少了每个令牌的计算，但这种规模的训练仍然需要专家路由、并行性、多模态集成、长上下文优化和系统设计。 OpenAI 进一步报告称，GPT-5.6 Sol 在其推测解码草稿模型上设计并运行了数百次实验，并通过硬件故障和不稳定来监控训练。由此产生的变化将代币生成效率提高了 15% 以上. Sparse activation reduces per-token computation, but training at this scale still couples expert routing, parallelism, multimodal integration, long-context optimization, and systems design. OpenAI further reports that GPT-5.6 Sol designed and ran hundreds of experiments on its speculative-decoding draft model and monitored training through hardware failures and instability. The resulting changes improved token-generation efficiency by more than 15%Ferrari et al. [2026]。除了数量之外，数据质量也很重要。 OpenAI 的 GDPval 表明，其 1,320 项专业任务总共需要大约 9,240 个专家小时，贡献者的平均经验超过 14 年. Data quality also matters in addition to quantity. OpenAI’s GDPval illustrates that its 1,320 professional tasks required roughly 9,240 expert-hours in total, with contributors averaging more than 14 years of experiencePatwardhan et al. [2026]。 Humanity 的 Last Exam 管道记录了超过 70,000 次提交尝试，并向专家评审发送了大约 13,000 个模型难题，然后生成了 3,000 个问题的基准. The Humanity’s Last Exam pipeline logged more than 70,000 submission attempts and sent approximately 13,000 model-stumping questions to expert review before producing a 3,000-question benchmarkPhan et al. [2025]。架构搜索仍然很昂贵，因为候选结构与其数据、优化和硬件机制相互作用。 AgentNAS 通过使用 LLM 提出特定于任务的种子架构并构建其搜索空间来部分解决此瓶颈，但候选选择仍然取决于外部指定目标下的组合搜索. Architecture search remains expensive because candidate structures interact with their data, optimization, and hardware regimes. AgentNAS addresses part of this bottleneck by using an LLM to propose a task-specific seed architecture and construct its search space, but candidate selection still depends on combinatorial search under an externally specified objectiveJeong et al. [2026].

∙\bullet 发展挑战 2：扩大反馈和学习环境。Development challenge 2: Scaling feedback and learning environments.合成数据和强化学习使部分能力开发自动化，但对生成和评估经验提出了实质性要求，需要经验生成基础设施和可靠的评估和保留更新机制。例如，DeepSeek-V3.2 报告训练后计算预算超过其预训练成本的 10%Synthetic data and reinforcement learning automate parts of capability development, but introduce substantial requirements for generating and evaluating experience, requiring both experience-generation infrastructure and reliable mechanisms for evaluating and retaining updates. For instance, DeepSeek-V3.2 reports a post-training computational budget exceeding 10% of its pretraining costDeepSeek-AI et al. [2025]，而 NVIDIA 的 AIMO-2 管道除了解决 54 万个问题外，还生成了 320 万个长推理解决方案和 170 万个工具集成解决方案, while NVIDIA’s AIMO-2 pipeline generated 3.2 million long-reasoning solutions and 1.7 million tool-integrated solutions, in addition to curating 540,000 problemsMoshkov et al. [2025].

∙\bullet 开发挑战3：部署后反复适应。Development challenge 3: Recurring adaptation after deployment.已部署的系统不断引入不断变化的文档、不熟悉的工具、不完整的上下文以及涉及相互依赖的操作的工作流程。改进此类系统需要工程师手动诊断故障、修改检索和工具界面、管理持久状态，并通过离散的、人工主导的版本重复回归测试。 Anthropic 报告称，代理工作负载使用的令牌数量大约是普通聊天的四倍，对于多代理系统，由于更长的上下文、协调、环境设置和端到端验证，这一比例上升到大约十五倍Deployed systems consistently introduce changing documents, unfamiliar tools, incomplete context, and workflows involving interdependent actions. Improving such systems requires engineers to manually diagnose failures, revise retrieval and tool interfaces, manage persistent state, and repeat regression testing through discrete, human-led releases. Anthropic reports that agentic workloads use approximately four times as many tokens as ordinary chat, rising to about fifteen times for multi-agent systems because of longer contexts, coordination, environment setup, and end-to-end verificationAnthropic [2025]，而 Meta 报告称 FBDetect 每周都会识别数千个基础设施回归，诊断一个这样的回归需要大约 10 个工程师小时, while Meta reports that FBDetect identifies thousands of infrastructure regressions each week, and diagnosing one such regression required roughly ten engineer-hoursMeta Engineering [2026].

1.2 从发展负担到 RSIFrom Development Burden to RSI

负担的产生是因为模型改进仍然是一系列昂贵的、外部协调的干预措施。为了解决这些障碍，RSI 检查部分协调是否可以成为正在改进的系统的持久能力。我们将递归自我改进（RSI）定义为一个自主的闭环过程，其中人工智能系统识别自身的局限性，开发和验证改进，并使用由此产生的功能来改进改进过程本身。 RSI的模型演化范式跨越三个维度：自主性、效率性和创新性。自主性将系统的责任从执行规定的更新扩展到识别限制、提取经验、提出变更以及验证和保留继任者。效率寻求从数据、计算、推理、人工审查和返工中进行更有效的改进。创新使系统能够超越人类指定的更新策略进行搜索，并将有用的发现反馈到后续的改进轮次中。这些维度描述了完整的改进循环是如何组织的以及它可以继承什么。The burdens arise because model improvement remains a sequence of costly, externally coordinated interventions. To address these barriers, RSI inspects whether part of that coordination can become a persistent capability of the system being improved. We define recursive self-improvement (RSI) as an autonomous, closed-loop process in which an AI system identifies its own limitations, develops and validates improvements, and uses the resulting capabilities to improve the improvement process itself. The model evolution paradigm of RSI spans three dimensions: autonomy, efficiency, and innovation. Autonomy expands the system’s responsibility from executing a prescribed update to identifying limitations, extracting experience, proposing changes, and validating and retaining successors. Efficiency seeks more validated improvement from data, compute, inference, human review, and rework. Innovation allows the system to search beyond human-prescribed update strategies and feed useful discoveries back into later improvement rounds. These dimensions describe how the full improvement loop is organized and what it can inherit.

而不是某种特定的学习算法或一次性的优化结果Rather than a particular learning algorithm or a one-off optimization resultSchmidhuber [2003], Zelikman et al. [2024], Zhang et al. [2026b]，RSI 旨在提高任务绩效以及发现和实施后续改进的机制。以下案例在模型生命周期的两个点上说明了这种区别，包括基础模型训练和软件工程中的持久适应，这将在后面的章节中介绍和研究。, RSI aims to improve both task performance and the mechanisms through which later improvements are discovered and implemented. The following cases illustrate this distinction at two points in the model lifecycle, including foundation-model training and persistent adaptation in software engineering, covered and studied in later sections.

∙\bullet 案例一：基础模型训练。Case 1: Foundation-model training.传统的实验循环选择更好的检查点，同时保持选择后续实验的过程不变。相反，A-Evolve-Training 将培训后的结果整合到持久的研究政策和发现日志中，元代理会对其进行修改以指导后来的工人的食谱选择A conventional experiment loop selects a better checkpoint while leaving the procedure for choosing later experiments unchanged. A-Evolve-Training instead consolidates post-training outcomes into a persistent research policy and discovery log, which a meta-agent revises to guide later workers’ recipe choicesShi et al. [2026b]。当发展分数提高但没有相应的外部收益时，系统会将实验重定向到数据重新平衡和检查点选择。保留的政策改变了后继模型的训练方式以及后续改进的方式。在 30B Nemotron 模型上的四轮自主回合中，外部得分从 0.80 上升到 0.86，而人类最高提交得分为 0.87. When development scores improved without corresponding external gains, the system redirected experiments toward data rebalancing and checkpoint selection. The retained policy changes both how successor models are trained and how later improvements are sought. Across four autonomous rounds on a 30B Nemotron model, the external score rose from 0.80 to 0.86, compared with 0.87 for the top human submissionShi et al. [2026b].

∙\bullet 案例 2：部署后的软件工程调整。Case 2: Software-engineering adaptation after deployment.修复存储库会改变软件产品，但可能不会影响编码代理反复出现的故障。 Ouroboros 相反，使用经过审查的部署证据来建议对代理工具、上下文组装、提示和核心实现进行版本化更改Repairing a repository changes the software product but may leave the coding agent’s recurring failures untouched. Ouroboros instead uses reviewed deployment evidence to propose versioned changes to the agent’s tools, context assembly, prompts, and core implementationRazzhigaev et al. [2026]。在接受的版本取代用于后续工作的运行时之前，候选修订版要经过测试和人工审核。持久更新改进了后续编码行为，并改变了诊断和修复后续故障的机制，同时专家保留了对后续纠正和部署的控制。. Candidate revisions undergo tests and human review before an accepted version replaces the runtime used for later work. The persistent update improves subsequent coding behavior and changes the mechanism through which later failures are diagnosed and repaired, while experts retain control over consequential corrections and deployment.

1.3 RSI 面临的挑战Challenges for RSI

虽然这两个案例显示了持久的变化如何影响以后的改进，但同样的持久性可能会带来错误或模糊控制所在。我们研究了三个反复出现的问题，以确定自我更新系统是否提供可靠的 RSI 证据。While the two cases show how persistent changes can shape later improvement, the same persistence can carry errors or obscure where control resides. We examine three recurring problems that determine whether a self-updating system provides credible evidence of RSI.

∙\bullet 安全继承。Safe inheritance.RSI 要求改变能够在任务或改进轮次中持续存在，但仅仅持续并不能保证持续的收益。哥德尔代理RSI requires changes to persist across tasks or improvement rounds, but persistence alone does not guarantee sustained gains. Gödel AgentYin et al. [2025]例如，重写了其任务策略和改进逻辑，但其 100 次 MGSM 优化试验中有 14% 的结果低于初始策略的性能。需要传输测试、版本历史记录和回滚机制来保留有用的更新而不降低早期功能。, for example, rewrites both its task policy and improvement logic, yet 14% of its 100 MGSM optimization trials ended below the initial policy’s performance. Transfer tests, version histories, and rollback mechanisms are needed to retain useful updates without degrading earlier capabilities.

∙\bullet 自主权归属。Autonomy attribution.产生更好的候选人并不一定意味着系统改进了候选人的发现或选择方式。达尔文哥德尔机器Generating better candidates does not necessarily mean the system has improved how candidates are discovered or selected. The Darwin Gödel MachineZhang et al. [2026b]改进了编码代理，将其 SWE-bench 子集的性能从 20% 提高到 50%，但其存档维护和父选择规则仍然无法自我修改。 RSI 分析必须将人工智能控制的决策与固定的搜索程序和人类接受标准区分开来。evolves coding agents, raising performance on its SWE-bench subset from 20% to 50%, but its archive maintenance and parent-selection rules remain outside self-modification. RSI analysis must distinguish AI-controlled decisions from fixed search procedures and human acceptance criteria.

∙\bullet 可靠的验证。Reliable verification.评估者的重复访问可以奖励剥削而不是能力增益。 Anthropic 的自动化研究实验Repeated evaluator access can reward exploitation rather than capability gains. Anthropic’s automated research experimentsWen et al. [2026]报告随机种子挑选并尝试通过评估器查询提取测试标签。不断变化的评估者使各轮比较变得更加复杂。红皇后哥德尔机report random-seed cherry-picking and attempted test-label extraction through evaluator queries. Evolving evaluators further complicate comparisons across rounds. The Red Queen Gödel MachineIacob et al. [2026]通过冻结每个时期内的评估者并根据独立的地面实况锚验证替换来解决这个问题。需要受保护的评估和匹配的计算预算来将真正的改进与评估者的利用或增加的搜索工作分开。addresses this by freezing evaluators within each epoch and validating replacements against an independent ground-truth anchor. Protected evaluation and matched computational budgets are needed to separate genuine improvement from evaluator exploitation or increased search effort.

1.4 以自治为中心的框架An Autonomy-Centered Framework

为了应对这些挑战，我们在一个以自主为中心的框架中调查了相关的 RSI 技术，该框架将人工智能的变化与其控制的改进决策分开。根据人工智能内化的改进责任范围，我们回顾了五个级别的 RSI 技术。图To address these challenges, we survey relevant RSI techniques in an autonomy-centered framework that separates what the AI changes from the improvement decisions it controls. Based on the scope of improvement responsibility internalized by AI, we review RSI techniques across five levels. Figure1绘制了这一进程中的代表性系统，而图maps representative systems across this progression, while Figure2隔离相应的循环结构。在每个级别，我们都会确定改进循环在何处结束、为后续几轮保留哪些内容以及哪些关键决策仍处于人类控制之下，然后引入实现这种责任划分的技术。isolates the corresponding loop structures. At each level, we identify where the improvement loop closes, what is retained for later rounds, and which critical decisions remain under human control, then introduce the techniques that implement this division of responsibility.

∙\bullet (L1) 改进执行自主权。(L1) Improvement Execution Autonomy.人类指定应该改进什么、应该如何改进以及什么构成成功，而人工智能则执行候选更新。例如，FineWeb-Edu 使用模型在网络语料库中应用人类定义的教育质量标签，而无需选择标签标准Humans specify what should be improved, how it should be improved, and what constitutes success, while AI executes candidate updates. For example, FineWeb-Edu uses a model to apply human-defined educational-quality labels across a web corpus without choosing the labeling criterionPenedo et al. [2024].

∙\bullet (L2) 改进策略自主性。(L2) Improvement Strategy Autonomy.目标、任务边界和评估标准仍然是外部固定的，但人工智能会诊断弱点并决定如何改进系统。例如，Self-Harness 使用执行跟踪在固定基准和升级规则下建议和测试对其代理工具的编辑The objective, task boundary, and evaluation criteria remain externally fixed, but AI diagnoses weaknesses and decides how to improve the system. For example, Self-Harness uses execution traces to propose and test edits to its agent harness under a fixed benchmark and promotion ruleZhang et al. [2026a].

∙\bullet (L3) 学习信号或经验获取自主性。(L3) Learning-Signal or Experience-Acquisition Autonomy.该系统还确定下一轮改进所需的经验。例如，SIMA 2 使用当前行为的评估来生成针对观察到的技能弱点的后续练习任务The system also determines the experience needed for its next improvement round. For example, SIMA 2 uses assessments of current behavior to generate later practice tasks that target observed skill weaknessesteam et al. [2025].

∙\bullet (L4) 环境适应自主性。(L4) Environment Adaptation Autonomy.改进循环使用部署交互来修改外部接受和治理规则下的持久系统状态。例如，PANDO 在长时间运行的交互过程中根据观察到的结果承认或降级可重用规则，因此后续操作会继承早期经验The improvement loop uses deployment interaction to revise persistent system state under external acceptance and governance rules. For example, PANDO admits or demotes reusable rules during a long-running interaction according to observed outcomes, so later actions inherit earlier experienceLi et al. [2026f].

∙\bullet (L5) 递归继承自治。(L5) Recursive Inheritance Autonomy.该系统不断地修改管理后续改进的机制，例如The system persistently revises a mechanism that governs subsequent improvement, such as an改良剂improver, 验证者verifier，或后继生成过程。例如，在发展分数无法预测外部收益后，A-Evolve-Training 修改了其研究政策，并使用修改后的政策来指导下一轮培训, or successor-generation procedure. For example, A-Evolve-Training revises its research policy after development scores fail to predict external gains and uses the revised policy to direct the next training roundShi et al. [2026b].

1.5 应用领域Application Domains

虽然自主级别描述了改进循环的结构，但它们的实际意义取决于领域中可用的反馈，因为相同的保留更新可能很容易在软件工程中进行测试，但很难在物理或临床环境中进行验证。我们考虑科学、具体智能、软件工程和医疗保健，因为它们暴露了四种不同的反馈机制，包括归因不确定的实验证据、与昂贵试验的物理交互、规格不完整的可执行测试以及专家监督下的高风险结果。这些制度使我们能够比较反馈成本和可靠性如何影响改进的保留和重用。While the autonomy levels describe the structure of an improvement loop, their practical meaning depends on the feedback available in a domain, as the same retained update may be straightforward to test in software engineering and difficult to validate in a physical or clinical setting. We consider science, embodied intelligence, software engineering, and healthcare because they expose four distinct feedback regimes, including experimental evidence with uncertain attribution, physical interaction with costly trials, executable tests with incomplete specifications, and high-stakes outcomes under expert oversight. These regimes allow us to compare how feedback cost and reliability affect the retention and reuse of improvements.

∙\bullet (S1) 科学 RSI。(S1) RSI for Science.科学发现涉及开放式探索、昂贵的实验以及可能无法清楚识别失败根源的反馈。我们研究积累的证据如何改进科学假设模块、实验代理以及反思或改进机制，并关注这些变化是否支持当前科学结果之外的后续研究。Scientific discovery involves open-ended exploration, costly experiments, and feedback that may not clearly identify the source of failure. We examine how accumulated evidence can improve scientific hypothesis modules, experimental agents, and reflection or improvement mechanisms, with attention to whether these changes support subsequent research beyond the current scientific result.

∙\bullet (S2) 体现智能的 RSI。(S2) RSI for Embodied Intelligence.具身代理通过自己的行动产生经验，而失败可能是由于交互的感知、规划和控制组件而引起的。物理试验也对探索和可重复性施加了限制。我们研究环境和课程、技能和代理工具、政策和行动模型以及世界模型和评估者的演变，重点关注交互反馈如何支持经过验证的改进，以便在以后的任务中重复使用。Embodied agents generate experience through their own actions, while failures may arise from interacting perception, planning, and control components. Physical trials also impose limits on exploration and repeatability. We examine the evolution of environments and curricula, skills and agent harnesses, policies and action models, and world models and evaluators, focusing on how interaction feedback supports validated improvements that can be reused in later tasks.

∙\bullet (S3) 软件工程 RSI。(S3) RSI for Software Engineering.软件工程使开发的工件和开发代理都可以进行可执行的修改和测试。我们研究存储库反馈如何支持编码代理实现和利用、开发经验和协作以及改进过程本身的持续变化。一个主要区别是更新是否提高了当前任务绩效、产生更强大继任者的能力，或两者兼而有之。Software engineering makes both the developed artifact and the developing agent accessible to executable modification and testing. We examine how repository feedback supports persistent changes to coding-agent implementations and harnesses, development experience and collaboration, and the improvement process itself. A central distinction is whether an update improves current task performance, the ability to produce stronger successors, or both.

∙\bullet (S4) 医疗保健领域的 RSI。(S4) RSI for Healthcare.医疗保健将有限的试错机会与延迟的、异质的反馈和改进结合起来，其有效性可能取决于患者群体或机构。我们研究临床记忆和知识、推理策略以及工具和工作流程的演变，强调回顾的经验如何在明确的验证和监督下为后续病例提供信息。Healthcare combines restricted opportunities for trial and error with delayed, heterogeneous feedback and improvements whose validity may depend on the patient population or institution. We examine the evolution of clinical memory and knowledge, reasoning strategies, and tools and workflows, emphasizing how reviewed experience can inform subsequent cases under explicit validation and oversight.

在这些领域中，我们比较更新的内容、反馈如何支持其保留，以及哪些决策仍由外部控制。该分析将自主框架与特定于应用程序的证据联系起来，并确定了已证明的改进机制和更全面的递归改进之间的差距。Across these domains, we compare what is updated, how feedback supports its retention, and which decisions remain externally controlled. This analysis connects the autonomy framework to application-specific evidence and identifies the gaps between demonstrated improvement mechanisms and fuller recursive improvement.

1.6 工业证据Industrial Evidence

领域分析确定了形成改进循环的反馈和验证条件，而工业系统则显示了如何在操作管道中处理这些条件，其中集成和部署约束是直接的。我们研究工业实践，因为前沿改进循环并不总是首先通过传统学术出版物记录。工业材料，包括技术报告、开源系统、工程博客、模型文档和已部署的产品基础设施，通常揭示系统级实践，例如评估管道、数据飞轮、代理线束、自动化实验和部署反馈循环，而这些在学术文献中仅部分体现。我们使用这些材料来补充研究文献，并了解如何在实际工程限制下实现自我改进。The domain analysis identifies the feedback and validation conditions that shape an improvement loop, while industrial systems show how these conditions are handled within operating pipelines, where integration and deployment constraints are immediate. We examine industrial practice because frontier improvement loops are not always first documented through conventional academic publications. Industrial materials, including technical reports, open-source systems, engineering blogs, model documentation, and deployed product infrastructures, often reveal system-level practices, such as evaluation pipelines, data flywheels, agent harnesses, automated experimentation, and deployment feedback loops, which are only partially represented in the academic literature. We use these materials to complement the research literature and to understand how self-improvement is implemented under real engineering constraints.

基于以自治为中心的框架和应用分析，我们研究了工业系统为自身改进承担哪些责任，以及这些责任在应用程序和工程环境中如何变化。我们进一步分析计算成本、反馈质量和人类参与等约束如何塑造改进循环的组织并限制可实现的自主范围。这种视角使我们能够描述已在部署或面向生产的系统中展示的机制，以及仍有待验证的递归改进的更雄心勃勃的愿景，从而阐明工业 RSI 实践的当前进展和局限性。图Building on the autonomy-centered framework and application analysis, we examine what responsibilities industrial systems assume for their own improvement and how these responsibilities vary across applications and engineering settings. We further analyze how constraints such as computational cost, feedback quality, and human involvement shape the organization of improvement loops and limit the attainable scope of autonomy. This perspective allows us to characterize both the mechanisms that have been demonstrated in deployed or production-oriented systems and the more ambitious visions of recursive improvement that remain to be validated, thereby clarifying the current progress and limitations of industrial RSI practice. Figure16按自主水平和改进目标报告了调查文献，而表reports the surveyed literature by autonomy level and improvement target, while Table12提供了相应的产业系统景观。provides the corresponding landscape of industrial systems.

1.7 与现有调查的差异Differences from Existing Surveys

现有的调查提供了自我进化系统的补充分类法以及构建改进循环的机制。这些著作建立了我们的分析所依赖的许多技术词汇。我们的调查在四个方面有所不同。Existing surveys provide complementary taxonomies of self-evolving systems and the mechanisms from which improvement loops are built. These works establish much of the technical vocabulary on which our analysis relies. Our survey differs in four respects.

∙\bullet 以改进循环为分析单位。Improvement loop as the unit of analysis.先前的调查按自我进化、更新对象、时间或技术机制的阶段来组织工作Prior surveys organize work by stages of self-evolution, update objects, timing, or technical mechanismsTao et al. [2024], Gao et al. [2026], Fang et al. [2025], Ren et al. [2026b]。这些视图解释了哪些变化以及变化是如何产生的，但是更新同一组件的系统可能会为人工智能分配非常不同的决策。我们跟踪一个完整的循环：什么触发了改进，谁提出并验证了更改，什么持续存在，以及哪些后续决策使用保留的更改。. These views explain what changes and how the change is produced, but systems that update the same component may assign very different decisions to AI. We trace a complete loop: what triggers improvement, who proposes and validates a change, what persists, and which later decisions use the retained change.

∙\bullet 以责任作为自治标准。Responsibility as the autonomy criterion.相关框架检查能力水平、共同进化、动态代理状态和 AI-for-AI 系统Related frameworks examine capability levels, co-evolution, dynamic agent state, and AI-for-AI systemsLiu et al. [2026c], Zong et al. [2026], Xu et al. [2026], Ye et al. [2026]。我们通过从外部设计师转移到人工智能的改进决策来实现自主性，而不是通过模型功能或自动化组件的数量。我们的五个层次区分了执行、策略选择、经验获取、环境适应和递归继承的责任。. We operationalize autonomy through the improvement decisions transferred from external designers to the AI rather than through model capability or the number of automated components. Our five levels distinguish responsibility for execution, strategy selection, experience acquisition, environmental adaptation, and recursive inheritance.

∙\bullet 递归和性能的单独证据。Separate evidence for recursion and performance.评估调查研究基于模型的判断、代理评估、规则引导的学习和监督失败Evaluation surveys study model-based judgment, agent assessment, rubric-guided learning, and oversight failuresLi et al. [2025a], Yehudai et al. [2026], Shan and Shao [2026], Kim et al. [2024], Slattery et al. [2024]。更高的任务绩效本身并不表明改进机制被修改、保留和重用。我们区分了结构递归和有效递归，结构递归是修改后的改进机制控制后一轮，有效递归是该机制在可比较的预算和独立评估下产生更强的后继者。. Higher task performance alone does not show that an improvement mechanism was revised, retained, and reused. We distinguish structural recursion, in which a revised improvement mechanism governs a later round, from effective recursion, in which that mechanism produces stronger successors under comparable budgets and independent evaluation.

∙\bullet 不同操作条件下的机制比较。Mechanisms compared across operating conditions.纠正、合成数据、终身学习、记忆、提示优化和工作流程设计方面的工作解释了各个组件如何改进Work on correction, synthetic data, lifelong learning, memory, prompt optimization, and workflow design explains how individual components improvePan et al. [2024], Venktesh et al. [2025], Niu et al. [2026], Long et al. [2024], Zheng et al. [2026b], Huang et al. [2026b], Zhou et al. [2026a], Ramnath et al. [2025], Lee et al. [2025], Yue et al. [2026], Li et al. [2026b]。我们研究这些机制如何在科学、具体智能、软件工程、医疗保健和工业实践的完整循环中发挥作用，其中反馈成本、验证和外部控制各不相同. We examine how these mechanisms function within complete loops across science, embodied intelligence, software engineering, healthcare, and industrial practice, where feedback cost, validation, and external control differDing et al. [2026], Zhou et al. [2026b], Zhu et al. [2026a]。比较这些设置中的相同循环问题可以揭示方法何时依赖于廉价的可执行反馈、重复交互、专家评审或生产基础设施。. Comparing the same loop questions across these settings reveals when a method depends on cheap executable feedback, repeated interaction, expert review, or production infrastructure.

这些选择共同将调查定位在改进机制目录和人工智能功能的一般层次结构之间。我们的目标是确定当前系统可以承担改进循环的哪些部分，保留的更改如何影响后续轮次，以及哪些证据支持递归进度的主张。These choices together position the survey between a catalog of improvement mechanisms and a general hierarchy of AI capabilities. Our aim is to determine which parts of an improvement loop current systems can assume, how retained changes affect later rounds, and what evidence supports claims of recursive progress.

2 背景和预备知识Background and Preliminaries

本节为我们的研究奠定了经验和概念基础 以自治为中心的递归自我完善观点。 我们首先考察现代基础模型在各个领域的不平衡进展。 不同的能力领域，强调为什么持续改进是 特别与交互式、有状态和工具使用的系统相关。 然后我们通过改进循环的结构来表征 RSI， 介绍分析如何产生改进所需的关键组件， 验证、保留和继承，并将 RSI 与相邻的区分开来 持续学习、AutoML 和代理 AI 等范式。 最后，由于当代 RSI 涵盖学术研究和工业领域 工程实践中，我们明确了所使用证据的范围和强度 在整个调查过程中。 总之，这些预备工作提供了实证动机、操作性 词汇和自治等级的证据基础 以下部分。This section establishes the empirical and conceptual basis for our autonomy-centered view of recursive self-improvement. We first examine the uneven progress of modern foundation models across different capability domains, highlighting why persistent improvement is particularly relevant to interactive, stateful, and tool-using systems. We then characterize RSI through the structure of an improvement loop, introduce the key components needed to analyze how improvements are generated, validated, retained, and inherited, and distinguish RSI from neighboring paradigms such as continual learning, AutoML, and agentic AI. Finally, because contemporary RSI spans both academic research and industrial engineering practice, we clarify the scope and strength of the evidence used throughout this survey. Together, these preliminaries provide the empirical motivation, operational vocabulary, and evidentiary basis for the autonomy hierarchy developed in the following section.
