These mechanisms can direct successive updates toward failures observed during deployment and reduce the capability gaps represented by the illustrative extensions.

2.2 递归自我完善的概念基础Conceptual Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement

智能系统可以参与改善其自身未来行为的想法有几个智力前身，包括自我修改程序、哥德尔机、自动化机器学习、元学习、持续学习、开放式学习以及能够修改代码、提示、工具或培训程序的最新代理系统The idea that an intelligent system may participate in improving its own future behavior has several intellectual predecessors, including self-modifying programs, the Gödel Machine, automated machine learning, meta-learning, continual learning, open-ended learning, and more recent agentic systems capable of modifying code, prompts, tools, or training proceduresSchmidhuber [2003], Ye et al. [2026], Shi et al. [2025], Wang et al. [2019], Hu et al. [2025], Zhang et al. [2025]。这些传统解决了问题的重叠部分，但它们本身并没有为 RSI 提供充分的标准。自动优化并不一定意味着自我改进，持续学习并不一定意味着学习过程的自主性，人工智能对外部工件的改进并不一定会修改生成它的人工智能系统。. These traditions address overlapping parts of the problem, but they do not by themselves provide a sufficient criterion for RSI. Automated optimization does not necessarily imply self-improvement, persistent learning does not necessarily imply autonomy over the learning process, and an AI-generated improvement to an external artifact does not necessarily modify the AI system that generated it.

为此，我们采取For this reason, we take the改进循环improvement loop而不是任何特定的算法作为分析的基本单位。这种视角允许通过非常不同的机制实现的系统根据相同的问题进行比较：什么产生了体验，什么改变了，什么持续到未来的交互中，谁控制更新过程，以及一轮改进的结果是否参与确定后续改进。rather than any particular algorithm as the basic unit of analysis. This perspective allows systems implemented through very different mechanisms to be compared according to the same questions: what generates the experience, what is changed, what persists into future interactions, who controls the update process, and whether the result of one improvement round participates in determining subsequent improvements.

2.2.1 改进循环的剖析Anatomy of an Improvement Loop

改进循环。Improvement loop.我们将改进循环定义为一个循环过程，其中人工智能系统利用经验提出对目标的修改，根据接受规则评估候选者，保留其状态中已接受的更改，并从更新的状态开始下一轮。以下组件标识每个操作发生的位置以及轮次之间传递的信息。We define an improvement loop as a recurring process in which an AI system uses experience to propose a modification to a target, evaluates the candidate under an acceptance rule, retains an accepted change in its state, and begins the next round from that updated state. The following components identify where each operation occurs and what information passes between rounds.

∙\bullet 人工智能系统：AI system:完整的计算实体，其能力状态在改进周期中进行跟踪。它包括确定系统如何运行、根据反馈生成修改并将已接受的结果带入下一轮的机制和持久状态。例如，在自动化代码改进中，人工智能系统包括提出补丁、执行修改后的程序、评估结果以及从保留版本继续的组件。the complete computational entity whose capability state is tracked across improvement cycles. It includes the mechanisms and persistent state that determine how the system acts, generates modifications from feedback, and carries accepted results into the next round. In automated code improvement, for example, the AI system includes the components that propose a patch, execute the modified program, evaluate the result, and continue from a retained version.

∙\bullet 系统状态：System state:人工智能系统在一轮结束时保留并由下一轮继承的部分。这是下一轮从上一轮收到的内容。如果系统接受更快的程序并继续修改该版本，则保留的程序属于其系统状态。the part of the AI system retained at the end of one round and inherited by the next. It is what the next round receives from the previous one. If a system accepts a faster program and continues modifying that version, the retained program belongs to its system state.

∙\bullet 经验：Experience:从早期交互中获得的信息并用于指导以后的修改。当测试失败、环境结果或审阅者更正通知后续更新时，它就成为经验。information obtained from earlier interactions and used to guide a later modification. A test failure, environment outcome, or reviewer correction becomes experience when it informs a subsequent update.

∙\bullet 目标：Target:本轮直接修改的对象。在代码优化中，目标可能是排序函数。如果系统稍后更改其生成候选代码的方法，则该搜索方法将成为目标。the object directly modified in the current round. In code optimization, the target may be a sorting function. If the system later changes its method for generating code candidates, that search method becomes the target.

∙\bullet 改进剂：Improver:将当前状态和可用经验转化为候选修改的机制。在提出下一个补丁之前读取当前代码和最近的测试失败的模型充当该轮的改进者。the mechanism that transforms the current state and available experience into candidate modifications. A model that reads the current code and a recent test failure before proposing the next patch acts as the improver in that round.

∙\bullet 策略：Strategy:改进器用来决定在哪里搜索以及如何生成候选的方法。策略可以优先考虑失败测试中涉及的代码位置。因为策略可以保留，所以也可能成为后期改进的目标。the method used by the improver to decide where to search and how to generate candidates. A strategy may prioritize code locations implicated in failed tests. Because the strategy can be retained, it may also become a target of later improvement.

∙\bullet 验证者：Verifier:评估候选人并应用接受规则的机制。它可以使用基准分数、单元测试、奖励模型、环境结果、人类反馈、正式约束、安全检查或这些信号的组合。the mechanism that evaluates candidates and applies the acceptance rule. It may use benchmark scores, unit tests, reward models, environment outcomes, human feedback, formal constraints, safety checks, or combinations of these signals.

∙\bullet 改进：Improvement:通过当前接受规则的候选修改将被保留，并进入下一个系统状态。因此，改进是一种被接受和继承的状态变化。a candidate modification that passes the current acceptance rule, is retained, and enters the next system state. An improvement is therefore an accepted and inherited state change.

∙\bullet 继任者：Successor:继承一个或多个已接受的改进并以更新状态进入下一轮的人工智能系统。例如，保留修订后的代码搜索策略并使用它来生成以后的修改的系统是生成该策略的版本的后继版本。the AI system that inherits one or more accepted improvements and enters the next round with an updated state. For example, a system that retains a revised code-search strategy and uses it to generate later modifications is the successor of the version that produced the strategy.

这种分解产生了三个交叉问题，将在整个调查中使用。This decomposition yields three cross-cutting questions that will be used throughout the survey.循环在哪里闭合？Where does the loop close?确定明显的改进是否真正返回到系统中。determines whether an apparent improvement actually returns to the system.更新和继承了什么？What is updated and inherited?决定了持续改进的载体。determines the persistent carrier of improvement.哪些决定仍然是外部的？Which decisions remain external?确定改进过程的权力有多少从人类或固定基础设施转移到人工智能系统本身。determines how much authority over the improvement process has been transferred from humans or fixed infrastructure to the AI system itself.

这种剖析适用于具有不同自动化程度的持续改进过程。下一小节详细说明了 RSI 的附加条件：经验必须产生具有足够自主权的持续自我改变，并且接受的改变必须能够影响后续改进的生成、评估、选择或巩固方式。This anatomy applies to persistent improvement processes with different degrees of automation. The next subsection specifies the additional conditions for RSI: experience must produce persistent self-change with sufficient autonomy, and an accepted change must be able to affect how later improvements are generated, evaluated, selected, or consolidated.

2.2.2 递归自我完善的定义Definition of Recursive Self-Improvement

使用上面的改进循环解剖，我们定义Using the improvement-loop anatomy above, we define递归自我完善recursive self-improvement（RSI）作为智能系统的能力，通过与任务、环境或其他智能代理的持续交互，在交互轮次中自主地将获得的经验和反馈转化为自身的持续变化（例如，模型参数、代理利用或改进策略），使得这些变化可以进一步影响用于生成、评估、选择和巩固后续自我改进的机制。因此，改进后的系统会以已经改变的能力状态重新引入下一轮交互和改进，从而使系统的改进能力本身成为持续递归过程的一部分。(RSI) as the capability of an intelligent system, through continued interaction with tasks, environments, or other intelligent agents, to autonomously transform acquired experience and feedback into persistent changes to itself across interaction rounds (e.g., model parameters, agent harnesses, or improvement policies), such that these changes can further affect the mechanisms used to generate, evaluate, select, and consolidate subsequent self-improvements. The improved system is consequently reintroduced into the next round of interaction and improvement with an already changed capability state, allowing the system’s capacity for improvement itself to become part of an ongoing recursive process.

RSI 包含一个自主的闭环过程，其中人工智能识别自身的局限性，开发和验证改进，并使用由此产生的能力来改进改进过程本身，目的是 (1) 扩大其能力前沿，(2) 提高资源效率，或 (3) 发现超出人类指定策略的新颖解决方案。RSI contains an autonomous, closed-loop process in which AI identifies its own limitations, develops and validates improvements, and uses the resulting capabilities to improve the improvement process itself, with the aim of (1) expanding its capability frontier, (2) increasing resource efficiency, or (3) discovering novel solutions beyond human-prescribed strategies.

最近的行业观点越来越多地通过自主改进循环来实施 RSI。 OpenAI 强调人工智能研究工作流程和反馈循环的自动化Recent industry perspectives increasingly operationalize RSI through autonomous improvement loops. OpenAI emphasizes the automation of AI research workflows and feedback loopsOpenAI [2026e]，而腾讯报告了一个早期阶段的 RSI 循环，其中实验结果被输入到后续几轮模型开发中, while Tencent reports an early-stage RSI loop in which experimental results are fed into subsequent rounds of model developmentTencent [2026]。更严格地说，阿里巴巴研究人员通过对改进机制本身进行修改来定义RSI. More strictly, Alibaba researchers define RSI by making the improvement mechanism itself subject to modificationLiu et al. [2026c]，而 Anthropic 将其最强大的形式描述为自主设计和开发自己的继任者的人工智能系统, whereas Anthropic describes its strongest form as an AI system autonomously designing and developing its own successorAnthropic Institute [2026].

2.2.3 与邻近范式的关系Relation to Neighboring Paradigms

RSI 与持续学习、自动化机器学习 (AutoML) 和代理 AI 交叉，因为改进循环的所有三个部分都是自动化的。它们的不同之处在于通常的改进目标、各轮保留的状态以及留给固定程序或外部参与者的决策。表RSI intersects with continual learning, automated machine learning (AutoML), and agentic AI because all three automate parts of an improvement loop. They differ in the usual target of improvement, the state retained across rounds, and the decisions left to a fixed procedure or an external actor. Table1总结了这些区别。summarizes these distinctions.

持续学习Continual learning：持续学习使模型或代理能够从一系列任务或数据中获取知识，同时限制早期能力的损失: Continual learning enables a model or agent to acquire knowledge from a sequence of tasks or data while limiting the loss of earlier capabilitiesShi et al. [2025], Wu et al. [2024], Zheng et al. [2025]。最近的工作涵盖持续预训练、指令调整、对齐、重播、参数高效更新和基于内存的适应. Recent work covers continual pre-training, instruction tuning, alignment, replay, parameter-efficient updates, and memory-based adaptationShi et al. [2025], Wu et al. [2024]。终身且自我进化的智能体进一步将持久状态扩展到模型权重之外的记忆、技能和行为策略. Lifelong and self-evolving agents further extend persistent state beyond model weights to memories, skills, and behavioral policiesZheng et al. [2026b], Fang et al. [2025]。然而，学习目标、更新规则、体验计划和验收测试通常仍然由系统设计者确定. The learning objective, update rule, experience schedule, and acceptance test nevertheless usually remain fixed by the system designerShi et al. [2025], Zheng et al. [2025]。在我们的框架中，当经验还可以修改后来的适应方案的提出、评估或巩固方式时，持续学习接近 RSI，并且修改后的过程在后续轮次中重复使用. In our framework, continual learning approaches RSI when experience can also revise how later adaptations are proposed, evaluated, or consolidated, and the revised process is reused in subsequent roundsZheng et al. [2026b], Fang et al. [2025].

自动机器学习AutoML：AutoML 自动执行模型开发决策，例如数据处理、模型和架构选择、超参数优化和管道构建: AutoML automates model-development decisions such as data processing, model and architecture selection, hyperparameter optimization, and pipeline constructionTrirat et al. [2025], Ye et al. [2026]。最近的系统通过语言模型代理扩大了这一范围：AutoML-Agent 构建并验证完整的机器学习管道，而 ADAS、AFlow 和 AgentSquare 搜索可执行代理设计、工作流程图或可重用模块. Recent systems broaden this scope through language-model agents: AutoML-Agent constructs and verifies complete machine-learning pipelines, while ADAS, AFlow, and AgentSquare search over executable agent designs, workflow graphs, or reusable modulesTrirat et al. [2025], Hu et al. [2025], Zhang et al. [2025], Shang et al. [2025]。 MLE-bench 和 AI Scientist-v2 将评估扩展到持续的机器学习工程和迭代研究工作流程. MLE-bench and the AI Scientist-v2 extend evaluation to sustained machine-learning engineering and iterative research workflowsChan et al. [2025], Yamada et al. [2025]。他们的搜索空间、目标、预算和评估者通常都是提前提供的，即使大部分开发工作都是自动化的. Their search spaces, objectives, budgets, and evaluators are generally supplied in advance, even when much of the development work is automatedTrirat et al. [2025], Hu et al. [2025], Zhang et al. [2025]。当用于搜索或评估改进的过程成为后续轮次可以改进的持久状态时，AutoML 达到 RSI 边界. AutoML reaches the RSI boundary when the procedure used to search for or evaluate improvements becomes persistent state that later rounds can improveHu et al. [2025], Zhang et al. [2025], Fang et al. [2025].

代理人工智能和代理机器学习Agentic AI and agentic ML：代理系统规划多步骤工作、调用工具、运行实验、协调专用组件并修改中间工件: Agentic systems plan multistep work, invoke tools, run experiments, coordinate specialized components, and revise intermediate artifactsChan et al. [2025], Starace et al. [2025], Yamada et al. [2025]。 MLE-bench、PaperBench 和 AI Scientist-v2 在机器学习工程和研究环境中研究这些功能. MLE-bench, PaperBench, and the AI Scientist-v2 study these capabilities in machine-learning engineering and research settingsChan et al. [2025], Starace et al. [2025], Yamada et al. [2025]，而 ADAS 和 AFlow 自动构建执行任务的代理或工作流程, while ADAS and AFlow automate the construction of the agent or workflow that performs the taskHu et al. [2025], Zhang et al. [2025]。这些系统可以在一个情节中运行，其利用、工具、停止规则和接受标准保持不变，这是在自我进化代理的工作中确定的边界. These systems may operate within an episode whose harness, tools, stopping rule, and acceptance criteria remain unchanged, a boundary identified in work on self-evolving agentsFang et al. [2025], Zheng et al. [2026b]。当对代理系统进行验证的更改在任务中持续存在并影响后续改进的生成或选择方式时，代理 ML 接近 RSI. Agentic ML approaches RSI when validated changes to the agent system persist across tasks and affect how later improvements are generated or selectedFang et al. [2025], Hu et al. [2025], Zhang et al. [2025].

因此，RSI 提出的独特问题不仅仅是人工智能是否有助于人工智能的发展。问题在于系统本身是否形成了持续的改进循环，以及对该循环的权威程度已成为内生的。The distinctive question posed by RSI is therefore not simply whether AI contributes to AI development. It is whether a persistent improvement loop has formed around the system itself, and how much authority over that loop has become endogenous.

2.3 证据范围Scope of Evidence

RSI目前的发展跨越了学术研究和工业工程实践。因此，将证据库限制在同行评审的出版物上将会忽略那些最详细描述出现在技术报告、官方工程博客、开源存储库、模型文档或公司研究材料中的系统。当这些来源提供有关改进循环的结构或操作的具体证据时，我们将其纳入其中。The current development of RSI spans academic research and industrial engineering practice. Restricting the evidence base to peer-reviewed publications would therefore omit systems whose most detailed descriptions appear in technical reports, official engineering blogs, open-source repositories, model documentation, or company research materials. We include these sources when they provide concrete evidence about the structure or operation of an improvement loop.

工业实践是当代 RSI 的主要证据来源。Industrial practice is a primary source of evidence for contemporary RSI.许多最先进的自我完善循环都是在前沿人工智能系统中开发出来的，然后才在传统学术论文中得到充分描述。他们的操作细节通常首先出现在领先人工智能实验室、工程博客、开源存储库、GitHub 和 Hugging Face 等平台上的模型发布以及公共基准或竞赛排行榜的技术或研究报告中。这些来源揭示了对本次调查特别重要的 RSI 方面：如何在工作系统中组织改进、在迭代中保留哪些工件、模型和代理如何与评估者和工具交互，以及改进机制是否在单个实验结果之外继续运行。Many of the most advanced self-improvement loops are developed in frontier AI systems before they are fully described in conventional academic papers. Their operational details often first appear in technical or research reports from leading AI laboratories, engineering blogs, open-source repositories, model releases on platforms such as GitHub and Hugging Face, and public benchmark or competition leaderboards. These sources expose aspects of RSI that are particularly important to this survey: how improvement is organized in a working system, what artifacts are retained across iterations, how models and agents interact with evaluators and tools, and whether an improvement mechanism continues to operate beyond a single experimental result.

这种更广泛的证据范围使调查能够捕捉新兴的 RSI 实践，同时保持已证实的机制和推断的机制之间的明确区别。This broader evidence scope allows the survey to capture emerging RSI practice while maintaining a clear distinction between demonstrated mechanisms and inferred ones.

3 跨自治级别的 RSIRSI Across Autonomy Levels

我们根据人工智能系统对其自身改进承担的责任大小，将现有的 RSI 工作组织成自治级别的层次结构。层次结构从We organize existing work on RSI into a hierarchy of autonomy levels, according to how much responsibility the AI system assumes for its own improvement. The hierarchy progresses from会话中的细化in-session refinement，其中改进仅限于当前任务，通过日益持久和自主的系统适应形式，, where improvement is confined to the current task, through increasingly persistent and autonomous forms of system adaptation, toward递归改进recursive improvement，产生未来改进的机制本身也需要改进。, where the mechanisms for producing future improvements themselves become subject to improvement.

在每个级别，我们都会审查代表性方法和系统，同时解决三个常见问题：At each level, we review representative approaches and systems while addressing three common questions:(1) 改进循环在哪里闭合，(2) 哪些改进被保留并进入下一轮，以及 (3) 改进过程中哪些关键决策仍处于人类控制之下？(1) where is the improvement loop closed, (2) what improvement is retained and carried into the next round, and (3) which critical decisions in the improvement process remain under human control?

表Table2提供了代表性实施技术的跨级图。provides a cross-level map of representative implementation techniques.

3.1 B0：任务内人工智能改进B0: In-Task AI Improvement

在 B0 时，改进仅限于当前任务：人工智能系统可以迭代地修改、验证或在候选输出中进行选择，但不会将由此产生的更改保留为未来独立任务的持久系统状态。因此，我们将 B0 视为非 RSI 参考水平，标志着两者之间的界限At B0, improvement is confined to the current task: the AI system may iteratively revise, verify, or select among candidate outputs, but no resulting change is retained as persistent system state for future independent tasks. We therefore treat B0 as a non-RSI reference level that marks the boundary between提高输出improving an output和and改进产生未来产出的系统improving the system that produces future outputs。换句话说，B0的定义标准是. Put differently, the defining criterion of B0 is输出变化无需持续的系统变化output change without persistent system change.

例如，编码代理可以使用人类提供的测试套件和五次尝试的固定限制来重复修改其代码。如果修复和反馈仅限于当前任务并且不改变代理处理后续任务的方式，则它保持在 B0。类似地，写作代理可以根据人类提供的标题修改一篇文章，而不保留未来写作的最终经验。在这两种情况下，人类都会指定评估规则和修改程序，而人工智能仅在这些限制内改进当前的输出。For example, a coding agent may repeatedly revise its code using a human-provided test suite and a fixed limit of five attempts. It remains at B0 if the fixes and feedback are confined to the current task and do not change how the agent handles subsequent tasks. Similarly, a writing agent may revise an essay against a human-provided rubric without retaining the resulting experience for future writing. In both cases, humans specify the evaluation rules and revision procedure, while AI improves only the current output within those constraints.

在固定规则下，B0可以提高单次输出。例如，自我优化通过同一会话中的生成-反馈-优化循环来改进输出Under fixed rules, B0 can improve output in single sessions. For instance, Self-Refine improves outputs through a generate–feedback–refine loop within the same sessionMadaan et al. [2023];反射将失败尝试的口头反思写入上下文缓冲区以供后续尝试; Reflexion writes verbal reflections on failed attempts into a context buffer for subsequent triesShinn et al. [2023];思想之树将推理组织为对候选思想分支的搜索; Tree of Thoughts organizes reasoning as a search over candidate thought branchesYao et al. [2023].

然而，B0无法跨任务积累知识。迭代轨迹和修正信号仅存在于当前会话内；任务终止后就被丢弃，系统无法将碎片化的经验整合为长期能力。 APEX-EM 指出，基于 LLM 的代理通常缺乏持久的程序记忆：即使在解决相同的任务之后，它们也必须从头开始重新推导解决方案However, B0 cannot accumulate knowledge across tasks. Iterative traces and correction signals exist only within the current session; after task termination they are discarded, and the system cannot consolidate fragmented experience into long-term capability. APEX-EM notes that LLM-based agents generally lack persistent procedural memory: even after solving an identical task, they must re-derive the solution from scratchBanerjee et al. [2026]。具体来说，主要有四个限制。. Specifically, there are four main limitations.

∙\bullet 经验不会跨任务积累。Experience does not accumulate across tasks.中间结果、批评和纠正保留在临时任务上下文中，而不是成为模型参数、可重用内存或操作规则的更新Intermediate results, critiques, and corrections remain in temporary task context rather than becoming updates to model parameters, reusable memory, or operating rulesZhao et al. [2024]。因此，系统可能会纠正一项任务中的错误，并在下一项任务中重复该错误。增加迭代次数并不能解决持续学习不足的问题。. A system may therefore correct an error in one task and repeat it in the next. Increasing the number of iterations cannot resolve this lack of persistent learning.

∙\bullet 改进程序仍然由人类定义。Improvement procedure remains human-defined.人工智能可以生成、验证和修改输出，但人类仍然决定这个过程如何运作AI can generate, verify, and revise outputs, but humans still determine how this process operatesMadaan et al. [2023]。例如，编码代理可以修复测试失败的代码，但它不会持续改进未来任务的测试过程。循环围绕电流输出闭合；升级系统改进机制的责任仍在人类身上。工具使用、模拟和现实世界的反馈本身并不会改变这个边界。. For example, a coding agent may fix code that fails a test, but it does not persistently improve the testing procedure for future tasks. The loop closes around the current output; responsibility for upgrading the system’s improvement mechanisms remains with humans. Tool use, simulation, and real-world feedback do not by themselves change this boundary.

∙\bullet 自我生成的反馈可能会加剧错误。Self-generated feedback can reinforce errors.当同一模型生成并评估答案时，两个阶段可能存在相同的知识差距。自校正基准将验证（特别是定位第一个不正确的推理步骤）视为关键瓶颈When the same model generates and evaluates an answer, both stages may share the same knowledge gaps. Self-Correction Bench identifies verification, particularly locating the first incorrect reasoning step, as a key bottleneckTsui [2026], Tyen et al. [2024]。如果没有可靠的外部反馈，修改甚至可能会将正确答案变成错误答案. Without reliable external feedback, revision can even turn a correct answer into an incorrect oneHuang et al. [2024]。因此，反复批评并不能保证纠正成功。. Repeated critique therefore does not guarantee successful correction.

∙\bullet 在固定评估下，更多迭代提供的收益有限。More iterations offer limited gains under fixed evaluation.在没有新信息的情况下修改答案可能不会带来额外的好处Revising an answer without new information may provide little additional benefitLi [2026];在某些情况下，独立抽样或外部验证可能更有效; independent sampling or external verification can be more effective in some settingsOlausson et al. [2024], Verma [2026]。固定验证器也会留下一些未被检测到的错误. A fixed verifier also leaves some errors undetectedLiu et al. [2023]。例如，反复修改代码以通过不完整的测试套件可能会提高测试性能，但会导致未测试的故障无法解决。. For example, repeatedly revising code to pass an incomplete test suite may improve test performance while leaving untested failures unresolved.

3.2 L1：改进执行的自主权L1: Autonomy over Improvement Execution

在 L1，人工智能系统执行人类定义的改进程序，其可接受的 结果将被保留并在以后的任务或改进轮次中重复使用。人类指定目标、更新程序和验收标准，而人工智能则执行规定的改进步骤。与 B0 不同，循环会更改指定 AI 系统内的持久状态，而不仅仅是细化当前任务输出。例如，编码代理可以遵循人工定义的过程，根据测试反馈修改代码，将经过验证的修复保存为可重用规则，并自动将它们应用到后续的独立任务。这种模式已经在生产基础设施中显现出来。 Meta 的容量效率系统将工程师的调试专业知识编码为可重复使用的修复技能，并通过预定义的程序应用这些技能来诊断性能回归并执行补救任务。 Meta 报告称，此工作流程将数小时的手动回归调查压缩为几分钟，并且生成的拉取请求经过标准审查和集成，从而在生产系统中实现持续改进At L1, AI system executes a human-defined improvement procedure whose accepted results are retained and reused in later tasks or improvement rounds. Humans specify the objective, update procedure, and acceptance criteria, while AI carries out the prescribed improvement steps. Unlike B0, the loop changes persistent state within the specified AI system rather than only refining the current task output. For example, a coding agent may follow a human-defined procedure to revise code based on test feedback, save validated fixes as reusable rules, and automatically apply them to subsequent independent tasks. This pattern is already visible in production infrastructure. Meta’s Capacity Efficiency system encodes engineers’ debugging expertise into reusable repair skills and applies these skills through predefined procedures to diagnose performance regressions and perform remediation tasks. Meta reports that this workflow compresses hours of manual regression investigation into minutes, and the resulting pull requests undergo standard review and integration, creating persistent improvements in the production systemMeta Engineering [2026].

该级别的特征环路可以总结如下：The characteristic loop at this level can be summarized as follows:

 获得改进目标receive improvement objective⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  执行规定程序execute prescribed procedure⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  生产改进produce improvement ⟶\longrightarrow\;  更新系统状态update system state⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  处理下一个任务process the next task⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  重复repeat

尽管结构简单，但可靠地执行该循环会带来几个核心挑战。首先，规定的程序必须涵盖执行过程中出现的情况。当任务遇到预定义过程无法解决的情况时，代理缺乏适用的下一步，并且无法独立修改过程来解决它。其次，执行必须在多步骤工作流程中保持可靠，因为不正确的诊断、转换或中间决策可能会影响所有后续操作。第三，由于所产生的改进被写回系统状态并在以后的任务中重用，因此在保留之前必须检查其有效性；否则，执行错误可能会持续存在并影响后续的开发周期。这些挑战在整个人工智能开发流程中反复出现，但其具体形式取决于改进过程的执行阶段。Despite its simple structure, executing this loop reliably presents several core challenges. First, the prescribed procedure must cover the situations that arise during execution. When the task encounters a condition that is not addressed by the predefined procedure, the agent lacks an applicable next step and cannot independently modify the procedure to resolve it. Second, execution must remain reliable across multi-step workflows, since an incorrect diagnosis, transformation, or intermediate decision can influence all subsequent actions. Third, because the resulting improvement is written back into the system state and reused in later tasks, its validity must be checked before retention; otherwise, execution errors can persist and affect subsequent development cycles. These challenges recur across the AI development pipeline, but their concrete form depends on the stage in which the improvement procedure is executed.

具体来说，真实场景中的大规模人工智能开发通常分为几个不同的层次：（1）数据层控制训练语料库的构建和管理； (2) 训练方法级别决定模型如何学习； （三）培训平台层管理大规模培训的执行； (4)评估和安全级别评估模型的能力和安全性； (5) 部署优化级别实现高效的模型服务； (6)应用系统层将基础模型能力集成到下游产品和应用系统中。以下部分研究人工智能系统如何在每个级别内自主执行预定义的改进程序，以及生成的工件如何输入到开发工作流程的下游阶段。表Specifically, large-scale AI development in real scenarios is typically organized into several distinct levels: (1) the data level governs the construction and curation of training corpora; (2) the training-method level determines how models learn; (3) the training-platform level manages the execution of large-scale training; (4) the evaluation-and-safety level assesses model capabilities and safety; (5) the deployment-optimization level enables efficient model serving; and (6) the application-system level integrates foundation-model capabilities into downstream products and application systems. The following sections examine how the AI system autonomously executes predefined improvement procedures within each level and how the resulting artifacts feed into downstream stages of the development workflow. Table3总结了在这些级别上讨论的代表性系统。summarizes the representative systems discussed across these levels.

3.2.1 数据级别Data Level

在数据层面，人工智能越来越多地接管以前通过大量手动操作执行的大规模数据生产和管理程序。现有的方法主要分为两类。第一个重点是At the data level, AI increasingly takes over the execution of large-scale data production and curation procedures that were previously carried out through substantial manual effort. Existing approaches mainly fall into two classes. The first focuses on数据清洗和质量过滤data cleaning and quality filtering，第二个重点是, and the second focuses on合成数据和监督生成synthetic data and supervision generation，人们定义目标任务、所需的数据特征和验证程序。, where humans define the target task, desired data characteristics, and validation procedures.

∙\bullet (1)数据清洗和质量过滤。(1) Data cleaning and quality filtering.数据层面的主要挑战是规模：训练语料和候选样本的数量远远超过样本层面人工审核的能力。因此，数据管理正在从逐个样本的人类判断转向人类定义质量标准和处理程序，而人工智能大规模执行它们的范式。在谷歌的高保真标签管理管道中，开发人员首先定义目标任务及其决策标准，例如标题诱饵的构成。然后，法学硕士应用这些标准为候选数据分配初步标签，然后使用预定义的聚类和边界样本选择程序识别一小部分信息样本以供专家注释A primary challenge at the data level is scale: the volume of training corpora and candidate samples far exceeds the capacity for manual review at the sample level. Data curation is therefore shifting from sample-by-sample human judgment toward a paradigm in which humans define quality criteria and processing procedures, while AI executes them at scale. In Google’s high-fidelity label curation pipeline, developers first define the target task and its decision criteria, such as what constitutes clickbait. An LLM then applies these criteria to assign preliminary labels to candidate data, after which a predefined clustering and boundary-sample selection procedure identifies a small subset of informative samples for expert annotationGoogle Research [2025]。 Phi-4 推理训练数据的构建中也出现了类似的分工：研究人员指定所需的难度和推理特征及其评估程序，而基于 LLM 的评估流程则应用这些标准来选择接近模型能力边界的样本. A similar division of labor appears in the construction of training data for Phi-4-reasoning: researchers specify the desired difficulty and reasoning characteristics together with their evaluation procedures, while LLM-based evaluation pipelines apply these criteria to select samples near the model’s capability boundaryAbdin et al. [2025]。 FineWeb-Edu 将这种模式扩展到大规模网络过滤：研究人员定义教育质量标准，使用法学硕士生成质量标签，并训练分类器大规模应用这些标准. FineWeb-Edu extends this pattern to large-scale web filtering: researchers define educational-quality criteria, use an LLM to generate quality labels, and train a classifier to apply these criteria at scalePenedo et al. [2024]。随着这些数据处理操作变得标准化，它们也可以合并到可重用的管道中。 NVIDIA NeMo Curator 将质量过滤、分类和重复数据删除组织到可配置模块中，这些模块根据开发人员指定的规则和参数执行. As these data-processing operations become standardized, they can also be incorporated into reusable pipelines. NVIDIA NeMo Curator organizes quality filtering, classification, and deduplication into configurable modules that execute according to developer-specified rules and parametersNVIDIA [2025]。 Data-Juicer 遵循类似的方法，但将数据处理操作抽象为可组合运算符，允许在大规模语料库上执行预定义的处理方法. Data-Juicer follows a similar approach but abstracts data-processing operations into composable operators, allowing predefined processing recipes to be executed over large-scale corporaChen et al. [2024].

∙\bullet (2)合成数据和监督信号生成。(2) Synthetic data and supervision signal generation.训练数据可以通过合成生成来扩展。手动构建复杂任务的高质量演示通常成本高昂，因此需要使用模型可以大规模执行的可重复数据生成程序。 Microsoft SynthLLM 遵循这种方法，从高质量的 Web 内容开始，通过预定义的多阶段过程组织参考概念，并使用 LLM 生成不同的提示和相应的响应作为综合训练示例Training data can be expanded through synthetic generation. High-quality demonstrations for complex tasks are often costly to construct manually, motivating the use of repeatable data-generation procedures that models can execute at scale. Microsoft SynthLLM follows this approach by starting from high-quality web content, organizing reference concepts through a predefined multi-stage procedure, and using LLMs to generate diverse prompts and corresponding responses as synthetic training examplesMicrosoft Research [2025]。类似的程序还可以产生更丰富的监督形式。 SynthAgent 将任务和交互轨迹的构建组织到预定义的管道中，其中模型执行网络探索、任务生成和轨迹细化，以生成用于训练网络代理的监督数据. Similar procedures can also produce richer forms of supervision. SynthAgent organizes the construction of tasks and interaction trajectories into a predefined pipeline, in which models perform web exploration, task generation, and trajectory refinement to produce supervision data for training web agentsWang et al. [2026c]。合成生成可以与预定义的质量评估相结合，构建更高质量的监督数据。 NVIDIA Nemotron-4 使用指令模型生成候选响应，并使用奖励模型根据预定义的质量维度对它们进行评分和过滤，生成的合成样本用于后续模型训练. Synthetic generation can be combined with predefined quality evaluation to construct higher-quality supervision data. NVIDIA Nemotron-4 uses an instruction model to generate candidate responses and a reward model to score and filter them according to predefined quality dimensions, with the resulting synthetic samples used for subsequent model trainingNVIDIA [2024].

3.2.2 培训方法级别Training-Method Level

在培训方法层面，人工智能越来越多地接管以前由研究人员和工程师手动编排的结构化学习和培训后程序的执行。现有方法主要将诊断、修订、评估和优化步骤编码到预定义的工作流程中，其中人类指定学习目标、反馈信号和更新规则，而人工智能系统执行这些程序以生成改进的训练信号并支持后续模型优化。At the training-method level, AI increasingly takes over the execution of structured learning and post-training procedures that were previously orchestrated manually by researchers and engineers. Existing approaches mainly encode diagnostic, revision, evaluation, and optimization steps into predefined workflows, where humans specify the learning objectives, feedback signals, and update rules, while AI systems execute these procedures to generate improved training signals and support subsequent model optimization.

既定的培训实践可以编码为明确的改进程序，并在培训后由人工智能系统执行，从而改进模型接收培训信号的方式，从而提高学习成果。编辑将此过程组织为一个两阶段的培训程序。研究人员首先指定诊断信号和修订标准，然后系统识别有问题的推理步骤，法学硕士根据标题清单仅修订受影响的部分。然后将修改后的输出用于进一步的强化学习校准Established training practices can be encoded into explicit improvement procedures and executed by AI systems during post-training, improving how models receive training signals and thereby enhancing learning outcomes. EDIT organizes this process as a two-stage training procedure. Researchers first specify the diagnostic signals and revision criteria, after which the system identifies problematic reasoning steps and an LLM revises only the affected parts according to a rubric checklist. The revised outputs are then used for further reinforcement-learning calibrationWu et al. [2026c]。 REPO 同样将多阶段标准操作程序和行为约束纳入培训过程。该模型在多轮交互过程中遵循规定的步骤，而基于LLM的法官根据预定义的标准评估程序合规性，并将评估结果转换为奖励信号以供后续策略优化. REPO similarly incorporates a multi-stage standard operating procedure and behavioral constraints into the training process. The model follows the prescribed steps during multi-turn interactions, while an LLM-based judge evaluates procedural compliance according to predefined criteria and converts the resulting assessments into reward signals for subsequent policy optimizationZeng et al. [2026].

3.2.3 培训平台级别Training-Platform Level

在培训平台层面，人工智能越来越多地接管基础设施工程程序的执行，以保持大规模培训的高效和可靠。现有的方法主要分为两类。第一个重点是At the training-platform level, AI increasingly takes over the execution of infrastructure engineering procedures required to keep large-scale training efficient and reliable. Existing approaches mainly fall into two classes. The first focuses on训练执行和性能优化training execution and performance optimization，其中代理分析工作负载并应用预定义的优化程序，第二个重点是, where agents analyze workloads and apply predefined optimization procedures, and the second focuses on故障诊断与恢复failure diagnosis and recovery，代理执行从工程知识和操作经验中提取的结构化调试和修复工作流程。, where agents execute structured debugging and remediation workflows distilled from engineering knowledge and operational experience.

∙\bullet (1) 训练执行与优化。(1) Training execution and optimization.性能工程实践可以编码为人工智能代理在具体工作负载上执行的显式优化程序。与代理无关的端到端 C/C++ 应用程序性能优化通过将完整的优化控制循环存储在程序内存中来遵循此模式。代理执行运行时分析，识别性能热点，生成候选代码修改，并根据预定义的工作流程验证正确性和性能，在进一步优化之前回滚不成功的更改Performance-engineering practices can be encoded into explicit optimization procedures that AI agents execute on concrete workloads. Agent-Agnostic End-to-End C/C++ Application Performance Optimization follows this pattern by storing the complete optimization control loop in procedural memory. The agent performs runtime analysis, identifies performance hotspots, generates candidate code modifications, and validates both correctness and performance according to the predefined workflow, with unsuccessful changes rolled back before further optimizationLu and Xia [2026].

∙\bullet (2)训练故障诊断与恢复。(2) Training failure diagnosis and recovery.分布式训练故障同样可以通过从积累的工程经验中得出的结构化调试程序来处理。 Meta 和 PyTorch 社区对 NCCL 看门狗超时的主要根本原因进行了分类，并将这些发现提炼成实用的决策树和调试操作手册。然后，人工智能代理通过跨等级对齐证据、跟踪集体序列以及将运行时跟踪连接到相应的代码路径来针对具体故障执行此结构化工作流程，以便找到最早的可操作分歧Distributed-training failures can similarly be handled through structured debugging procedures derived from accumulated engineering experience. Meta and the PyTorch community categorized the major root causes of NCCL watchdog timeouts and distilled these findings into a practical decision tree and debugging runbook. An AI agent then executes this structured workflow on concrete failures by aligning evidence across ranks, tracing collective sequences, and connecting runtime traces to the corresponding code paths in order to locate the earliest actionable divergenceLiu et al. [2026a].

3.2.4 评估和安全水平Evaluation-and-Safety Level

在评估和安全层面，人工智能越来越多地接管模型评估程序的执行，将专家定义的要求转化为可扩展和可重复的评估。现有方法使用人工智能系统在大量模型输出中应用预定义的规则、测试协议和风险标准，而人类仍然负责定义评估目标、标准和接受阈值。At the evaluation-and-safety level, AI increasingly takes over the execution of model assessment procedures that translate expert-defined requirements into scalable and repeatable evaluations. Existing approaches use AI systems to apply predefined rubrics, test protocols, and risk criteria across large numbers of model outputs, while humans remain responsible for defining the evaluation objectives, criteria, and acceptance thresholds.

模型评估将专家判断转化为可重复的测试和评分程序。 OpenAI HealthBench 要求医学专家为特定的医疗保健对话定义详细的评估标准，指定理想的响应应包括或避免的内容以及每个标准的相对重要性。然后，GPT-4.1 应用这些预定义的标准对候选模型响应进行评分并计算最终评估结果Model evaluation transforms expert judgment into repeatable testing and scoring procedures. OpenAI HealthBench asks medical experts to define detailed evaluation criteria for specific healthcare conversations, specifying what an ideal response should include or avoid and the relative importance of each criterion. GPT-4.1 then applies these predefined criteria to score candidate model responses and compute the final evaluation resultArora et al. [2025]。类似的评估程序也可以应用于稳健性、安全性和风险评估，为后续模型改进和发布决策提供标准化反馈。. Similar evaluation procedures can also be applied to robustness, safety, and risk evaluation, providing standardized feedback for subsequent model improvement and release decisions.

3.2.5 部署优化级别Deployment-Optimization Level

在部署优化层面，人工智能越来越多地接管程序的执行，使经过训练的模型适应具体的硬件和运行时环境。现有方法将部署专业知识编码到标准化工作流程中，以进行模型转换、兼容性解析、量化、运行时配置和验证，其中人类指定目标平台和部署约束，而人工智能系统则执行相应的适应和验证步骤。At the deployment-optimization level, AI increasingly takes over the execution of procedures for adapting trained models to concrete hardware and runtime environments. Existing approaches encode deployment expertise into standardized workflows for model conversion, compatibility resolution, quantization, runtime configuration, and validation, where humans specify the target platform and deployment constraints, while AI systems execute the corresponding adaptation and verification steps.

将经过训练的模型部署到目标硬件通常需要专门的模型转换和运行时适应程序。 AIPC 将这种部署专业知识编码为由代理技能和分阶段验证支持的标准化、可验证的阶段。给定经过训练的模型和目标 Qualcomm AI Runtime 环境，AI 代理执行预定义的部署程序来转换模型、处理部署不兼容性、执行量化校准并验证最终的实现。该流程为下游推理生成可运行的部署工件Deploying trained models to target hardware often requires specialized procedures for model conversion and runtime adaptation. AIPC encodes this deployment expertise into standardized, verifiable stages supported by Agent Skills and stage-wise validation. Given a trained model and a target Qualcomm AI Runtime environment, the AI agent executes the predefined deployment procedure to convert the model, handle deployment incompatibilities, perform quantization calibration, and validate the resulting implementation. The process produces runnable deployment artifacts for downstream inferenceSu et al. [2026].

3.2.6 应用系统级Application-System Level

在应用系统层面，人工智能越来越多地接管将基础模型集成到运营产品和服务中所需的软件工程程序的执行。现有方法将开发知识编码为可重用的技能、剧本和工程工作流程，允许人工智能系统执行服务集成、接口实现、代码修改、测试和验证等任务，而人类则继续指定产品需求、系统架构和管理开发约束。At the application-system level, AI increasingly takes over the execution of software-engineering procedures required to integrate foundation models into operational products and services. Existing approaches encode development knowledge into reusable skills, playbooks, and engineering workflows, allowing AI systems to perform tasks such as service integration, interface implementation, code modification, testing, and validation, while humans continue to specify product requirements, system architecture, and the governing development constraints.

将基础模型功能转化为实际产品需要通过可重复的工程过程将模型服务和接口集成到应用系统中。 Agent Toolkit for AWS 将生成式 AI 开发实践编码为可重用的代理技能。其 Amazon Bedrock 技能提供了将模型功能集成到应用程序中的预定义程序。 AI编码代理可以执行这些过程，将基础模型服务与下游产品接口和应用程序组件连接起来Transforming foundation-model capabilities into practical products requires model services and interfaces to be integrated into application systems through repeatable engineering procedures. Agent Toolkit for AWS encodes generative AI development practices into reusable Agent Skills. Its Amazon Bedrock skill provides predefined procedures for integrating model capabilities into applications. AI coding agents can execute these procedures to connect foundation-model services with downstream product interfaces and application componentsAmazon Web Services [2026]。 LinkedIn 的上下文代理手册和工具 (CAPT) 同样将积累的组织知识编码到分步手册中，使 AI 编码代理能够在真实代码库中执行具体的工程任务（例如服务创建、接口扩展和代码维护）. LinkedIn’s Contextual Agent Playbooks & Tools (CAPT) similarly encodes accumulated organizational knowledge into step-by-step playbooks, enabling AI coding agents to carry out concrete engineering tasks in real codebases (e.g., service creation, interface extension, and code maintenance)LinkedIn Engineering [2026]。 OpenAI Harness Engineering 将此模式扩展到端到端软件产品开发。工程师定义产品意图、系统架构以及管理持续集成、代码合并和回滚的规则，而 Codex 在这些预定义的约束内执行实施和验证，并不断生成进入后续开发工作流程的代码工件. OpenAI Harness Engineering extends this pattern to end-to-end software product development. Engineers define product intent, system architecture, and the rules governing continuous integration, code merging, and rollback, while Codex performs implementation and validation within these predefined constraints and continuously produces code artifacts that enter subsequent development workflowsOpenAI [2026c].

3.2.7 评估 L1 执行自主性Evaluating L1 Execution Autonomy

在这些级别上，L1 系统共享相同的基本能力边界：人工智能可以执行越来越长且相应的改进程序，并且由此产生的工件可能会持续到后续阶段，但控制改进的程序仍然是外部指定的。因此，L1 的评估应考虑两个耦合属性：Across these levels, L1 systems share the same fundamental capability boundary: AI can execute increasingly long and consequential improvement procedures, and the resulting artifacts may persist into subsequent stages, but the procedures governing improvement remain externally specified. Evaluation of L1 should therefore consider two coupled properties:执行可靠性execution reliability，即人工智能在不同条件下能否正确执行规定的程序；和, namely whether AI can correctly carry out the prescribed procedure under varying conditions; and持久性安全persistence safety，即在执行期间引入的错误在其输出传播到后续改进轮之前是否被检测到。, namely whether errors introduced during execution are detected before their outputs propagate into subsequent improvement rounds.

预定义改进程序的可靠性对于评估该级别的执行自主性至关重要。 L1 系统可以在有限的人工干预下完成扩展的动作序列，但其执行仍然受到预先指定的程序的限制。当任务条件超出这些程序所涵盖的范围时，或者当工作流程中嵌入的假设不再成立时，系统无法独立修改改进程序，因此很容易出现执行失败。The reliability of predefined improvement procedures is central to evaluating execution autonomy at this level. L1 systems can complete extended sequences of actions with limited human intervention, but their execution remains bounded by procedures specified in advance. When task conditions fall outside the scope covered by these procedures, or when assumptions embedded in the workflow no longer hold, the system cannot independently revise the improvement procedure and is therefore prone to execution failure.

持续下去会进一步放大此类失败的后果。执行期间产生的输出可以在后续开发阶段保留和重用，从而允许错误传播到引入它们的任务之外并影响后续迭代。因此，评估不仅应该检查预定义的过程是否正确执行，还应该检查生成的工件在进入下游工作流程之前是否仍然有效。Persistence further amplifies the consequences of such failures. Outputs produced during execution can be retained and reused in subsequent development stages, allowing errors to propagate beyond the task in which they were introduced and affect later iterations. Evaluation should therefore examine not only whether predefined procedures are executed correctly, but also whether the resulting artifacts remain valid before entering downstream workflows.

发现：L1 大规模执行人类定义的改进程序。Finding: L1 executes human-defined improvement procedures at scale.人类首先将已建立的工程经验编码为明确的改进步骤和验证规则，而人工智能系统则在具体任务上执行这些预定义的程序。生成的工件将被保留并合并到后续的开发工作流程中，从而允许在独立的任务和开发阶段重复应用相同的改进过程。Humans first encode established engineering experience into explicit improvement steps and validation rules, while AI systems execute these predefined procedures on concrete tasks. The resulting artifacts are retained and incorporated into later development workflows, allowing the same improvement procedures to be repeatedly applied across independent tasks and development stages.

3.3 L2：改进策略的自主权L2: Autonomy over Improvement Strategies

在L2，人工智能系统使用评估反馈来选择改进 干预尝试下一步，而不是仅仅执行规定的 更新。 它提出并测试对目标的更改并保留已接受的 修订，而人类继续指定目标、任务边界和接受标准。 周围的搜索框架可能保持固定；自主权在于决定如何改进目标。 在许多人工智能开发工作流程中，执行提议的变更是相对机械的；困难的部分是决定哪些改变值得尝试。研究人员必须解释失败，推断哪个因素限制了进展，选择效果不确定的干预措施，并在观察结果后决定下一步尝试什么。随着可能的干预空间的增加，这种实验决策成为一个主要瓶颈：详尽的搜索是不可行的，而手动实验则受到研究人员注意力和先验直觉的限制。 L2 系统自动化了这个瓶颈。不仅仅是进行人类指定的修改，At L2, the AI system uses evaluation feedback to choose which improvement intervention to attempt next, rather than merely executing a prescribed update. It proposes and tests changes to the target and retains accepted revisions, while humans continue to specify the objective, task boundary, and acceptance criteria. The surrounding search framework may remain fixed; autonomy lies in determining how the target should be improved. In many AI-development workflows, executing a proposed change is comparatively mechanical; the difficult part is deciding which change is worth trying. Researchers must interpret failures, infer which component is limiting progress, choose an intervention whose effect is uncertain, and decide what to try next after observing the result. As the space of possible interventions grows, this experimental decision-making becomes a major bottleneck: exhaustive search is infeasible, while manual experimentation is constrained by researcher attention and prior intuitions. L2 systems automate this bottleneck. Rather than merely carrying out a human-specified modification, the改良剂improver使用评估结果和实验证据来确定下一个候选干预措施。uses evaluation results and experimental evidence to determine the next candidate intervention.

这种转变越来越类似于实证研究人员角色的部分自动化。例如，OpenAI 将当前的前沿代理描述为达到“自动化研究实习生”阶段，在人类监督下完成明确的研究任务，而研究人员则继续设定优先级并决定哪些结果值得进一步投资或部署This transition increasingly resembles partial automation of the empirical researcher’s role. OpenAI, for example, describes current frontier agents as reaching an “automated research intern” stage for well-defined research tasks under human supervision, while researchers continue to set priorities and decide which results merit further investment or deploymentOpenAI [2026d]。因此，相关的自主权并不是对研究不受限制的控制，而是特定研究责任的转移：将观察到的证据转化为下一个实验。. The relevant autonomy is therefore not unrestricted control of research, but the transfer of a specific research responsibility: turning observed evidence into the next experiment.

该级别的特征环路可以总结如下：The characteristic loop at this level can be summarized as follows:

 观察表现observe performance⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  诊断diagnose⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  选择如何改变select how change ⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  实例化并测试instantiate and test⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  保留或恢复retain or revert⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  重复repeat

正在改进的对象可能保持很小，如在即时优化中，或者扩展到可执行代理并最终扩展为模型训练程序。这些设置中发生的变化是改进者可用的干预对象和范围，以及可用于决定尝试哪种修改的证据。因此，我们通过以下方式组织 L2：The object being improved may remain small, as in prompt optimization, or expand to an executable agent and eventually to a model-training program. What changes across these settings is the object and scope of intervention available to the improver, together with the evidence available for deciding which modification to attempt. We therefore organize L2 by the搜索改进策略的对象object over which improvement strategies are searched，而不是由单个系统。 图, rather than by individual systems. Figure4说明了这一点 策略自治机制，其中有关当前系统的证据 指导如何改进的自主选择和评估。illustrates this strategy-autonomy mechanism, in which evidence about the current system guides the autonomous selection and evaluation of how to improve it.

3.3.1 提示搜索Prompt Search

的The改良剂improver决定如何根据执行跟踪和评估结果更改管理模型或代理的指令。decides how the instructions that govern a model or agent should be changed based on execution traces and evaluation results.在最窄的 L2 设置中，系统决定如何修改提示或文本控制变量，而不是仅仅实例化规定的编辑。例如，Dropbox 使用 GEPA 重写了提示，告诉 LLM 如何判断检索到的文件或消息是否与用户的搜索相关In the narrowest L2 setting, the system decides how a prompt or textual control variable should be revised rather than merely instantiating a prescribed edit. For example, Dropbox used GEPA to rewrite the prompt that tells an LLM how to judge whether retrieved files or messages are relevant to a user’s searchWang and Meyerzon [2026]。 然而，早期的进化方法搜索替代突变，而最近的反射优化器使用执行跟踪来识别故障模式并生成有针对性的修订。 GEPA 将失败归因于特定模块并保留补充的提示变体，而不是立即提交到单个贪婪的谱系. However, earlier evolutionary methods search over alternative mutations, while more recent reflective optimizers use execution traces to identify failure modes and generate targeted revisions. GEPA attributes failures to particular modules and preserves complementary prompt variants rather than committing immediately to a single greedy lineageAgrawal et al. [2026]。这种反馈驱动的搜索并不限于单个优化器设计。 MPO 将可编辑表面扩展到多模式提示，使用评估衍生的语义反馈来指导后续文本和非文本提示候选，而 C-Evolve 将候选生成嵌入固定的进化协议中。在这些设置中，搜索机制可以在外部指定，而具体的提示修改则来自评估反馈。. This feedback-driven search is not restricted to a single optimizer design. MPO extends the editable surface to multimodal prompts, using evaluation-derived semantic feedback to guide subsequent textual and non-textual prompt candidates, while C-Evolve embeds candidate generation within a fixed evolutionary protocol. Across these settings, the search machinery can be externally specified while the concrete prompt revisions emerge from evaluation feedback.Choi et al. [2026], Li et al. [2026c]。 因此，自主权的相关增加并不是即时生成本身，而是对下一步尝试哪种修订策略的控制。. The relevant increase in autonomy is therefore not prompt generation itself, but control over which revision strategy is attempted next.

3.3.2 代理和线束搜索Agent and Harness Search

改进可能涉及重新设计推理和工具使用组件的交互方式。Improvement can involve redesigning how reasoning and tool-using components interact.一旦可编辑对象从提示扩展到可执行代理代码，策略搜索就开始类似于自动化系统设计。例如，Microsoft Foundry 的代理优化器根据评估失败重写了托管代理的系统指令、技能和本地功能工具描述Once the editable object expands from a prompt to executable agent code, strategy search begins to resemble automated system design. For example, Microsoft Foundry’s Agent Optimizer rewrites hosted agents’ system instructions, skills, and local function-tool descriptions from evaluation failuresQuintanilla and Dibia [2026]。 代理系统自动化设计 (ADAS) 将代理形式化为 Python. Automated Design of Agentic Systems (ADAS) formalizes an agent as a Python前进forward函数并使用元代理来填充不断增长的候选代理档案function and uses a meta-agent to populate an ever-growing archive of candidate agentsHu et al. [2025]。在每次迭代中，元代理都会根据验证数据评估候选者，并将其代码和指标存储在存档中。 由于这些决策被编码在可执行的线束代码中，因此单个修订可以更改代理在整个任务中的行为方式，而不仅仅是更改一条指令。. In each iteration, the meta-agent evaluates the candidate on validation data and stores both its code and metrics in the archive. Because these decisions are encoded in executable harness code, a single revision can change how the agent behaves throughout an entire task rather than only changing one instruction.

最近的工作流搜索系统通过设计空间的不同表示来实例化这个想法。 AFlow 将工作流程编码为可执行图，并将蒙特卡洛树搜索应用于连续的代码级修改，使用执行结果作为后续分支的反馈Recent workflow-search systems instantiate this idea through different representations of the design space. AFlow encodes workflows as executable graphs and applies Monte Carlo tree search to successive code-level modifications, using execution outcomes as feedback for later branchesZhang et al. [2025]。 相反，AgentSquare 将代理设计分解为可重复使用的模块，并通过进化和重组进行搜索，从而允许在一种配置中发现的成功结构成为另一种配置的构建块. AgentSquare instead factorizes agent designs into reusable modules and searches through evolution and recombination, allowing successful structures discovered in one configuration to become building blocks for anotherShang et al. [2025].

由此产生的自主性远大于局部参数调整，同时在重要意义上保持有界。改进者在替代代理设计中进行选择，但候选人仍然会得到晋升，因为他们在外部维护的评估过程中表现更好。 L2 自治涉及寻找更好的系统配置；它并不意味着有权重新定义成功绩效的构成。The resulting autonomy is substantially greater than local parameter tuning while remaining bounded in an important sense. The improver chooses among alternative agent designs, yet candidates are still promoted because they perform better under an externally maintained evaluation process. L2 autonomy concerns the search for a better system configuration; it does not imply authority to redefine what constitutes successful performance.

3.3.3 模型和训练搜索Model and Training Search

的The改良剂improver将经验培训证据转化为有关如何配置、构建或优化学习者本身的决策。converts empirical training evidence into decisions about how the learner itself should be configured, structured, or optimized.因此，人类研究人员严重依赖积累的直觉来决定进行可能的实验中的哪一小部分。 L2 改进器的新作用是压缩这个实验周期：检查之前运行中发生的情况，推断改进可能来自何处，并相应地分配下一个实验。当前的系统越来越多地搜索持久配置、模型结构和学习过程本身。Human researchers therefore rely heavily on accumulated intuition to decide which small fraction of the possible experiments to run. The emerging role of an L2 improver is to compress this experimental cycle: inspect what happened in previous runs, infer where improvement is likely to come from, and allocate the next experiment accordingly. Current systems increasingly search over persistent configurations, model structure, and the learning procedure itself.

∙\bullet (1)配置搜索。(1) Configuration Search.它可以自动分配昂贵的训练试验。最近的代理方法越来越多地通过对先前实验的语义推理来增强传统搜索。该系统不会将每次试验视为孤立的黑盒查询，而是可以解释训练结果并使用它们来集中后续探索。例如，NVIDIA 针对训练后 Cosmos 3 的 2026 TAO 工作流程允许编码代理在固定验证目标下调用 LLM 引导的 AutoMLIt automates the allocation of expensive training trials. Recent agentic approaches increasingly augment conventional search with semantic reasoning about previous experiments. Rather than treating each trial as an isolated black-box query, the system can interpret training outcomes and use them to concentrate subsequent exploration. For example, NVIDIA’s 2026 TAO workflow for post-training Cosmos 3 lets a coding agent invoke LLM-guided AutoML under a fixed validation objectiveRodge [2026]。 人类提供模型、任务、数据和所需的指标；系统接管了接下来应该评估哪种配置的大部分重复决策。. The human supplies the model, task, data, and desired metric; the system takes over much of the repeated decision of which configuration should be evaluated next.

∙\bullet (2)架构搜索。(2) Architecture Search.它委托了模型的结构设计，减少了对人工设计的搜索空间的依赖。 基于法学硕士的改进者可以解释经验结果并提出结构性改变，其确切内容事先未列举。 AgentNAS 的出发点是观察到现代 NAS 仍然依赖于手动设计的、特定于任务的搜索空间。它使用 LLM 生成特定于任务的种子架构，然后从该设计中导出结构化搜索空间以用于后续组合搜索It delegates the structural design of the model, reducing reliance on a human-engineered search space. LLM-based improvers can interpret empirical results and propose structural changes whose exact content was not enumerated beforehand. AgentNAS starts from the observation that modern NAS still depends on manually engineered, task-specific search spaces. It uses an LLM to produce a task-specific seed architecture and then derives a structured search space from that design for subsequent combinatorial searchJeong et al. [2026].

∙\bullet (3)训练-规则搜索。(3) Training-Rule Search.的The改良剂improver更改学习模型参数的可执行过程。 目前的前沿人员正在开始自动化这一从假设到实验的步骤。 OpenAI 对 GPT-6 Astra 的 NanoGPT 评估为代理提供了固定的验证目标、一个 H100 和受限的训练设置，但要求代理本身诊断训练瓶颈、修改训练代码、调整其配置并对训练循环进行有用的更改changes the executable procedure by which model parameters are learned. Current frontier agents are beginning to automate this hypothesis-to-experiment step. OpenAI’s NanoGPT evaluation for GPT-6 Astra gives the agent a fixed validation target, one H100, and a constrained training setup, but requires the agent itself to diagnose training bottlenecks, modify the training code, tune its configuration, and make useful changes to the training loopOpenAI [2026b]。 开放的研究环境更直接地暴露了同样的分工。在. Open research environments expose the same division of labor more directly. In自动研究autoresearch，数据管道、评估函数、指标和每次实验的计算预算保持固定，而代理重复编辑训练程序，并仅在受保护的验证指标改善时才保留修改, the data pipeline, evaluation function, metric, and per-experiment compute budget remain fixed, while the agent repeatedly edits the training program and keeps a modification only when the protected validation metric improvesKarpathy [2026a].

∙\bullet (4) 系统和实施搜索。(4) Systems and Implementation Search.的The改良剂improver寻求模型计算的更有效实现，同时正确性和系统级性能仍然受到外部测试的保护。 人工智能可以分析瓶颈、提出实施变更、验证数值正确性、测量实际硬件性能，并使用结果来决定下一步修改哪些内容。 AutoKernel 从分析开始，而不是任意代码生成：它识别具有最大潜在端到端影响的操作，并将代理的实验引导到这些瓶颈。仅在正确性检查和测量 GPU 加速后才接受候选 Triton 或 CUDA 实现searches for a more efficient realization of a model’s computation while correctness and system-level performance remain protected by external tests. AI can profile a bottleneck, propose an implementation change, verify numerical correctness, measure real hardware performance, and use the result to decide what to modify next. AutoKernel begins from profiling rather than arbitrary code generation: it identifies operations with the largest potential end-to-end impact and directs the agent’s experiments toward those bottlenecks. Candidate Triton or CUDA implementations are accepted only after correctness checks and measured GPU speedupsJaber and Jaber [2026].

3.3.4 评估 L2 策略自主性Evaluating L2 Strategy Autonomy

对改进策略的更大自主权本身并不意味着更强的递归自我改进。 L2 系统可能具有非常富有表现力的干预空间，但搜索效率低下，利用其评估器的弱点，或者产生在几次迭代后消失的增益。因此我们将Greater autonomy over improvement strategy does not by itself imply stronger recursive self-improvement. An L2 system may have a very expressive intervention space and nevertheless search it inefficiently, exploit weaknesses in its evaluator, or produce gains that disappear after several iterations. We therefore separate the授予自主权的程度degree of delegated autonomy从from the由此产生的改进过程的质量quality of the resulting improvement process.

这些维度是互补的：只有当反馈可以区分候选者并且搜索过程可以有效地探索该空间时，更广泛的搜索空间才有用。这种组合有助于解释为什么当前的工业系统专注于编码、模型训练和内核优化，其中候选干预措施是可执行的并且可以快速获得反馈。These dimensions are complementary: a broader search space is useful only if feedback can discriminate among candidates and the search process can explore that space efficiently. This combination helps explain why current industrial systems concentrate on coding, model training, and kernel optimization, where candidate interventions are executable and feedback can be obtained rapidly.

同样的自适应搜索循环也会产生特征评估风险。重复的开发集访问会导致基准过度拟合，额外的搜索计算可能会被误认为是算法改进，并且 LLM 评估者可能会分享提案者的盲点。公共自动化研究系统使这些风险具体化：报告的行为包括随机种子挑选、捷径发现以及通过重复评估器查询尝试提取测试标签The same adaptive search loop also creates characteristic evaluation hazards. Repeated development-set access invites benchmark overfitting, additional search compute can be mistaken for algorithmic improvement, and an LLM evaluator may share the proposer’s blind spots. Public automated-research systems make these risks concrete: reported behaviors include random-seed cherry-picking, shortcut discovery, and attempted test-label extraction through repeated evaluator queriesWen et al. [2026]。 一旦基准被自适应地查询，它就有效地成为优化表面的一部分，而不是被动的测量工具。 公司报告的结果仍然是可行性和规模的有用证据，但其出处应明确，并且不应被视为等同于独立重复的实验。. Once a benchmark is queried adaptively, it effectively becomes part of the optimization surface rather than a passive measurement instrument. Company-reported results remain useful evidence of feasibility and scale, but their provenance should be explicit and they should not be treated as equivalent to independently replicated experiments.

发现：L2 将人类的努力从提出个人改进转变为限制对改进的搜索。Finding: L2 shifts human effort from proposing individual improvements to constraining the search for improvements.人类仍然指定目标和接受标准，但不再需要选择每个候选干预措施。这将瓶颈从执行已知的改进转变为搜索可能的改进。The human still specifies the objective and acceptance criterion, but no longer needs to choose each candidate intervention. This changes the bottleneck from executing a known improvement to searching over possible improvements.

3.4 L3：未来学习体验的自主权L3: Autonomy over Future Learning Experience

L3 增加了自主权L3 adds autonomy over接下来要获得什么学习经验what learning experience to acquire next。 L2 涉及如何改进的决策，而额外的自主权 在 L3 中检查涉及学习议程：系统使用以下方面的证据： 它当前的能力、失败和学习历史来确定什么 下一步应该学习。 然后学习改变了后续经验获取的状态 取决于，将经验选择和持续改进联系起来 回合。. Whereas L2 concerns decisions about how to improve, the additional autonomy examined at L3 concerns the learning agenda: the system uses evidence about its current capabilities, failures, and learning history to determine what it should learn from next. Learning then changes the state on which subsequent experience acquisition depends, connecting experience selection and persistent improvement across rounds.

该级别的特征环路可以总结如下：The characteristic loop at this level can be summarized as follows:

 观察学习者状态observe learner state⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  选择学习经历choose learning experience⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  获得经验acquire experience ⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  更新持久状态update persistent state⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  重塑未来体验reshape future experience⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  重复repeat

定义属性是The defining property is学习者制约的未来经验 收购learner-conditioned future experience acquisition。 关于不断发展的学习者的证据必须为以下决定提供依据： 选择、生成或寻求后续学习的经验，以及 由此产生的持久更新必须反馈到以后的采购决策中。 这一决定可以通过单独的课程组成部分或 纳入代理商的政策中。 偶然改变访问状态的策略更新本身并不 表现出对学习议程的自主权。. Evidence about the evolving learner must inform a decision about which experience to select, generate, or seek for subsequent learning, and the resulting persistent update must feed back into later acquisition decisions. This decision may be implemented by a separate curriculum component or integrated into the agent’s policy. A policy update that incidentally changes visited states does not, by itself, demonstrate autonomy over the learning agenda.

经验不需要从头开始产生。 从外部提供的池中反复选择材料可以展示 当选择适应学习者并参与学习时，这种机制 继续循环；单独使用一次性过滤或保留则不然。 同样，目标、评估者、更新程序和管理规则 体验选择可能是人为设计的。 相关的区别是学习者的反馈是否会自动改变 下一个学习议程，无需人工重新设计 每轮。 持久学习可能驻留在模型参数或可重用的外部 状态，包括记忆和技能。Experience need not be generated from scratch. Repeatedly selecting material from an externally supplied pool can exhibit this mechanism when selection adapts to the learner and participates in the continuing loop; one-time filtering or retention alone does not. Likewise, the objective, evaluator, update procedure, and rules governing experience selection may be human-designed. The relevant distinction is whether learner feedback autonomously changes the next learning agenda, without requiring a human to redesign it after each round. Persistent learning may reside in model parameters or reusable external state, including memories and skills.

下面的例子检验了这种体验自主机制 特别的改进循环。 图The examples below examine this experience-autonomy mechanism within particular improvement loops. Figure5说明了这一点的两个代表性实现 反馈结构：自适应任务生成和自我游戏，以及 通过环境互动进行自主实践。 该机制的证据应与其他机制的证据一起解释 分配总体系统级别时层次结构的要求。illustrates two representative realizations of this feedback structure: adaptive task generation and self-play, and autonomous practice through environment interaction. Evidence for this mechanism should be interpreted alongside the other requirements of the hierarchy when assigning an overall system level.

3.4.1 从工业自动化到体验自主From Industrial Automation to Experience Autonomy

现代训练数据管道使许多数据操作自动化， 但仅执行自动化并不能建立体验自主权。Modern training-data pipelines automate many data operations, but execution automation alone does not establish experience autonomy.借鉴此处审查的公开记录的实践Drawing on the publicly documented practices reviewed hereSoldaini et al. [2024], AI et al. [2025], Yang et al. [2025], Abdin et al. [2024], 我们将重复功能分为六个部分：数据源准备， 数据标记、数据选择、数据构建、数据混合和训练 编排和模型反馈诊断。 这些功能不需要形成固定的顺序；他们可以重复出现 预训练、监督微调、偏好优化，以及 强化学习。, we organize recurring functions into six components: data-source preparation, data labeling, data selection, data construction, data mixture and training orchestration, and model-feedback diagnosis. These functions need not form a fixed sequence; they can recur across pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning.

Operations such as ingestion, filtering, and sample generation can be executed at scale once their inputs and acceptance criteria are specifiedSoldaini et al. [2024], Penedo et al. [2024], Yang et al. [2025]。 审查的报告还描述了研究人员定义的选择，涉及 数据政策、生成和混合策略、训练阶段以及 实验评价. The reviewed reports also describe researcher-defined choices concerning data policies, generation and mixture strategies, training stages, and experimental evaluationAI et al. [2025], Penedo et al. [2024], Li et al. [2024]。 这些选择说明了自动化操作之间的区别 并委派有关后续学习议程的决定。. These choices illustrate the distinction between automating an operation and delegating decisions about the subsequent learning agenda.

人为设计的规则并不排除 L3 特定的机制。 固定的选择算法仍然可以产生自适应学习议程 如果它使用不断变化的学习者的反馈来选择后续的经验。 相反，重复生成和过滤数据的自动化管道 仅仅通过生产新样本并不能建立经验自主性。 决定性的证据是学习者状态之间的紧密依赖， 经验获取、持续学习以及后来的获取决策。 这里引用的管道描述记录了实质性的操作 自动化，但它们本身并不能建立这种完全依赖Human-designed rules do not preclude the L3-specific mechanism. A fixed selection algorithm can still produce an adaptive learning agenda if it uses the changing learner’s feedback to choose subsequent experience. Conversely, an automated pipeline that repeatedly generates and filters data does not establish experience autonomy merely by producing new samples. The decisive evidence is a closed dependence between learner state, experience acquisition, persistent learning, and later acquisition decisions. The pipeline descriptions cited here document substantial operational automation, but do not by themselves establish this full dependenceAI et al. [2025], Yang et al. [2025], Abdin et al. [2024]。 这种明显的区别并不意味着工业体系必然 缺乏这样的机制。. This evidential distinction does not imply that industrial systems necessarily lack such mechanisms.

They are complementary organizational views rather than exhaustive or mutually exclusive categories: an interactive agent may also generate its own tasks, and learner-conditioned selection can operate within either pattern or over an existing data pool.
