3.4.2 自适应任务生成和自我游戏Adaptive Task Generation and Self-Play

训练任务的价值随着学习者的进步而变化。The value of a training task changes as the learner improves.固定任务分配不会明确跟踪这种移动能力 前沿：熟悉的任务可能变得无意义，而远远超出的任务 当前的能力可能提供很少的可用学习信号。 自适应生成通过使用学习者依赖来解决这个问题 估计哪些任务可以支持进一步改进的信号。 核心挑战是获取信息信号并将其翻译 转化为有用的任务分配，并保持结果的有效性 经验。A fixed task distribution does not explicitly track this moving competence frontier: familiar tasks may become uninformative, while tasks far beyond current capabilities may provide little usable learning signal. Adaptive generation addresses this problem by using learner-dependent signals to estimate which tasks may support further improvement. The central challenges are to obtain an informative signal, translate it into a useful task distribution, and maintain the validity of the resulting experience.

搜索自玩 (SSP)Search Self-Play (SSP)Lu et al. [2026a]连接前两个 通过使提议者奖励取决于当前求解器的性能来应对挑战。 随着求解器的改变，控制未来搜索的激励也会改变 问题，允许课程不断发展而无需手动重新设计 每个任务批次。 绝对零推理机 (AZR)connects the first two challenges by making proposer rewards depend on current solver performance. As the solver changes, so does the incentive governing future search problems, allowing the curriculum to evolve without manually redesigning each task batch. Absolute Zero Reasoner (AZR)Zhao et al. [2025]情侣求婚和 单个模型中可执行推理任务的解决方案。 其依赖于求解器的可学习性奖励指导任务建议，而代码 执行者验证建议的任务并检查解决方案。 这区分了无约束综合可能合并的两个要求： 经验必须是可评估的，并且其难度必须对 当前的学习者。couples proposal and solution of executable reasoning tasks within a single model. Its solver-dependent learnability reward guides task proposal, while a code executor validates proposed tasks and checks solutions. This separates two requirements that unconstrained synthesis can conflate: experience must be evaluable, and its difficulty must be useful for the current learner.

R-零R-ZeroHuang et al. [2026a]使用挑战者-求解器架构来适应 无需外部提供答案标签即可生成任务。 挑战者的不确定性奖励取决于多个的一致性 当前求解器的响应；因此更新解算器会改变 控制后续任务的信号。 这种基于一致性的数量是模型感知难度的代理， 不是答案正确性或未来学习收获的直接证据。 它在循环中的作用是使经验获取响应于 即使没有更强的正确性信号，学习者也能做到这一点。uses a Challenger–Solver architecture to adapt task generation without externally supplied answer labels. The Challenger’s uncertainty reward depends on the consistency of multiple responses from the current Solver; updates to the Solver therefore alter the signal governing subsequent tasks. This consistency-based quantity is a proxy for model-perceived difficulty, not direct evidence of answer correctness or future learning gain. Its role in the loop is to make experience acquisition responsive to the learner even when stronger correctness signals are unavailable.

正式域提供了获得可靠反馈的替代途径。 直通车Formal domains provide an alternative route to reliable feedback. STPDong and Ma [2025]通过联合开发解决稀疏证明奖励问题 猜想者和证明者。 生成当前证明者只能困难地证明的猜想 为猜想者提供培训材料，同时检查证明改进 证明者。 因此，证明者不断变化的边界重塑了随后的猜想。 证明助手支持形式领域内的正确性检查； 依赖于学习者的选择标准有以下不同目的： 识别有用的训练难度。addresses sparse proof rewards by jointly developing a conjecturer and a prover. Generated conjectures that the current prover can prove only with difficulty provide training material for the conjecturer, while checked proofs improve the prover. The prover’s changing frontier thus reshapes subsequent conjectures. Proof assistants support correctness checking within the formal domain; the learner-dependent selection criterion serves the separate purpose of identifying useful training difficulty.

提出、解决、验证 (PSV)Propose, Solve, Verify (PSV)Wilf et al. [2026]带来了相关机制 验证代码生成。 求解器派生的难度标签附有用于提示新问题的示例 规格。 检查候选规范的可编译性并生成 解决方案在发布之前会根据其规格进行正式检查 用于训练。 这些检查建立了与正式规范相关的属性； 他们不保证该规范表达了有用的任务或 它的解决方案将提高学习者的水平。 事实上，埃因霍温报告称，已实现的困难之间存在大量重叠 问题分为简单、中等和困难，表明 困难条件提案提供部分而非精确 课程控制。brings a related mechanism to verified code generation. Solver-derived difficulty labels accompany examples used to prompt new specifications. Candidate specifications are checked for compilability, and generated solutions are formally checked against their specifications before being used for training. These checks establish properties relative to the formal specification; they do not guarantee that the specification expresses a useful task or that its solution will improve the learner. Indeed, PSV reports substantial overlap between the realized difficulties of problems targeted as easy, medium, and hard, showing that difficulty-conditioned proposal offers partial rather than exact curriculum control.

视玩VisPlayHe et al. [2026a]将这种方法扩展到视觉语言 使用图像条件提问者和推理者进行推理。 发问者收到一个不确定性奖励，该奖励有利于以下问题： 大多数答案的置信度接近规定的中点，并且 阻止重复问题的多样性惩罚。 随着 Reasoner 的变化，其响应一致性会改变奖励 未来的问题生成。 与 R-Zero 一样，生成的信号是可扩展的，但可以反映模糊性 或不一致的答案以及生产困难。extends this approach to vision-language reasoning using an image-conditioned Questioner and a Reasoner. The Questioner receives an uncertainty reward that favors questions whose majority-answer confidence is near the prescribed midpoint, together with a diversity penalty that discourages repetitive questions. As the Reasoner changes, its response consistency changes the reward for future question generation. As in R-Zero, the resulting signal is scalable but can reflect ambiguity or inconsistent answers as well as productive difficulty.

在这些系统中，反馈在两个相连的维度上有所不同。 可执行的结果和正式的证明检查可以保证正确性 在指定的任务设置内，而答案一致性估计 没有独立确定正确性的困难。 适应可能存在于受过训练的提议者或生成提示中， 选择程序以当前学习者的测量为条件。 这些选择权衡了验证范围、反馈成本和敏感性 到不完美的代理。 共同的进步是估计的学习价值影响未来 经验获取和持续学习变化，估计 后面几轮。Across these systems, feedback differs along two connected dimensions. Executable outcomes and formal proof checking can ground correctness within a specified task setting, whereas answer consistency estimates difficulty without independently establishing correctness. Adaptation may reside in a trained proposer or in generation prompts and selection procedures conditioned on current learner measurements. These choices trade off verification scope, feedback cost, and sensitivity to imperfect proxies. The shared advance is that estimated learning value influences future experience acquisition, and persistent learning changes that estimate in later rounds.

3.4.3 通过环境交互进行自主实践Autonomous Practice through Environment Interaction

交互式代理必须决定下一步花在哪里 学习努力。Interactive agents must decide where to spend their next learning effort.单独收集额外的轨迹并不能解决这个问题： 无指导的探索可能会重新审视已掌握的行为，而固定的实践 时间表无法明确响应新获得的技能或持久的技能 失败。 下面的系统将交互反馈与未来的实践目标联系起来， 使用持续学习使后续经验更加敏感 代理人能力的变化。Collecting additional trajectories alone does not resolve this problem: unguided exploration may revisit mastered behaviors, while a fixed practice schedule cannot explicitly respond to newly acquired skills or persistent failures. The systems below connect interaction feedback to future practice objectives, using persistent learning to make subsequent experience more responsive to the agent’s changing capabilities.

航行者号VOYAGERWang et al. [2023]将自动课程与 Minecraft 中可执行技能的持久库。 当前的代理状态和探索历史为新目标提供信息，同时 成功的行为成为以后任务中可重复使用的技能。 这将课程决策与积累的能力结合起来：学习 改变代理可以尝试的内容，并提供进一步的探索 可以从中获得额外技能的经验。 相关的坚持在于外在技能而不是要求 更新底层语言模型的参数。combines an automatic curriculum with a persistent library of executable skills in Minecraft. Current agent state and exploration history inform new objectives, while successful behaviors become reusable skills for later tasks. This couples curriculum decisions to accumulated capability: learning changes what the agent can attempt, and further exploration supplies experience from which additional skills can be acquired. The relevant persistence is in external skills rather than a requirement to update the underlying language model’s parameters.

SIMA 2 team et al. [2025]说明了为什么实验设置 在识别这种机制时很重要。 其固定任务实验证明了自生成的改进 轨迹，但并不能单独建立任务选择的自主权。 在完整的 ASKA 自我完善设置中，取而代之的是基于 Gemini 的任务设置器 使用下游奖励模型评估将练习集中在较弱的技能上。 由此产生的经验可以培训代理，连接能力评估 到后续的练习分配。 相关的自主权属于这个耦合学习系统，包括 它的任务设定者，而不是要求表演模型做每一个 课程决策本身。illustrates why the experimental setting matters when identifying this mechanism. Its fixed-task experiment demonstrates improvement from self-generated trajectories, but does not alone establish autonomy over task selection. In the full ASKA self-improvement setup, a Gemini-based task setter instead uses downstream reward-model evaluations to focus practice on weaker skills. The resulting experience trains the agent, connecting capability assessment to subsequent practice allocation. The relevant autonomy belongs to this coupled learning system, including its task setter, rather than requiring the acting model to make every curriculum decision itself.

SEA代理SEAgentSun et al. [2026c]解决不熟悉软件的练习 通过轨迹评估和课程之间的明确联系 记忆。 世界状态模型提供轨迹判断和GUI描述 课程生成器的状态更改，更新持久的addresses practice in unfamiliar software through an explicit connection between trajectory assessment and curriculum memory. A World State Model supplies trajectory judgments and descriptions of GUI state changes to a Curriculum Generator, which updates a persistent软件指南software guidebook并用它来生成以后的任务。 演员从收集的经验和随后的互动中学习 进一步修订指南和任务集。 因此，该指南包含了早期探索的信息 后来的实践决策，帮助课程扩展到以前的范围 探索运营。and uses it to generate later tasks. The Actor learns from the collected experience, and subsequent interactions further revise the guidebook and task set. The guidebook therefore carries information from earlier exploration into later practice decisions, helping the curriculum expand beyond previously explored operations.

这些系统共享反馈结构，但依赖于不同的持久性 资源和判断。 VOYAGER 将目标与探索历史和可重复使用的技能联系起来； SIMA 2 将奖励模型评估与任务设置联系起来； SEAgent 维护 对指导未来任务的软件行为的不断发展的描述。 因此，技能构建不可靠，奖励判断不准确， 或错误的指南条目都可能会误导以后的学习努力。 自主交互减少了手动指定课程的需要， 同时将反馈的质量和积累的状态作为核心 环路的可靠性。These systems share a feedback structure but depend on different persistent resources and judgments. VOYAGER links objectives to exploration history and reusable skills; SIMA 2 connects reward-model assessments to task setting; SEAgent maintains an evolving account of software behavior that guides future tasks. Consequently, unreliable skill construction, inaccurate reward judgments, or erroneous guidebook entries can each misdirect later learning effort. Autonomous interaction reduces the need for manually prescribed curricula, while leaving the quality of feedback and accumulated state central to the reliability of the loop.

3.4.4 评估 L3 体验自主性Evaluating L3 Experience Autonomy

体验自主性和学习质量是截然不同的。 系统可以控制其未来的学习议程并获取经验 信息贫乏、狭隘或评估不正确。 因此，评估应建立反馈机制和 使用它的好处：哪些学习者信号影响习得，什么 持久状态通过学习发生变化，以及这种变化如何影响 后来的收购决定。Experience autonomy and learning quality are distinct. A system may control its future learning agenda yet acquire experience that is uninformative, narrow, or incorrectly evaluated. Assessment should therefore establish both the feedback mechanism and the benefit of using it: which learner signal influences acquisition, what persistent state changes through learning, and how that change affects a later acquisition decision.

为了评估学习者调节的贡献，有用的控制包括 尽早冻结习得机制的学习者状态输入 检查点，或用独立于学习者的决策替换自适应决策 时间表。 比较应匹配对数据源和环境的访问以及使用 可比较的计算和交互预算，包括体验成本 生成和评估。 保持获取的样本相同将消除非常分布的 适应研究中。 这些控件有助于区分自适应体验获取的价值 改进仅归因于额外的培训资源。To assess the contribution of learner conditioning, useful controls include freezing the acquisition mechanism’s learner-state input at an earlier checkpoint, or replacing adaptive decisions with a learner-independent schedule. Comparisons should match access to data sources and environments and use comparable compute and interaction budgets, including the cost of experience generation and assessment. Holding the acquired samples identical would remove the very distributional adaptation under study. These controls help separate the value of adaptive experience acquisition from improvement attributable to additional training resources alone.

评价还要区分正确性、难度、学习性 好处。 正式或可执行的检查可以在其内部建立指定的属性 支持设置，同时一致性度量和基于模型的判断 提供错误的估计。 单独验证的正确性和估计的难度都不能确定 边际学习价值。 在可行的情况下，研究应将采集信号与独立的信号进行比较 有效性检查、实现的任务难度以及随后的学习收益， 并检查这些关系是否随着学习者的变化而保持稳定。Evaluation should also distinguish correctness, difficulty, and learning benefit. Formal or executable checks can establish specified properties within their supported setting, while consistency measures and model-based judgments provide fallible estimates. Neither verified correctness nor estimated difficulty alone establishes marginal learning value. Where feasible, studies should compare acquisition signals with independent validity checks, realized task difficulty, and subsequent learning gains, and examine whether these relationships remain stable as the learner changes.

我们使用We use经历腐败experience corruption表示有缺陷的风险 经验或反馈会扭曲后来的学习和习得决策。 具有误导性的难度代理可能会偏向于不合适的任务；一个不准确的 法官可能会奖励错误的行为；持久内存可能携带不正确的 未来实践中的假设。 因为这些影响可以输入参数、技能、记忆或课程 状态，它们可能会跨轮传播。 这是反馈循环的结构性风险，而不是断言 每个系统都表现出这样的放大作用。to denote the risk that defective experience or feedback distorts later learning and acquisition decisions. A misleading difficulty proxy may favor unsuitable tasks; an inaccurate judge may reward erroneous behavior; persistent memory may carry incorrect assumptions into future practice. Because these effects can enter parameters, skills, memories, or curriculum state, they may propagate across rounds. This is a structural risk of the feedback loop, rather than an assertion that every system exhibits such amplification.

因此，可信的评估应该跟踪多个方面的绩效 轮次，所获得经验的有效性和多样性，以及转移到 新的任务或环境。 用于指导课程的反馈必须与受保护的反馈区分开来。 用于评估泛化性的评估：重复访问测试实例 通过任务选择、奖励构建或持久记忆可以 它们是学习过程的一部分。 对于任务生成系统，评估应检查课程是否 继续跟踪学习者，而不会陷入狭窄或容易陷入困境 奖励的例子。 对于交互系统，应该检查实践是否持续 获得超出熟悉行为的有用技能。A credible evaluation should therefore track performance across multiple rounds, the validity and diversity of acquired experience, and transfer to fresh tasks or environments. Feedback used to guide the curriculum must be distinguished from protected evaluation used to assess generalization: repeated access to test instances through task selection, reward construction, or persistent memory can make them part of the learning process. For task-generation systems, evaluation should examine whether the curriculum continues to track the learner without collapsing onto narrow or easily rewarded examples. For interactive systems, it should examine whether practice continues to acquire useful skills beyond familiar behaviors.

发现：L3 增加了对未来学习议程的自主权。Finding: L3 adds autonomy over the future learning agenda.系统利用其不断发展的功能、故障或学习历史来 引导接下来选择、生成或寻求哪种体验，并持续下去 学习会反馈到以后的收购决策中。 人为设计的目标、评估者和学习规则可能仍然存在 地点；体验自主权涉及在此环境下做出的决策， 并且本身并不保证有用或可靠的改进。The system uses its evolving capabilities, failures, or learning history to steer which experience is selected, generated, or sought next, and persistent learning feeds back into later acquisition decisions. Human-designed objectives, evaluators, and learning rules may remain in place; experience autonomy concerns decisions made within this setting, and does not itself guarantee useful or reliable improvement.

3.5 L4：部署自主和环境适应L4: Autonomy in Deployment and Environmental Adaptation

在 L4，人工智能使用持续部署交互的反馈来做出决定 运营代理应如何持续适应。 L3 的重点是获得学习所需的经验，而 L4 的重点是 关于操作经验如何改变记忆、技能或执行力 后续任务中使用的组件。 保留的变化塑造了以后的行为和可用的反馈 进一步适应。 目标、访问边界、受保护的评估和权限 后续释放仍受外部管理。 图At L4, AI uses feedback from continued deployment interaction to decide how the operating agent should persistently adapt. Whereas L3 centers on what experience to acquire for learning, L4 centers on how operational experience changes the memory, skills, or execution components used in subsequent tasks. Retained changes shape later behavior and the feedback available for further adaptation. The objective, access boundaries, protected evaluation, and authority over consequential releases remain externally governed. Figure7提供了此部署适应的概述 机制，展示交互体验如何转化为持久的 影响后续行为的改变。provides an overview of this deployment-adaptation mechanism, showing how interaction experience is converted into persistent changes that shape subsequent behavior.

该级别的特征环路可以总结如下：The characteristic loop at this level can be summarized as follows:

 观察部署交互observe deployment interaction⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  提出持续的适应propose persistent adaptation⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  修改代理组件revise agent components ⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  验证并保留validate and retain⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  在以后的任务中重用reuse in later tasks⟶\;\longrightarrow\;  收集新的反馈并重复collect new feedback and repeat

我们围绕轨迹蒸馏、迭代来组织讨论 修改代理系统，选择性保留和部署 更新。这些机制的不同之处在于它们改变的内容，当改变发生时 重复使用，以及如何建立持续有用性。 表We organize the discussion around trajectory distillation, iterative revision of the agent system, and selective retention and deployment of updates. These mechanisms differ in what they change, when the change is reused, and how continued usefulness is established. Table6总结代表性方法 沿着这三个轴。summarizes representative methods along these three axes.

3.5.1 轨迹蒸馏Trajectory distillation

轨迹蒸馏将代理的交互历史转换为紧凑的工件，这些工件在会话中持续存在并影响后续任务。Trajectory distillation converts an agent’s interaction histories into compact artifacts that persist across sessions and condition later tasks.与原始轨迹相比，提炼的工件更加简洁，查询成本更低，并且结构更易于在后续任务中重用。Compared with raw trajectories, distilled artifacts are more concise, less costly to consult, and structured for easier reuse in subsequent tasks.我们按照提炼工件的形式对以下方法进行分组：文本经验记忆、结构化记忆、程序技能库和可执行代码。We group the methods below by the form of the distilled artifact: textual experience memory, structured memory, procedural skill libraries, and executable code.

文本体验记忆。Textual experience memory.此类别将提取的工件保留为自然语言段落，这些段落将被检索到提示中以供后续任务使用。动态备忘单This category keeps the distilled artifact as natural-language passages that are retrieved into the prompt for later tasks. Dynamic CheatsheetSuzgun et al. [2026]使冻结模型能够改进一系列相关问题，而无需访问真实标签。它维护了一个关于策略、代码片段和已知陷阱的单一不断演变的注释，同一模型在回答每个传入问题时都会参考这些注释，并通过添加精炼的课程和删除被取代的条目来进行管理。代理上下文工程enables a frozen model to improve across a series of related problems without access to ground-truth labels. It maintains a single evolving note of strategies, code snippets, and known pitfalls, which the same model consults when answering each incoming problem and curates by adding distilled lessons and removing superseded entries. Agentic Context EngineeringZhang et al. [2026d]遵循相同的方法，同时随着记忆的增长保持详细和信息丰富。它存储带有计数器的简短条目，记录每个条目是否有助于或阻碍后续任务，并添加小补丁而不是重写整个笔记，从而避免了压缩造成的信息丢失。推理银行follows the same recipe while keeping the memory detailed and informative as it grows. It stores short entries with counters that record whether each entry helps or hinders later tasks, and adds small patches rather than rewriting the whole note, which avoids information loss by compression. ReasoningBankOuyang et al. [2026]将这个想法应用到多步智能体中，并通过将每个判断的轨迹提炼成一个简短的、有标题的策略，在后续任务之前检索该策略，从失败中学习，就像从成功中学习一样。adapts the idea to multi-step agents and learns from failures as much as from successes by distilling each judged trajectory into a short, titled strategy that is retrieved before later tasks.

结构化记忆。Structured memory.结构化内存不是自由文本，而是将经验存储在显式记录或图表中，从而使重用的条件变得可检查。尖峰Instead of free text, structured memory stores experience in explicit records or graphs, making the conditions for reuse inspectable. APEXLi et al. [2026e]通过构建战略图作为由先决关系链接的任务里程碑图，鼓励智能体随着记忆的增长探索新策略，而不是让它适应熟悉的例程。每个情节结束后，结果都会沿着导致它的里程碑传播回来，因此地图会记录哪些路径有效。一个单独的步骤添加了智能体尚未尝试过的有希望的分支，并且智能体在规划时查阅地图以在已知的良好路径和未尝试过的路径之间进行选择。其他结构反映了环境。例如，角色代理encourages an agent to explore new strategies as its memory grows rather than letting it settle into familiar routines by building a strategy map as a graph of task milestones linked by prerequisite relations. After each episode, the outcome is propagated back along the milestones that led to it, so the map records which paths have worked. A separate step adds promising branches that the agent has not tried, and the agent consults the map at planning time to choose between a known good path and an untried one. Other structures mirror the environment. For instance, PersonaAgentZhang et al. [2026e]和PAHFand PAHFLiang et al. [2026]相反，围绕单个用户组织内存。 PersonaAgent 将情景和语义用户记忆转换为每个用户角色提示，而 PAHF 在未找到相关偏好时要求用户澄清不明确的请求，从而修改偏好条目，然后将他们的反馈集成到记忆中并修改过时的条目。内存工具代理instead organize memory around individual users. PersonaAgent translates episodic and semantic user memory into a per-user persona prompt, while PAHF revises preference entries by asking users to clarify an ambiguous request when no relevant preference is found, then integrates their feedback into memory and revises outdated entries. MemToolAgentEr et al. [2026]通过存储对失败的工具调用的批评并调整每次调用检索的条目数，使内存发挥更具程序性的作用。gives memory a more procedural role by storing critiques of failed tool calls and adjusting how many entries it retrieves per call.

程序技能库。Procedural skill libraries.该类别不仅仅描述经验，而是提取后来的代理直接遵循的可重用技能或标准操作程序。追踪技能Instead of only describing experience, this category extracts reusable skills or standard operating procedures that a later agent follows directly. Trace2SkillNi et al. [2026]将个人轨迹的经验教训转化为其他模型和任务可以重用的技能。它首先在域任务上推出冻结代理。两个分析师角色，一个专注于错误，另一个专注于成功，然后读取轨迹并提出技能编辑，这些编辑将分阶段合并到便携式技能目录中。由于合并的文档是直接读取的，而不是针对每个情节进行检索，因此后来的代理将其作为指令的一部分加载一次。练习turns lessons from individual trajectories into skills that other models and tasks can reuse. It first rolls out a frozen agent on domain tasks. Two analyst roles, one focused on errors and the other on successes, then read the trajectories and propose skill edits, which are merged in stages into a portable skill directory. Because the consolidated document is read directly rather than retrieved for each episode, later agents load it once as part of their instructions. PRACTICEBai et al. [2026]对具体代理应用相同的离线蒸馏，同时保持技能库在变化时保持一致，而不是无限制地增长，其中可训练的技能学习者建议进行批量编辑，以添加、细化、合并或删除条目。学习者首先从预言轨迹中学习基本技能生成和库维护，然后通过对比同一任务上不同执行者的成功和失败轨迹来学习失败意识，最后根据自己的编辑分布提炼出更强的老师。另外两种方法在执行过程中获得技能。潘多applies the same offline distillation to embodied agents while keeping the skill library consistent as it changes rather than growing unbounded, where a trainable skill learner proposes batch edits that add, refine, merge, or remove entries. The learner first learns basic skill generation and library maintenance from oracle trajectories, then learns failure awareness by contrasting successful and failed trajectories from different executors on the same tasks, and is finally distilled toward a stronger teacher on its own edit distribution. Two other methods acquire skills during execution. PANDOLi et al. [2026f]通过提炼防止重复失败的规则和替换部署期间每次推出的多步骤浏览器子目标的参数化例程，改进部署期间的 Web 代理，而 PILOTimproves a web agent during deployment by distilling rules that prevent repeated failures and parameterized routines that replace multi-step browser subgoals from each rollout during deployment, while PILOTXiao et al. [2026c]使用主管从长期的实时运行中提炼出程序和故障模式，因此后面的课程从积累的技能开始。uses a supervisor to distill procedures and failure modes from a live, long-horizon run, so later sessions start with the accumulated skills.

可执行的工件。Executable artifacts.从文本到代码，该类别将经验编译成可直接调用的工件，将文本内存的灵活性与可执行工具的效率结合起来。梅蒂斯Moving from text to code, this category compiles experience into artifacts that are invoked directly, combining the flexibility of text memory with the efficiency of executable tools. MetisDai et al. [2026]通过双存储器、计划、环境事实和陷阱的文本存储以及可调用工具的代码库来实现这一点。反射器维护文本条目，经常重用的文本计划被重写为可调用工具，并且只有在沙箱中正确编译和运行后才被接受。然后检索涵盖文本条目和工具描述。 Evo-安全带achieves this through a dual memory, a text store of plans, environment facts, and pitfalls alongside a code library of callable tools. A reflector maintains the text entries, and a frequently reused text plan is rewritten as a callable tool and accepted only after it compiles and runs correctly in a sandbox. Retrieval then covers both text entries and tool descriptions. Evo-HarnessWei et al. [2026a]将目标从单一工具扩大到整个工具，将失败或负面评估任务的经验教训汇编成跨任务模式和特定于任务的程序。塑造者broadens the target from single tools to the whole harness, compiling lessons from failed or negatively evaluated tasks into cross-task patterns and task-specific procedures. SHAPERWang et al. [2026a]通过发展文本规划指导以及选择向规划者显示的上下文的沙盒 Python 函数，将相同的想法应用于具体代理。applies the same idea to embodied agents by evolving textual planning guidance together with a sandboxed Python function that selects the context shown to the planner.

评估协议。Evaluation protocols.该家庭的评估方案在时间范围和效益方面有所不同。进化记忆Evaluation protocols for this family differ in time horizon and in what they count as benefit. Evo-MemoryWei et al. [2025b]将数据集重组为顺序任务流，以便可以长期测量内存积累和重用。潘多restructures datasets into sequential task streams so that memory accumulation and reuse can be measured over long horizons. PANDOLi et al. [2026f]相反，审计运行中的行为，报告操作重复、步骤开销和提示缓存利用率，以及 Metisinstead audits behavior within a run, reporting action repetition, step overhead, and prompt-cache utilization, and MetisDai et al. [2026]将任务质量与执行和施工成本联系起来。relates task quality to execution and construction cost.

3.5.2 代理系统迭代改版Iterative revision of the agent system

这一部分不是修改智能体记忆的内容，而是修改智能体系统本身：产生解决方案的技能、判断解决方案的标准、运行解决方案的安全带或下面的权重。决定性的问题是哪些组件可能会发生变化以及哪些验收标准在变化时保持不变。我们将工作分为共同进化耦合组件、衡量自我导向系统修订的基准以及固定验证者下的进化搜索，然后分析修订是否转化为效益。Rather than what an agent remembers, this section revises the agent system itself: the skills that produce solutions, the rubrics that judge them, the harness that runs them, or the weights underneath. The defining question is which components may change and which acceptance criteria stay fixed while they do. We group the work into co-evolving coupled components, benchmarks that measure self-directed system revision, and evolutionary search under fixed verifiers, followed by analyses of whether revision translates into benefit.

共同进化的组件。Co-evolving components.协同进化同时修改两个耦合组件，这引发了循环问题：如果判断器与求解器一起改进，则更高的分数可能反映更容易的判断而不是更好的解决方案。德科埃沃Co-evolution revises two coupled components at once, which raises a circularity problem: if the judge improves alongside the solver, higher scores may reflect an easier judge rather than better solutions. DecoEvoChen et al. [2026a]通过在文本空间中发展求解器技能和评分标准生成器技能来解决这个问题，同时解耦它们的目标并在优化期间保留黄金评分标准。求解器技能根据标准级别的反馈进行更新。相比之下，评分标准生成器由两个与分数无关的审核控制：结构审核检查生成的评分标准是否涵盖任务的要求，对比审核检查它是否区分接近平局的响应，并在两者之间进行帕累托验证。由于生成器永远看不到求解器的总分，因此它无法通过简化评分标准来提高其排名。addresses this problem by evolving a solver skill and a rubric-generator skill in text space while decoupling their objectives and withholding gold rubrics during optimization. The solver skill is updated from criterion-level rubric feedback. The rubric generator, in contrast, is gated by two score-independent audits: a structural audit checks that the generated rubric covers the task’s requirements, and a contrastive audit checks that it discriminates between near-tie responses, with Pareto verification across the two. Because the generator never sees the solver’s aggregate score, it cannot improve its standing by making the rubric easier.

自我指导修订的基准。Benchmarks of self-directed revision.这项工作不是提出新方法，而是衡量当前模型是否可以修改自己的系统。线束开发Rather than proposing new methods, this line of work measures whether current models can revise their own systems at all. HarnessDevWu et al. [2026a]询问模型是否可以创建和改进自己的工具、提示、工具循环和执行逻辑的模型外部支架。创建者代理从最小的种子和一些开发案例构建完整的工具，并根据下游反馈对其进行迭代修改。候选修订版被冻结，并在隐藏任务上对成功率和执行者令牌成本进行评分，创建者和执行者保持分离，以便可以在一个固定执行者下比较工具。渴望asks whether models can create and improve their own harness, the model-external scaffolding of prompts, tool loops, and execution logic. The creator agent builds a complete harness from a minimal seed and a few development cases and iteratively revises it from downstream feedback. The candidate revisions are frozen and scored on hidden tasks for both success rate and executor-token cost, with the creator and the executor kept separate so that harnesses can be compared under one fixed executor. ASPIREWu et al. [2026b]询问模型是否可以在仅给出模糊目标的情况下自我改进。它将数据、更新方法和验证信号的选择委托给权重和线束上的代理，并且分数门控控制器会回滚任何经过验证的分数没有提高的更改。 S3健身房asks whether a model can improve itself given only a vague goal. It delegates the choice of data, update method, and validation signal to the agent across both weights and the harness, and a score-gated controller rolls back any change whose verified score does not improve. S3GymShi et al. [2026a]将问题限制在经验通道上，保留验证者的结果，因此代理必须判断自己的轨迹，并比较原始历史、压缩摘要和参数训练作为改进途径。restricts the question to the experience channel, withholding verifier outcomes so the agent must judge its own trajectories, and compares raw history, compressed summaries, and parameter training as improvement pathways.

修订效益分析。Analyses of revision benefit.修订是否真正转化为效益本身就是一个问题，一项分析发现两者经常被混为一谈。安全带更新背后的研究并不是安全带效益Whether revision actually translates into benefit is a question in its own right, and one analysis finds that the two are often conflated. The study behind Harness Updating Is Not Harness BenefitLin et al. [2026c]区分两种功能：生成有用的持久更新，并在求解时利用它们。每个都是在固定的解决-演化协议下进行测量的，在多个模型主干和三个代理基准上具有相同的提示和预算。更新能力在很大程度上独立于基础模型能力，小型模型的更新所产生的收益与前沿模型的收益相当。相比之下，从更新的工具中受益的能力是非单调变化的，并且失败集中在两种模式：相关工件没有被激活，或者它们被激活但没有忠实地遵循。一个实际的结果是，能力投资属于任务解决者而不是进化者。separates two capabilities: producing useful persistent updates, and exploiting them at solve time. Each is measured under a fixed solve-evolve protocol with identical prompts and budgets across several model backbones and three agent benchmarks. Updating ability is largely independent of base model capability, with a small model’s updates yielding gains comparable to a frontier model’s. The ability to benefit from an updated harness, by contrast, varies non-monotonically, and failures concentrate in two modes: relevant artifacts are not activated, or they are activated but not faithfully followed. A practical consequence is that capability investment belongs in the task-solving agent rather than in the evolver.

3.5.3 选择性保留和部署更新Selective retention and deployment of updates

轨迹精炼和系统修订都以提议的更改结束，而本节重点介绍哪些提议的更改会持久存在以及哪些对以后的任务可用。下面的工作在三个点应用这种控制：进入之前、继续使用期间以及释放到操作系统中时。Trajectory distillation and system revision both end with a proposed change, while this section focuses on which proposed changes become persistent and which stay available to later tasks. The work below applies this control at three points: before admission, during continued use, and at release into an operational system.

候选人验证。Candidate validation.提议的更新必须产生证据才能进入持久状态。 HDSOA proposed update must produce evidence before it can enter the persistent state. HDSOShang and Yang [2026]旨在防止从嘈杂的轨迹中提取的技能编码执行者无法遵循的虚假快捷方式或规则。策展人模型观察紧凑的执行器轨迹，并提出具有明确验证计划的假设，其中通过执行相同的任务两次来测试每个候选者，一次使用当前批准的存储库作为对照，一次使用添加的候选者技能作为处理，只有当两次运行之间的差异支持假设时，候选者才进入批准的存储库。比较以增加规模的阶段进行，并以对独立任务的确认结束。梅蒂斯is designed to prevent skills distilled from noisy trajectories from encoding spurious shortcuts or rules that the executor cannot follow. A curator model observes compact executor traces and proposes a hypothesis with an explicit validation plan, where each candidate is tested by executing the same tasks twice, once with the current approved repository as the control and once with the candidate skill added as the treatment, and the candidate enters the approved repository only when the differences between the two runs support the hypothesis. The comparison runs in stages of increasing size and ends with confirmation on independent tasks. MetisDai et al. [2026]，在轨迹蒸馏部分前面介绍过，在文本计划已保留在内存中之后应用类似的门，其中文本计划仅在跨任务重复并通过依赖性和编译检查后才成为可执行代码。, introduced earlier in the trajectory-distillation section, applies a similar gate after the text plan is already retained in memory, where a text plan becomes executable code only after it recurs across tasks and passes dependency and compilation checks.

图书馆维护。Library maintenance.入院后，人们的注意力转移到图书馆本身的健康状况上，因为曾经有用的技能可能会随着任务和模型的变化而退化。图书馆漂移研究After admission, attention shifts to the health of the library itself, since skills that were once useful can degrade as tasks and models change. The Library Drift studyZhang et al. [2026f]表明无限制的积累会逐渐降低检索质量并阻碍进度，通常是在任务分数中效果变得明显之前。它提出了由三个部分组成的生命周期管理。仅附加证据日志跟踪每项技能对任务结果的贡献，并且当其测量的贡献消失时，技能将被淘汰。活跃技能的数量是有上限的，因此新技能会与现有的条目竞争。新技能也是在元技能下编写的，元技能是一种存储的指南，指导如何编写未来的技能。研究表明，治理选择很重要：过于激进地淘汰技能比让图书馆不受指导更糟糕。与此同时，另一项分析shows that unbounded accumulation gradually degrades retrieval quality and stalls progress, often before the effect becomes visible in task scores. It proposes lifecycle management with three parts. An append-only evidence log tracks each skill’s contribution to task outcomes, and a skill is retired when its measured contribution fades. The number of active skills is capped, so a new skill competes with the entries already present. New skills are also written under a meta-skill, a stored guide that steers how future skills are authored. The study shows that governance choices matter: retiring skills too aggressively performs worse than leaving the library unguided. Meanwhile, another analysisLiu et al. [2026e]研究发现，仔细过滤技能编辑，而不是根据任务结果反复重写技能，可以提高任务绩效。finds that carefully filtering skill edits, rather than repeatedly rewriting skills from task outcomes, improves task performance.

受控部署。Governed deployment.在生产中，不正确的更新可能会影响真实用户，因此需要严格的控制来防止意外问题。税务人工智能部署In production, an incorrect update can affect real users, so a strict gate is needed to prevent unexpected issues. The Tax AI deploymentOpenAI and Thrive Holdings [2026]在生产税准备系统中应用这样一个门，从业者的纠正可以推动改进。纠正被记录为结构化的现场证据，重复的失败被分组为评估目标。编码代理调查跟踪、评估和存储库，以针对目标和回归评估实施和验证修复。该循环可能仅更改产品的有限部分，例如提取模式、源选择、税收引擎映射器和分级器。工程师保留有关架构和产品设计的决策。每个修复都作为发布前工程审查的拉取请求到达，代理无法解决的案例将被路由回从业人员。因此，人类做出最终的接受决定，而这次审查带来的延迟是环路运营成本的一部分。applies such a gate inside a production tax-preparation system, where practitioner corrections drive improvement. Corrections are recorded as structured field-level evidence, and repeated failures are grouped into evaluation targets. A coding agent investigates the trace, evaluations, and repository to implement and validate a fix against targeted and regression evaluations. The loop may change only a bounded part of the product, such as the extraction schema, source selection, tax-engine mapper, and graders. Engineers retain decisions about architecture and product design. Each fix arrives as a pull request for engineering review before release, and cases that the agent cannot resolve are routed back to practitioners. Humans therefore make the final acceptance decision, and the delay introduced by this review is part of the loop’s operating cost.

3.5.4 评估 L4 部署自主性Evaluating L4 Deployment Autonomy

部署后更大的适应自主权本身并不能带来可靠的改进。 L4 系统可能会保留更新，但不会表明它们在任务、环境或执行者发生变化时仍然有用。评估应区分部署自主程度和最终适应过程的质量。Greater autonomy over adaptation after deployment does not by itself establish reliable improvement. An L4 system may retain updates without showing that they remain useful as tasks, environments, or executors change. Evaluation should distinguish the degree of deployment autonomy from the quality of the resulting adaptation process.

此级别的典型风险是持续更新失败，其中接受的更改可能会在其弱点变得明显之前影响许多后续决策。在不同形式的保留状态中，可能会出现失败，因为系统从嘈杂的证据中推断出错误的教训，在其有效范围之外应用合理的教训，未能调用相关更新，或者以牺牲早期功能为代价保留新行为A characteristic risk at this level is persistent update failure, where an accepted change may affect many later decisions before its weakness becomes visible. Across different forms of retained state, failure may arise because the system infers the wrong lesson from noisy evidence, applies a sound lesson outside its valid scope, fails to invoke a relevant update, or preserves new behavior at the expense of earlier capabilitiesSuzgun et al. [2026], Zhang et al. [2026f], Liu et al. [2026e], Lin et al. [2026c]。仅最终任务分数无法区分这些机制。可信的评估必须将每个保留的变更与产生它的证据、其后来的使用及其对新任务和先前解决的任务的影响联系起来。. Final task scores alone cannot separate these mechanisms. A credible evaluation must connect each retained change to the evidence that produced it, its later use, and its effects on both new and previously solved tasks.

目前的证据对于部署适应是否随着时间的推移仍然有效留下了进一步的不确定性。大多数评估涵盖有限的任务流和模型、任务和环境的有限组合，而重复评估使得更长的研究成本高昂The current evidence leaves further uncertainty about whether deployment adaptation remains effective over time. Most evaluations cover bounded task streams and limited combinations of models, tasks, and environments, while repeated assessment makes longer studies costlyNi et al. [2026], Xiao et al. [2026c], Wu et al. [2026a]。反馈也可能不完整或对循环来说是内生的，因为结果标签可能有噪音，评估者可能会随着系统的变化而变化，并且有用的保留工件可能仍然无法影响执行. Feedback may also be incomplete or endogenous to the loop, as outcome labels can be noisy, evaluators can change with the system, and a useful retained artifact may still fail to influence executionOuyang et al. [2026], Chen et al. [2026a], Lin et al. [2026c]。因此，L4 的评估应该检查跨时间和分布变化的适应，包括保留的变化改变后来行为的点。. Evaluation of L4 should consequently examine adaptation across time and distribution shifts, including the point at which a retained change alters later behavior.

L4 自治仍然受到周围部署过程的限制。代理可以决定交互证据如何改变持久状态，而人类则继续指定目标、访问边界、受保护的评估和发布权限。 L4 应该关注已部署系统内操作适应的自主权。L4 autonomy remains bounded by the surrounding deployment process. The agent may decide how interaction evidence changes persistent state, while humans continue to specify the objective, access boundaries, protected evaluation, and release authority. L4 should concern autonomy over operational adaptation within a deployed system.

发现：L4 将自主权从选择经验转变为决定经验的哪些后果在部署中持续存在。Finding: L4 shifts autonomy from selecting experience to deciding which consequences of experience persist in deployment.代理将交互历史记录转换为对记忆、技能、线束、代码或模型参数的保留更改，这些更改会影响以后的任务和反馈。人类保留客观的、受保护的接受标准、访问边界以及对后续发布的最终权力。The agent converts interaction histories into retained changes to memory, skills, harnesses, code, or model parameters, and these changes affect later tasks and feedback. Humans retain the objective, protected acceptance criteria, access boundaries, and final authority over consequential releases.

3.6 L5：从环境适应到元改进L5: From Environmental Adaptation to Meta-Improvement

改进过程本身就可能成为瓶颈。编码代理可能会重复生成类似的不成功补丁，因为其搜索过程丢弃了有用的替代方案。研究代理可以在发展分数停止预测外部表现之后优化该分数。修复此类故障需要改变指导实验和判断结果的程序。设计这些程序的成本很高：必须通过其产生的后续改进来评估修订，通常需要跨多个任务和重复运行An improvement process can become a bottleneck in its own right. A coding agent may repeatedly generate similar unsuccessful patches because its search procedure discards useful alternatives. A research agent may optimize a development score after that score has stopped predicting external performance. Repairing such failures requires changes to the procedures that direct experiments and judge their outcomes. Designing these procedures is costly: a revision must be assessed through the later improvements it produces, often across several tasks and repeated runsZelikman et al. [2024], Shi et al. [2026b].

当人工智能持续修改负责未来改进的机制并在后续回合中使用修改后的机制时，L5 就开始了。L5 begins when AI persistently modifies a mechanism responsible for future improvements and uses the revised mechanism in subsequent rounds.可编辑机制可以是改进器、后继评估器、搜索策略或指导研究的程序。 L2 搜索候选干预措施； L3决定获得什么经验； L4 将部署反馈纳入持续适应中。 L5还使管理后续改进的程序成为改进的对象。已部署的代理通过不变的学习过程保留新的调试技能就是 L4 的例子。修改和重用诊断故障并培养这些技能的过程可以跨越 L5 边界。The editable mechanism may be an improver, a successor evaluator, a search policy, or a procedure for directing research. L2 searches for candidate interventions; L3 determines what experience to acquire; L4 incorporates deployment feedback into persistent adaptation. L5 additionally makes the procedure governing later improvement an object of improvement. A deployed agent that retains new debugging skills through an unchanged learning procedure exemplifies L4. Revising and reusing the procedure that diagnoses failures and builds those skills can cross the L5 boundary.

当修订后的机制返回来管理后来继任者的生成、评估或选择时，循环就结束了。继承的状态包括已接受的代码、提示、评估器或研究策略，以及后续修订所使用的证据。人类设计师仍然建立总体任务、受保护的评估、可编辑组件和资源权限，并可能保留否决权和部署权限。其中一些决定是由固定基础设施执行的；他们不需要人批准每次迭代。数字The loop closes when a revised mechanism returns to govern the generation, evaluation, or selection of later successors. The inherited state includes the accepted code, prompts, evaluators, or research policy, together with evidence used by later revisions. Human designers still establish the overall mission, protected evaluation, editable components, and resource permissions, and may retain veto and deployment authority. Some of these decisions are enforced by fixed infrastructure; they do not require a person to approve every iteration. Figure8说明了早期尝试的证据如何指导改进过程的修订，然后继任者继承并重用该改进过程。illustrates how evidence from earlier attempts can guide a revision of the improvement process, which successors then inherit and reuse.

这些条件区分These conditions distinguish结构L5structural L5，这表明人工智能主导的变革持续存在并控制了后续的改进回合，从, which demonstrates that an AI-directed change persists and controls a later improvement round, from有效L5effective L5，这表明修订后的机制在可比较的预算和独立评估的情况下产生或选择了更好的继任者。当负责后续修改的流程保持不变时，自修改任务代码提供的证据不足。相反，即使任务代理代码不变，进化的后继评估器也可以建立结构性 L5。因此，分类适用于所检查的特定机制。表, which demonstrates that the revised mechanism produces or selects better successors under comparable budgets and independent assessment. Self-modifying task code provides insufficient evidence when the process responsible for later revisions remains unchanged. Conversely, an evolved successor evaluator can establish structural L5 even with unchanged task-agent code. Classification therefore applies to the particular mechanism examined. Table7总结了代表性系统的循环、继承状态和外部控制。summarizes the loop, inherited state, and external controls of representative systems.

3.6.1 改进搜索程序Improving the Search Procedure

人工智能修改了未来候选改进的生成和探索方式。The AI revises how future candidate improvements are generated and explored.固定优化器可以将其预算花在无用的建议上，即使其底层模型可以生成更好的搜索算法。挑战在于通过改进其他程序的能力来评估建议的优化器。A fixed optimizer can spend its budget on unproductive proposals, even when its underlying model can generate better search algorithms. The challenge is to evaluate a proposed optimizer through its ability to improve other programs.

停止STOPZelikman et al. [2024]使这个问题可执行。它的改进器是一个Python程序，它调用固定的语言模型，生成候选代码，评估提供的实用程序，并返回选定的候选代码。当前改进器接收自己的源作为优化目标。后续改进者根据他们在下游任务中编写的程序的质量进行评分，选定的改进者将执行下一轮的自我改进。因此，继承的工件是可以引入波束搜索、替代采样或其他候选选择逻辑的搜索过程。该研究报告称，选定的第四代改进者在排除自我改进的所有五项转移任务上都优于种子。任务分配、效用、基本模型和资源限制仍然由外部指定。较弱的模型运行平均会出现倒退，并且一些生成的程序逃避了软预算或利用了评估错误。makes this problem executable. Its improver is a Python program that calls a fixed language model, generates candidate code, evaluates a supplied utility, and returns a selected candidate. The current improver receives its own source as the optimization target. Successor improvers are scored by the quality of programs they produce on downstream tasks, and the selected improver performs the next self-improvement round. The inherited artifact is thus a search procedure that may introduce beam search, alternative sampling, or other candidate-selection logic. The study reports that a selected fourth-generation improver outperformed the seed on all five transfer tasks excluded from self-improvement. The task distribution, utility, base model, and resource limits remained externally specified. Weaker-model runs regressed on average, and some generated programs evaded soft budgets or exploited evaluation bugs.

哥德尔代理Gödel AgentYin et al. [2025]让 AI 能够访问共享 Python 程序中的任务策略和递归更新逻辑。执行反馈通知重写，修改后的程序在下一次递归调用中运行，包括其修改后的自更新过程。这将搜索范围扩大到开发人员固定的编辑例程之外。它还使错误变得可遗传：研究报告称，100 次 MGSM 优化试验中有 14 次的结果低于初始策略的性能，并且无限制的运行可以调用更强的模型。因此，任务目标和执行权限仍然是重要的外部控制。gives the AI access to both its task policy and recursive update logic in a shared Python program. Execution feedback informs a rewrite, and the revised program runs in the next recursive call, including its modified self-update procedure. This broadens the search beyond a developer’s fixed editing routine. It also makes errors inheritable: the study reports that 14 of 100 MGSM optimization trials ended below the initial policy’s performance, and unrestricted runs could call stronger models. Task objectives and execution permissions therefore remain consequential external controls.

3.6.2 改进继任者评估Improving Successor Evaluation

人工智能改进了确定保留哪些继任者的评估器。The AI improves the evaluator that determines which successors are retained.反复的优化给法官的盲点带来了压力。保持该判断不变可能会支持利用其错误的提案。不受限制的裁判修改会产生相反的问题：连续的分数可能反映出标准的变化。Repeated optimization places pressure on a judge’s blind spots. Keeping that judge unchanged can favor proposals that exploit its errors. Unrestricted judge revision creates the opposite problem: successive scores may reflect changing standards.

红皇后哥德尔机 (RQGM)The Red Queen Gödel Machine (RQGM)Iacob et al. [2026]通过评估器共同进化来解决这种紧张关系。它的学习评估器仍然冻结在一个时期内。在预定的边界，挑战者评估者与独立的地面实况锚进行比较；然后，选定的评估者将管理下一个纪元。取决于替换的评估者的分数将被丢弃，并且受影响的代理在重新访问时将被重新评估。该循环推进改进的评估器和代理代码，同时重置不兼容的评估记录。在保留的多语言编码任务中，预印本报告的通过率为 71.7%，而 HGM-H 的通过率为 69.9%，搜索令牌使用率较低。锚点、替换时间表和编排仍然是外部固定的。这些控制保留了可以判断评估者更改的参考；正式的稳定性论点适用于每个冻结时期，而不是无限制地改变目标。addresses this tension through evaluator co-evolution. Its learned evaluator remains frozen within an epoch. At a scheduled boundary, challenger evaluators are compared against an independent ground-truth anchor; the selected evaluator then governs the next epoch. Scores dependent on the replaced evaluator are discarded and affected agents are re-evaluated when revisited. The loop carries forward an improved evaluator and agent code while resetting incompatible evaluation records. On held-out Polyglot coding tasks, the preprint reports a 71.7% pass rate against 69.9% for HGM-H, with lower search-token use. The anchor, replacement schedule, and orchestration remain externally fixed. These controls preserve a reference against which evaluator changes can be judged; the formal stability argument applies within each frozen epoch, not to unrestricted changes of objective.

[2026b]提供了具体案例。其预印本报告了 30B 模型四轮的自主后训练。工人返回配方变更、检查点评估和失败；收集器整合这些结果，元代理修改下一轮的搜索策略。该政策包含一个常设秘诀、晋升或退休的搜索方向以及不成功方法的登记册。当发展分数增加而没有相应的外部收益时，修订后的政策会引导工人采取干预措施，尽管降低了代理值，但仍可以改善外部目标。该研究报告的最终排行榜得分为 0.86，而人类提交的最高得分为 0.87。跨轮继承存在于研究策略和发现日志中；底层工人的基础和构成保持不变。该案例支持人类定义的目标中的政策级 L5，但没有证明该目标的自主修订。provides a concrete case. Its preprint reports autonomous post-training of a 30B model across four rounds. Workers return recipe changes, checkpoint evaluations, and failures; a collector consolidates these results, and a meta-agent revises the next round’s search policy. The policy carries a standing recipe, promoted or retired search directions, and a registry of unsuccessful approaches. When development scores increased without corresponding external gains, the revised policy directed workers toward interventions that could improve the external target despite lowering the proxy. The study reports a final leaderboard score of 0.86, compared with 0.87 for the top human submission. Cross-round inheritance resides in the research policy and discovery log; the underlying worker substrate and constitution remain fixed. The case supports policy-level L5 within a human-defined objective, with no demonstrated autonomous revision of that objective.

当继承的程序有助于暴露新的限制并再次修改以解决它时，就会出现螺旋式改进。下一个目标应该确定可测试的能力差距，保留现有的能力，并证明进一步支出的合理性。目标修订本身提供的证据有限：评估必须确定修订后的政策改变了后续研究并改善了其结果。A spiral of improvement emerges when an inherited procedure helps expose a new limitation and is revised again to address it. The next goal should identify a testable capability gap, preserve established capabilities, and justify further expenditure. Goal revision alone supplies limited evidence: the evaluation must establish that the revised policy changes subsequent research and improves its outcomes.

发现：L5使得改进过程可继承。Finding: L5 makes the improvement procedure inheritable.通过重用修订后的改进器、评估器或研究策略来关闭循环。继任者继承该程序及其支持证据；人类保留总体目标、受保护的接受标准和资源权威。The loop closes through reuse of a revised improver, evaluator, or research policy. Successors inherit that procedure and its supporting evidence; humans retain the overall objective, protected acceptance criteria, and resource authority.

3.7 跨层次综合Cross-Level Synthesis

在 B0-L5 中，自主层级可以理解为改进循环中责任的逐步转移。这些级别的不同主要不在于正在优化的特定算法或工件，而在于人工智能系统将哪些改进决策内化，哪些状态持续到后续轮次，以及哪些接受条件仍然受到外部保护。Across B0–L5, the autonomy hierarchy can be understood as a progressive transfer of responsibility over the improvement loop. The levels differ not primarily in the particular algorithm or artifact being optimized, but in which improvement decisions are internalized by the AI system, what state persists into later rounds, and which acceptance conditions remain externally protected.

因此，可以简洁地表述相邻层之间的中心边界。从B0到L1的转变是The central boundaries between adjacent levels can therefore be stated compactly. The transition from B0 to L1 is坚持persistence：已接受的更改必须在当前任务中继续存在。 L1 至 L2 转机: an accepted change must survive the current task. L1 to L2 transfers策略选择strategy selection：人工智能决定尝试哪种干预，而不仅仅是执行规定的干预。 L2 到 L3 增加了对: AI decides which intervention to attempt rather than merely executing a prescribed one. L2 to L3 adds control over the未来的学习议程future learning agenda，因此不断发展的学习者会影响接下来获得的经验。 L3 到 L4 将反馈过程扩展为, so the evolving learner influences what experience is acquired next. L3 to L4 extends this feedback process into持久部署和环境交互persistent deployment and environmental interaction，其中系统更改必须在不断变化的操作条件下保持有用。 L4到L5终于介绍了, where system changes must remain useful under changing operational conditions. L4 to L5 finally introduces递归继承recursive inheritance，其中负责后期改进的机制本身成为继承的改进目标。, in which the mechanism responsible for later improvement itself becomes an inherited target of improvement.

重要的是，更高的自主级别本身并不意味着更好的改进过程。更大的授权可能与低效的搜索、不可靠的反馈、回归、评估者剥削或不良的转移共存。因此，我们将人工智能内化的改进责任范围与由此产生的改进的质量和效率分开。纵观此处审查的证据，较低和中级水平得到相对广泛的系统的支持，而 L3-L4 能力仍然更加依赖于领域，而端到端 L5 证据集中在有界原型和新兴工业或研究系统中。这种区别激发了下一节中特定于应用程序的分析。Importantly, a higher autonomy level does not by itself imply a better improvement process. Greater delegated authority can coexist with inefficient search, unreliable feedback, regression, evaluator exploitation, or poor transfer. We therefore separate the scope of improvement responsibility internalized by AI from the quality and efficiency of the resulting improvement. Across the evidence reviewed here, lower and intermediate levels are supported by a comparatively broad range of systems, whereas L3–L4 capabilities remain more domain-dependent and end-to-end L5 evidence is concentrated in bounded prototypes and emerging industrial or research systems. This distinction motivates the application-specific analysis in the following section.

4 跨应用程序的 RSIRSI Across Applications

根据人工智能控制下的改进功能将系统分类为 B0 到 L5，现在我们研究 RSI 如何在不同场景中应用。如图所示Having classified systems from B0 to L5 according to the improvement functions placed under AI control, we now examine how RSI is applied across different scenarios. As illustrated in Fig.9，应用程序在改进内容以及验证和保留更新所需的反馈方面有所不同。我们将证据分为四个应用领域，包括科学人工智能 (S1)、体现智能 (S2)、软件工程 (S3) 和医疗保健 (S4)。这些场景并不相互排斥，因为医疗保健人工智能科学家可能同时属于 S1 和 S4。, applications differ in both what they improve and the feedback required to validate and retain an update. We organize the evidence into four application regimes, including AI for science (S1), embodied intelligence (S2), software engineering (S3), and healthcare (S4). These scenarios are not mutually exclusive, as a healthcare AI scientist may fall under both S1 and S4.

每个小节都遵循一个共同的结构。我们首先描述目标场景中的典型人工智能工作流程，确定 RSI 循环如何从其任务和可用反馈中出现，并回顾特定场景的 RSI 挑战。然后，我们根据代表性系统改进的组件或工作流程对它们进行分组，并比较它们在 RSI 循环中的干预位置、更新内容以及如何保留这些改进。最后，我们评估了当前研究与每种情景设想的完整 RSI 循环之间的差距，强调了现有证据的强度、特定情景的风险以及取得更大改进的关键障碍。Each subsection follows a common structure. We first characterize the typical AI workflow in the target scenario, identify how an RSI loop can emerge from its tasks and available feedback, and review the challenges of the RSI for a specific scenario. We then group representative systems according to the components or workflows they improve, and compare where they intervene in the RSI loop, what they update, and how these improvements are retained. Finally, we assess the gap between current research and the full RSI loop envisioned for each scenario, highlighting the strength of existing evidence, scenario-specific risks, and the key barriers to greater improvement.

4.1 S1：科学 RSIS1: RSI for Science

科学对于 RSI 来说是一个特别重要的背景，因为科学进步不仅取决于解决孤立的问题，还取决于改进产生未来问题、假设和实验的机制。 因此，科学 RSI 不同于仅仅寻找更好的分子、方程或假设的自动发现。科学 RSI 循环从研究挑战开始，生成候选假设和实验，通过计算或与物理世界的交互对其进行评估，并使用所得证据或证伪来诊断人工智能科学 (AI4Sci) 系统。Science is a particularly consequential setting for RSI, as scientific progress depends not only on solving isolated problems, but also on improving the mechanisms by which future questions, hypotheses, and experiments are generated. Scientific RSI therefore differs from automated discovery that merely searches for a better molecule, equation, or hypothesis. A scientific RSI loop starts from a research challenge, generates candidate hypotheses and experiments, evaluates them through computation or interaction with the physical world, and uses the resulting evidence or falsification to diagnose the AI-for-science (AI4Sci) system.

科学 RSI 主要受到三个特征的挑战。 首先，科学发现是开放式的。相关假设的空间和必要的工具和实验都是事先未知的，而昂贵的实验使探索本身成为改进问题的一部分。 其次，科学反馈往往稀疏、延迟且不明确。例如，失败的实验可能表明假设不正确，但也可能是由不合适的模型、无效的方案或不可靠的仪器造成的。 第三，科学有效性取决于假设、领域和测量程序。在一种设置中成功的更新如果不记录其出处、有效性范围和不确定性，就无法安全地继承。 这些特征使得科学 RSI 同时成为证据获取、能力演化和认知控制的问题。因此，我们围绕可能演变的三个组件组织现有的工作，包括科学假设模块、实验代理和反射系统或改进器。RSI for science is mainly challenged by three characteristics. First, scientific discovery is open-ended. Neither the space of relevant hypotheses nor the set of necessary tools and experiments is known in advance, and costly experiments make exploration itself part of the improvement problem. Second, scientific feedback is often sparse, delayed, and non-identifying. For example, a failed experiment may indicate an incorrect hypothesis, but it may also result from an inappropriate model, an invalid protocol, or an unreliable instrument. Third, scientific validity is conditional on assumptions, domains, and measurement procedures. An update that succeeds in one setting cannot be inherited safely without recording its provenance, scope of validity, and uncertainty. These characteristics make scientific RSI simultaneously a problem of evidence acquisition, capability evolution, and epistemic control. Accordingly, we organize existing work around three components that may evolve, including the scientific hypothesis module, the experimental agent, and the reflection system or improver.

4.1.1 不断发展的科学假设模块Evolving Scientific Hypothesis Modules

假设模块确定提出哪些解释或候选方法并确定优先级。它的演变需要反馈来改变用于未来假设生成的机制，而不仅仅是为当前问题选择更好的假设。海波锻造The hypothesis module determines which explanations or candidate methods are proposed and prioritized. Its evolution requires feedback to change the mechanism used for future hypothesis generation, rather than merely selecting a better hypothesis for the current problem. HypoForgeQian et al. [2026]不断将科学经验提炼成可重复使用的程序技能，用于假设生成、实验设计和执行。当无法获得直接的经验反馈时，它会根据判别器的批评更新生成技能，并根据实际执行结果和归因失败来完善测试技能。 进化科学家continually distills scientific experience into reusable procedural skills for hypothesis generation, experimental design, and execution. It updates generation skills from discriminator critiques when direct empirical feedback is unavailable, and refines testing skills from real execution outcomes and attributed failures. EvoScientistLyu et al. [2026]相反，它会保留有希望和失败的研究方向的构想记忆，并在以后的任务中检索这些记忆以调整后续的建议。尽管底层模型、内存模式和更新过程保持固定，但这会产生持久的基于内存的适应。instead maintains an ideation memory of promising and failed research directions, which is retrieved in later tasks to adjust subsequent proposals. This produces persistent memory-based adaptation, although the underlying models, memory schema, and update procedure remain fixed.

更直接的方法更新候选生成器本身。 TTT-发现A more direct approach updates the candidate generator itself. TTT-DiscoverYuksekgonul et al. [2026]在测试时应用强化学习，允许科学反馈来修改模型权重，同时解决新问题。可自我改进的聚合物发现框架applies reinforcement learning at test time, allowing scientific feedback to modify model weights while solving a new problem. The self-improvable polymer discovery frameworkKhajeh et al. [2025]类似地，将模拟评估的候选者添加到训练数据中并重新训练其生成模型。 这些系统的发展仍然是特定于任务或领域的，并且是通过固定的培训和选择程序产生的。 因此，目前的证据支持有限的假设水平改进，而不是一种在跨领域制定科学假设方面逐渐变得更好的通用机制。similarly adds simulation-evaluated candidates to the training data and retrains its generative model. The evolution of these systems remain task- or domain-specific and are produced by fixed training and selection procedures. Current evidence therefore supports bounded hypothesis-level improvement, not a general mechanism that becomes progressively better at formulating scientific hypotheses across domains.

4.1.2 不断发展的实验代理Evolving Experimental Agents

实验代理通过选择工具、编写代码或操作实验室设备将假设转化为可执行程序。当执行反馈转换为可重用的操作时，它就会发生演变。测试时工具的演变An experimental agent turns a hypothesis into an executable procedure by selecting tools, writing code, or operating laboratory equipment. Its evolution occurs when execution feedback is converted into reusable actions. Test-Time Tool EvolutionLu et al. [2026b]在推理过程中综合、验证和重用可执行的科学工具，其 SciEvo 基准包含由 925 个进化工具支持的 1,590 个任务。 级联synthesizes, verifies, and reuses executable scientific tools during inference, whose SciEvo benchmark contains 1,590 tasks supported by 925 evolved tools. CASCADEHuang et al. [2026d]创建、修复和积累化学和材料科学的可执行技能，而 S1-NexusAgentcreates, repairs, and accumulates executable skills for chemistry and materials science, while S1-NexusAgentTeam [2026]将完整的研究轨迹提炼成可重复使用的科学技能。 技能铸造厂distills complete research trajectories into reusable Scientific Skills. SkillFoundryShen et al. [2026a]通过挖掘论文、存储库、文档和 API 等异构资源，将它们编译成可执行的技能包，并根据执行和下游实用程序验证、合并或修剪这些技能，构建并持续维护可重用的科学技能库。 这些方法使代理的动作空间持久且可扩展，尽管它们的工具生成和准入规则仍然是外部指定的。builds and continually maintains a library of reusable scientific skills by mining heterogeneous resources such as papers, repositories, documentation, and APIs, compiling them into executable skill packages, and validating, merging, or pruning these skills based on execution and downstream utility. These methods make the agent’s action space persistent and extensible, although their tool-generation and admission rules remain externally specified.

其他系统发展了更广泛的实验策略和工作流程。 药物圣人Other systems evolve broader experimental strategies and workflows. DrugSAGEZhang et al. [2026h]将经过验证的建模过程、训练策略和重复出现的错误修复存储在跨任务存储器中。从 16 项任务中收集的经验提高了 17 项保留任务的绩效，提供了继承经验改变新问题行为的直接证据。 史黛拉stores verified modeling procedures, training strategies, and recurring error fixes in a cross-task memory. Experience collected from 16 tasks improves performance on 17 held-out tasks, providing direct evidence that inherited experience changes behavior on new problems. STELLAJin et al. [2025]更新推理模板并扩展生物医学研究的工具海洋，EarthLinkupdates reasoning templates and expands a Tool Ocean for biomedical research, EarthLinkGuo et al. [2025b]保留了气候科学和 OriGene 的成功脚本和分析工作流程retains successful scripts and analytical workflows for climate science, and OriGeneZhang et al. [2026i]使用人类和实验反馈完善思维模板、工具组合和分析协议。 在物理模拟中，自进化流体控制剂refines thinking templates, tool compositions, and analytical protocols using human and experimental feedback. In physical simulation, the self-evolving fluid-control agentSun et al. [2026a]共同修改其代理定义及其产生的白盒控制器。这个案例还说明了一个重要的评估边界，其中实验代理的改进必须与科学工件（例如控制器）的改进分开衡量。jointly revises its agent definition and the white-box controller it produces. This case also illustrates an important evaluation boundary, where improvements to the experimental agent must be measured separately from improvements to the scientific artifact, such as the controller.

在这些系统中，最有力的证据来自于后续任务中经过验证的重用，而不是工具或内存库大小的增长。因此，可靠的实验代理进化需要明确的技能前提条件、执行测试、出处、版本控制和回滚。如果没有这些控制，本地成功的工作流程可能会在其验证条件之外被继承。Across these systems, the strongest evidence comes from validated reuse on later tasks rather than growth in the size of a tool or memory library. Reliable experimental-agent evolution therefore requires explicit skill preconditions, execution tests, provenance, versioning, and rollback. Without these controls, a locally successful workflow may be inherited outside the conditions under which it was validated.

4.1.3 不断发展的反射系统和改进剂Evolving Reflection Systems and Improvers

反思系统解释证据并识别失败原因，而改进者决定修改哪些组件、如何修改以及是否应保留更新。修改当前输出的固定批评者执行预定义的改进程序，而不断发展的改进者必须根据早期改进的结果更新自己的诊断、干预或促销政策。The reflection system interprets evidence and identifies the cause of failure, whereas the improver decides what component to modify, how to modify it, and whether the update should be retained. A fixed critic that revises the current output executes a predefined improvement procedure, while an evolving improver must instead update its own diagnostic, intervention, or promotion policy from the outcomes of earlier improvements.

新航SIAHebbar et al. [2026]提供当前 AI4Sci 系统中最广泛的组件级更新循环。其反馈代理使用任务结果在修改代理支架、工具、重试和搜索逻辑以及具有不同策略的低等级适配器（LoRA）权重之间进行选择。 珊瑚色provides the broadest component-level update loop among current AI4Sci systems. Its Feedback-Agent uses task outcomes to choose between modifying the agent scaffold, tools, retry and search logic, and low-rank adapter (LoRA) weights with different strategies. CORALQu et al. [2026]用长期运行的异步代理取代固定的进化搜索启发式，这些代理可以自主检查先前的尝试，决定何时测试或调用评估器，并将发现具体化为共享尝试、注释和可重用技能，并通过心跳触发的反射和重定向来维持长期探索。 世嘉replaces fixed evolutionary-search heuristics with long-running asynchronous agents that autonomously inspect prior attempts, decide when to test or invoke evaluators, and externalize discoveries as shared attempts, notes, and reusable skills, with heartbeat-triggered reflection and redirection sustaining long-horizon exploration. SAGADu et al. [2026]将可编辑表面扩展到目标层。在固定的高级科学目标下，它诊断优化候选群体中的故障模式，提出或重新衡量具体目标，并将它们实现为指导后续搜索的可执行评分函数。extends the editable surface to the objective layer. Under a fixed high-level scientific goal, it diagnoses failure modes in optimized candidate populations, proposes or reweights concrete objectives, and implements them as executable scoring functions that steer subsequent search.

4.1.4 递归改进科学代理Toward Recursively Improving Science Agents

总而言之，这些工作为科学 RSI 指明了更广阔的视野。它的最终形式不仅是一个能够产生更好的假设或实验结果的系统，而且是一个通过原始创新逐渐更好地进行科学的系统。它应该共同改进假设的生成、实验的执行和证据的解释，以便每个研究周期都能产生科学发现和对未来发现的可重复使用的改进。Taken together, these lines of work point toward a broader vision of scientific RSI. Its ultimate form is not merely a system that produces better hypotheses or experimental results, but one that becomes progressively better at conducting science with original innovation. It should jointly improve how hypotheses are generated, experiments are executed, and evidence is interpreted, such that each research cycle produces both scientific findings and reusable improvements to future discovery.

目前的 AI4Sci 系统仅部分实现了这一愿景。 B0 式的输出细化已经广泛应用，而 L1 持久更新已通过模型再训练和内存积累得到证明Current AI4Sci systems realize this vision only partially. B0-style output refinement is already widespread, while L1 persistent updates have been demonstrated through model retraining and memory accumulationYuksekgonul et al. [2026], Khajeh et al. [2025], Lyu et al. [2026]。 L2 代表当前最强大的前沿，系统可以自主选择或应用模型权重、工具、技能、工作流程和支架的更新. L2 represents the strongest current frontier, with systems autonomously selecting or applying updates to model weights, tools, skills, workflows, and scaffoldsHebbar et al. [2026], Lu et al. [2026b], Huang et al. [2026d]。一些系统通过自适应探索和跨任务经验重用展示了 L3 的各个方面. A few systems exhibit aspects of L3 through adaptive exploration and cross-task experience reuseQu et al. [2026], Zhang et al. [2026h]，而改进器本身的端到端 L4 环境适应和 L5 演化在很大程度上仍未被探索。, whereas end-to-end L4 environment adaptation and L5 evolution of the improver itself remain largely unexplored.

4.2 S2：体现智能的 RSIS2: RSI for Embodied Intelligence

对于具身智能来说，智能体的行为会在物理或模拟环境中产生可观察到的后果，这为 RSI 提供了自然的环境。 然而，仍然存在三个主要挑战。 首先，经验是内生的，因为当前的策略决定了智能体达到的状态，从而决定了有哪些证据可用于进一步改进。 其次，能力分布在整个感觉运动系统中，包括感知、计划、控制和物理体现，​​使得故障很难归因于单个组件。 第三，物理试验不能自由复制、逆转或重置，因此候选更新必须在安全、硬件和资源限制下进行评估。For embodied intelligence, an agent’s actions produce observable consequences in a physical or simulated environment, which provides a natural setting for RSI. However, three main challenges remain. First, experience is endogenous, as the current policy determines which states the agent reaches and therefore what evidence is available for further improvement. Second, capability is distributed across the sensorimotor system, including perception, planning, control, and the physical embodiment, making failures difficult to attribute to a single component. Third, physical trials cannot be freely reproduced, reversed, or reset, so candidate updates must be evaluated under safety, hardware, and resource constraints.

因此，体现 RSI 必须共同解决经验生成、跨组件信用分配和安全继承问题。它的交互循环从提供学习任务的环境和课程开始，其中代理利用组织相关功能，策略执行操作，世界模型和评估器解释结果。然后，经过验证的反馈会写回这些组件，从而允许更新后的系统参与下一轮交互。因此，我们回顾了有关不断变化的环境和课程、代理工具、政策和行动模型以及世界模型和评估者的现有工作。Embodied RSI must therefore jointly address experience generation, cross-component credit assignment, and safe inheritance. Its interaction loop begins with environments and curricula that provide learning tasks, where the agent harness organizes relevant capabilities, the policy executes actions, and world models and evaluators interpret the resulting outcomes. Validated feedback is then written back to these components, allowing the updated system to participate in the next round of interaction. Accordingly, we review existing work on evolving environments and curricula, agent harnesses, policies and action models, and world models and evaluators.

4.2.1 不断变化的环境和课程Evolving Environments and Curricula

体现的 RSI 循环首先确定代理将经历什么并从中学习。诗人An embodied RSI loop begins by determining what the agent will experience and learn from. POETWang et al. [2019]通过共同进化一群环境-代理对来解决固定的、人为设计的课程的局限性。它改变环境，通过最低标准承认既不平凡也不无法解决的挑战，优化相应的策略，并定期跨环境转移策略以重用行为垫脚石。环境生成器addresses the limitation of fixed, human-designed curricula by co-evolving a population of environment–agent pairs. It mutates environments, admits challenges that are neither trivial nor unsolvable through a minimal criterion, optimizes the corresponding policies, and periodically transfers policies across environments to reuse behavioral stepping stones. EnvGenZala et al. [2024]针对直接部署大型语言模型作为具体代理的高成本以及静态课程无法解决个人弱点的问题。相反，它采用法学硕士作为课程设计者，法学硕士生成模拟器配置，较小的强化学习智能体在其中进行训练，并且技能水平表现返回给法学硕士，以生成针对智能体剩余弱点的环境。 基因环境targets the high cost of directly deploying large language models as embodied agents and the inability of static curricula to address individual weaknesses. It instead employs an LLM as a curriculum designer, where the LLM generates simulator configurations, a smaller RL agent trains in them, and skill-level performance is returned to the LLM to produce environments targeting the agent’s remaining weaknesses. GenEnvGuo et al. [2025a]通过将环境模拟器参数化为可训练的课程策略，进一步解决静态训练数据与改进学习者之间的不匹配问题。其further addresses the mismatch between static training data and an improving learner by parameterizing the environment simulator as a trainable curriculum policy. Itsα\alpha-课程奖励有利于学习者当前能力前沿附近的任务，之后使用 GRPO 优化学习者，并通过奖励加权回归更新模拟器。-Curriculum Reward favors tasks near the learner’s current capability frontier, after which the learner is optimized with GRPO and the simulator is updated through reward-weighted regression.

尽管这些方法可以适应现有模拟器中的任务，但 OMNI-EPICWhereas these methods adapt tasks within an existing simulator, OMNI-EPICFaldor et al. [2025]解决手动预定义环境分布所施加的受限搜索空间。它使用 LLM 生成可执行环境和奖励代码，同时根据先前任务的存档和当前代理的学习进度来调整后续建议，以寻求既可学习又新颖的挑战。 模拟世界工作室addresses the restricted search space imposed by manually predefined environment distributions. It uses LLMs to generate executable environment and reward code, while conditioning subsequent proposals on an archive of prior tasks and the current agent’s learning progress to seek challenges that are both learnable and novel. SimWorld StudioKang et al. [2026]解决了另一个障碍，即生成的三维内容通常是静态的、无法验证的且不适合具体训练。它的 SimCoder 代理编写可执行的虚幻引擎代码，使用编译错误、物理检查和视觉语言模型批评来修改环境，并为下一代存储成功的工具和技能。然后，学习者的表现会引导其走向难度逐渐加大、与健身房兼容的世界。总的来说，这些方法将学习者的表现转化为一种进化分布和未来体验体验生成器的机制。tackles a further obstacle, where generated three-dimensional content is often static, unverifiable, and unsuitable for embodied training. Its SimCoder agent writes executable Unreal Engine code, revises environments using compilation errors, physics checks, and vision-language-model critiques, and stores successful tools and skills for later generation. Learner performance then guides it toward progressively harder Gym-compatible worlds. Collectively, these methods convert learner performance into a mechanism for evolving the distribution and the generator of future embodied experience.

4.2.2 不断发展的技能、记忆和特工装备Evolving Skills, Memory, and Agent Harnesses

给定一项任务，代理工具确定如何将记忆、技能、工具和执行规则组装成可操作的系统。航行者号Given a task, the agent harness determines how memories, skills, tools, and execution rules are assembled into an actionable system. VoyagerWang et al. [2023]将成功的 Minecraft 行为写入可执行技能库，而 LRLLwrites successful Minecraft behaviors into an executable skill library, while LRLLTziafas and Kasaei [2024]使用自我引导探索和唤醒-睡眠过程来增长和重组可组合机器人程序库。体现技能uses self-guided exploration and a wake–sleep process to grow and reorganize a library of composable robot programs. EmbodiSkillJu et al. [2026]进一步区分由不正确的技能引起的失败和由代理未遵循有效指导引起的失败，仅在轨迹提供相关证据时更新技能。further distinguishes between failures caused by an incorrect skill and failures caused by the agent not following valid guidance, updating a skill only when the trajectory provides relevant evidence.

最近的系统将更新目标从个人技能扩展到周围的代理架构。塑造者More recent systems expand the update target from individual skills to the surrounding agent architecture. SHAPERWang et al. [2026a]通过环境部署共同发展可重用技能和上下文代码利用，而 ASPIREjointly evolves reusable skills and the context-code harness through environment rollouts, while ASPIRELu et al. [2026c]诊断机器人执行故障，验证候选修复，并将成功的修复保留为可转移技能。恩派尔diagnoses robot execution failures, validates candidate repairs, and retains successful fixes as transferable skills. ENPIREXiao et al. [2026b]更进一步，允许编码代理通过重复的现实实验来修改机器人策略、训练程序和支持基础设施。goes further by allowing coding agents to revise robot policies, training procedures, and supporting infrastructure through repeated real-world experiments.

这些系统接近系统级演进，因为经验不仅改变了代理所知道的内容，还改变了其能力的选择、组合和改进方式。由此产生的工具最终决定了政策如何将观察和指示转化为行动。These systems approach system-level evolution as experience changes not only what the agent knows, but also how its capabilities are selected, composed, and improved. The resulting harness ultimately shapes how the policy converts observations and instructions into actions.

4.2.3 不断变化的政策和行动模式Evolving Policies and Action Models

任务和执行上下文就位后，策略将确定代理在环境中的行为方式。自我完善的具体基础模型With the task and execution context in place, the policy determines how the agent acts in the environment. Self-Improving Embodied Foundation ModelsGhasemipour et al. [2025]从预训练模型中获取奖励和成功信号，使机器人能够在有限的人类监督下练习任务并改进其策略。奖牌++derive reward and success signals from a pretrained model, allowing robots to practice tasks and improve their policies with limited human supervision. MEDAL++Sharma et al. [2023]同样，通过学习如何完成和撤消任务来支持自主实践，减少手动环境重置的需要。其他方法更新更有针对性的组件。 Q-规划similarly supports autonomous practice by learning both how to complete and undo a task, reducing the need for manual environment resets. Other methods update more targeted components. Q-PlanningGiridhar et al. [2026]保持大型行为克隆策略固定，但不断从成功和失败的部署轨迹中训练较小的价值函数，而 SERPkeeps a large behavior-cloning policy fixed but continually trains a smaller value function from both successful and failed deployment trajectories, while SERPLi et al. [2026a]在重新规划之前根据最近的导航失败调整其行动模型。在每种情况下，当前政策产生的互动都会成为其后继政策的培训证据。adjusts its action model from recent navigation failures before replanning. In each case, interaction produced by the current policy becomes training evidence for its successor.

然而，更新算法、奖励定义和允许的模型组件仍然是预先指定的，使得这些系统主要是策略层面自我改进的案例。此外，在安全地继承此类经验之前，系​​统必须预测并评估其行为实际造成的后果。However, the update algorithm, reward definition, and permitted model components remain specified in advance, making these systems primarily cases of policy-level self-improvement. Moreover, before such experience can be safely inherited, the system must predict and evaluate what its actions actually caused.

4.2.4 不断发展的世界模型和评估者Evolving World Models and Evaluators

一旦政策生效，世界模型和评估者就会将由此产生的互动转化为预测、结果判断和学习信号。超长激光焊接法Once the policy acts, world models and evaluators turn the resulting interaction into predictions, outcome judgments, and learning signals. VLAWGuo et al. [2026]使用真实的机器人部署来改进以动作为条件的视频世界模型，然后生成额外的综合经验来训练视觉-语言-动作策略。世界-VLA-环路uses real-robot rollouts to improve an action-conditioned video world model, which then generates additional synthetic experience for training the vision-language-action policy. World-VLA-LoopLiu et al. [2026d]使这种关系不断迭代，政策失败完善世界模型，而完善后的模型为下一轮政策优化提供更可靠的环境。莫图斯2makes this relation iterative, where policy failures refine the world model, and the refined model provides a more reliable environment for the next round of policy optimization. Motus2Bi et al. [2026]将政策、模拟和评估功能集成到共享模型中，利用失败和次优的交互来改进其动态和价值预测。扬帆integrates policy, simulation, and evaluation functions into a shared model, using failed and suboptimal interactions to improve its dynamics and value predictions. SAILLuo et al. [2026]遵循一个相关的循环，其中视频规划器执行其自己生成的计划并根据生成的轨迹进行微调。follows a related loop in which a video planner executes its own generated plans and is fine-tuned on the resulting trajectories.

这些方法不仅改进了政策，还改进了预测后果和产生未来训练信号的机制。然后，他们的反馈可以更新下一轮使用的政策、工具或课程，从而关闭具体的 RSI 循环。尽管如此，他们的目标和更新程序仍然是外部固定的，因此他们实例化了有界模型-策略协同进化，而不是无限制的递归改进。These methods improve not only the policy but also the mechanisms that predict consequences and produce future training signals. Their feedback can then update the policy, harness, or curriculum used in the next round, closing the embodied RSI loop. Nevertheless, their objectives and update procedures remain externally fixed, so they instantiate bounded model–policy co-evolution rather than unrestricted recursive improvement.

4.2.5 递归改进具体代理Toward Recursively Improving Embodied Agents

总而言之，这些工作表明，体现的 RSI 不仅应该提高任务绩效，还应该提高代理获取和验证新能力的过程。环境生成器应该提出靠近智能体能力边界的任务；该工具应组装相关的记忆、技能、工具和模型；政策应与环境相互作用；世界模型和评估者应该解释由此产生的结果。然后，经过验证的改进应该由政策、世界模型或工具继承，从而允许每个交互周期改进当前的行为和未来的学习。Taken together, these lines of work suggest that embodied RSI should improve not only task performance but also the process through which an agent acquires and validates new capabilities. An environment generator should propose tasks near the agent’s capability frontier; the harness should assemble relevant memories, skills, tools, and models; the policy should interact with the environment; and world models and evaluators should interpret the resulting outcomes. Verified improvements should then be inherited by the policy, world model, or harness, allowing each interaction cycle to improve both current behavior and future learning.

当前的系统仅部分地实现了该循环。 B0 式的情节内反思和重新规划已经很普遍。通过基于具体经验的政策和模型更新，L1 的持续改进得到了证明Current systems realize this loop only partially. B0-style within-episode reflection and replanning are already widespread. L1 persistent improvement has been demonstrated through policy and model updates based on embodied experienceGhasemipour et al. [2025], Sharma et al. [2023], Luo et al. [2026]。 L2 代表当前的主要前沿，系统在固定的评估程序下选择和应用技能、提示、控制程序和代理工具的更新. L2 represents a major current frontier, with systems selecting and applying updates to skills, prompts, control programs, and agent harnesses under fixed evaluation proceduresJu et al. [2026], Wang et al. [2026a], Lu et al. [2026c]。一些系统通过根据学习者的状态生成经验并保留跨任务的经过验证的技能来展示 L3 功能. Some systems exhibit L3 capabilities by generating experience according to the learner’s state and retaining validated skills across tasksWang et al. [2023], Tziafas and Kasaei [2024]。 L4 主体-环境协同进化也已出现，主要是在模拟中. L4 agent–environment co-evolution has also emerged, primarily in simulationWang et al. [2019], Zala et al. [2024], Guo et al. [2025a], Kang et al. [2026]。恩派尔. ENPIREXiao et al. [2026b]进一步通过允许编码代理修改策略、培训程序和支持基础设施来限制 L5。然而，它的环境接口、评估器和安全约束仍然是外部指定的。further approaches bounded L5 by allowing coding agents to revise policies, training procedures, and supporting infrastructure. However, its environment interfaces, evaluators, and safety constraints remain externally specified.

4.3 S3：软件工程的 RSIS3: RSI for Software Engineering

软件工程为研究 RSI 提供了一个异常具体的环境，因为产品和开发它的代理都表示为可执行代码。当编码代理尝试解决问题、观察基于存储库的反馈（例如测试失败、运行时跟踪或代码审查）并使用此证据来修改其自身的持久部分时，典型的循环就开始了。修改的组件可能是代理的技能、工作流程或实施，并且接受的更改将在以后的任务中重复使用。Software engineering provides an unusually concrete setting for studying RSI because both the product and the agent that develops it are represented as executable code. A typical loop begins when a coding agent attempts an issue, observes repository-grounded feedback such as test failures, runtime traces, or code review, and uses this evidence to modify a persistent part of itself. The modified component may be the agent’s skills, workflow, or implementation, and accepted changes are reused in later tasks.

软件工程的 RSI 面临三个基本挑战。 首先，系统必须不断生成针对其当前能力差距的软件任务，同时保持可验证性和对未来学习的价值。 其次，软件工程的改进必须评估修改现在是否有效以及是否增加了系统进一步改进的能力。更改可能会立即提高基准性能，但会导致后续搜索停滞，而暂时较弱的变体可能会产生更强的后代。 第三，在保持外部契约（例如评估标准、改进目标）的同时协调多个组件的演变仍然是一个挑战。 因此，我们围绕三个不断发展的组件组织现有的工作，包括代理实现和利用、软件工程经验和协作以及改进过程本身。RSI for software engineering then faces three fundamental challenges. First, the system must continually generate software tasks that target its current capability gaps while remaining both verifiable and valuable for future learning. Second, improvement for software engineering must assess both whether a modification is effective now and whether it increases the system’s capacity for further improvement. A change may raise immediate benchmark performance yet cause subsequent search to stagnate, whereas a temporarily weaker variant may produce stronger descendants. Third, coordinating the evolution of multiple components while preserving the outer contract (e.g., evaluation criteria, improvement objectives) remains a challenge. Accordingly, we organize existing work around three evolving components, including agent implementations and harnesses, software-engineering experience and collaboration, and the improvement process itself.

4.3.1 不断发展的编码代理实施和利用Evolving Coding-Agent Implementations and Harnesses

软件工程 RSI 最直接的形式将编码代理本身视为可编辑的软件项目。西卡The most direct form of software-engineering RSI treats the coding agent itself as an editable software project. SICARobeyns et al. [2025]允许代理检查以前的版本和基准测试结果，修改自己的 Python 代码库，并在下一轮改进中使用选定的版本。 由于同一系统既充当软件开发人员又充当正在开发的对象，因此对文件编辑工具、子代理或上下文管理的更改可以改进普通编码和随后的自我修改。 然而，它的基准、效用函数和沙箱仍然是外部固定的。allows an agent to inspect previous versions and benchmark results, modify its own Python codebase, and use the selected version in the next improvement round. Because the same system acts both as the software developer and as the object being developed, changes to file-editing tools, subagents, or context management can improve both ordinary coding and subsequent self-modification. However, its benchmark, utility function, and sandbox remain externally fixed.

最近的工作将自我修改范围缩小到代理More recent work narrows self-modification to the agent马具harness（例如中间件、验证规则和控制逻辑）。 自我安全带(e.g., middleware, verification rules, and control logic). Self-HarnessZhang et al. [2026a]使用执行跟踪来识别重复出现的弱点，要求相同的底层模型对其当前工具提出小的更改，并且仅在回归测试后保留建议。 代理线束工程uses execution traces to identify recurring weaknesses, asks the same underlying model to propose small changes to its current harness, and retains a proposal only after regression testing. Agentic Harness EngineeringLin et al. [2026b]将线束组件公开为可单独编辑和可恢复的文件，将长轨迹提炼为结构化证据，并检查每个提议的更改是否产生其预测的效果。其独立的演化者角色使得循环不如自驾驭那样直接地自我引用，但所接受的驾驭在以后的执行中仍然存在。衔尾蛇exposes harness components as separately editable and revertible files, distills long trajectories into structured evidence, and checks whether each proposed change produces its predicted effect. Together, these systems show how version control, regression tests, and rollback can turn agent self-modification into a persistent and auditable process.

4.3.2 不断发展的软件工程经验、技能和协作Evolving Software-Engineering Experience, Skills, and Collaboration

一种较轻的自我进化形式改变了编码代理如何使用先前的开发经验，而无需重写其完整实现。 SWE-ExpA lighter form of self-evolution changes how a coding agent uses prior development experience without rewriting its full implementation. SWE-ExpChen et al. [2026b]将成功和失败的问题解决轨迹提取到经验库中，并为以后的存储库任务检索相关经验教训。代码技能extracts both successful and failed issue-resolution trajectories into an experience bank and retrieves relevant lessons for later repository tasks. CODESKILLLi et al. In both cases, the persistent output is reusable development knowledge which supports cross-task adaptation. However, their fixed extraction and update procedures do not themselves become better through use.

自我进化还可以改变软件团队的组织。埃沃马克Self-evolution can also change the organization of a software team. EvoMACHu et al. [2024]将多代理编码工作流程表示为角色提示和通信链接的网络，然后使用测试反馈和文本反向传播来修改代理及其连接。 这改进了用于构建当前程序的工作流程，但报告的更新发生在每个任务的测试期间。represents a multi-agent coding workflow as a network of role prompts and communication links, then uses test feedback and textual back-propagation to revise both the agents and their connections. This improves the workflow used to construct the current program, but the reported updates occur during test time for each task.

4.3.3 不断发展的改进过程Evolving the Improvement Process

最强大的系统不会遵循单一的已接受编辑序列；他们还寻找替代的进化路径。达尔文哥德尔机 (DGM)The strongest systems do not follow a single sequence of accepted edits; they also search over alternative evolutionary paths. Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM)Zhang et al. [2026b]维护编码代理变体的档案，选择以前的代理作为父代，让它们修改自己的实现，并评估其后代的可执行编码任务。保留多个谱系可以防止一种有害的编辑永久阻碍进展，并允许暂时较弱的变体成为有用的垫脚石。赫胥黎-哥德尔机 (HGM)maintains an archive of coding-agent variants, selects previous agents as parents, lets them modify their own implementations, and evaluates their descendants on executable coding tasks. Keeping multiple lineages prevents one harmful edit from permanently blocking progress and allows temporarily weak variants to become useful stepping stones. Huxley–Gödel Machine (HGM)Wang et al. [2026b]进一步认为，当前的基准表现并不等同于产生更好后代的能力。因此估计further argues that current benchmark performance is not the same as the ability to produce better descendants.
