基于群体的方法拓宽了跨谱系的遗传范围。群体进化代理Population-based methods broaden what can be inherited across lineages. Group-Evolving AgentsWeng et al. [2026]允许多个父代理在生成新组时共享成功的修改和失败的经验，因此有用的发现不会孤立在一个分支内。达尔文Xallows several parent agents to share successful modifications and failure experience when producing a new group, so useful discoveries are not isolated within one branch. DarwinXZhang et al. [2026g]围绕冻结模型进化出完整的工具集，并且仅当它们扩展任务覆盖范围而不回归先前解决的案例时才允许变体。螺旋evolves populations of complete harnesses around a frozen model and admits variants only when they extend task coverage without regressing previously solved cases. HELIXFan and Huang [2026]提出了进一步的模型 - 线束循环，其中线束进化改进了当前的执行并生成经过验证的轨迹以更新模型，之后为更改的模型重建线束。proposes a further model–harness loop in which harness evolution improves current execution and generates verified trajectories for updating the model, after which the harness is rebuilt for the changed model.

4.3.4 递归改进软件工程代理Toward Recursively Improving Software-Engineering Agents

总而言之，这些工作表明软件工程 RSI 循环为Taken together, these works suggest a software-engineering RSI loop of发展挑战Development Challenge→\rightarrow代理级修改Agent-Level Modification→\rightarrow基于存储库的试验Repository-Grounded Trial→\rightarrow回归感知选择Regression-Aware Selection→\rightarrow版本化继承Versioned Inheritance。存储库反馈会触发持久代理更新，该更新会根据当前和保留的任务进行评估，然后作为可跟踪和可逆的版本继承，以供未来开发和自我改进。. Repository feedback triggers a persistent agent update, which is evaluated on current and held-out tasks before being inherited as a traceable and reversible version for future development and self-improvement.

B0 task-local refinement is widespread, while L1 persistent updates appear in cross-task experience and skill learningChen et al. [2026b], Li et al. [2026d]。 L2 是最强大的既定级别，代理在固定目标和评估者下选择对工具、工具或工作流程进行更改. L2 is the strongest established level, with agents selecting changes to harnesses, tools, or workflows under fixed objectives and evaluatorsZhang et al. [2026a], Lin et al. [2026b], Zhang et al. [2026g]。 L3 是通过自我游戏 SWE-RL 和 Socratic-SWE 中的学习者条件任务生成而出现的. L3 is emerging through learner-conditioned task generation in Self-play SWE-RL and Socratic-SWEWei et al. [2026b], Xiao et al. [2026a]。 L4 环境适应仍然基本上不存在。 SICA 和 DGM 通过修改代码展现出有界的 L5 特征，从而塑造后来的自我改进. L4 environment adaptation remains largely absent. [2026b]，而 HGM 引入了基于谱系的元选择，而不调整选择规则本身, while HGM introduces lineage-based meta-selection without adapting the selection rule itselfWang et al. [2026b]。软件开发改进器的完整 L5 改进尚未得到证实。. Full L5 improvement of the software-development improver has not yet been demonstrated.

4.4 S4：医疗保健领域的 RSIS4: RSI for Healthcare

作为人工智能应用最突出的场景之一，医疗保健涵盖了诊断、医学图像分析和治疗计划等任务。典型的 RSI 循环始于代理执行临床任务并接收来自诊断结果、临床医生修正或临床指南的可验证反馈。然后，代理持续更新其组件（例如，临床知识、推理策略、工作流程），并保留在内存、技能库或模型参数中，以便在后续案例中重用。As one of the most prominent scenarios for AI application, healthcare spans tasks like diagnosis, medical image analysis, and treatment planning. A typical RSI loop begins with an agent performing a clinical task and receiving verifiable feedback from diagnostic results, clinician corrections, or clinical guidelines. The agent then persistently updates its components (e.g., clinical knowledge, reasoning strategies, workflows) with improvements retained in memory, skill libraries, or model parameters for reuse across subsequent cases.

医疗保健领域的 RSI 主要受到三个特征的挑战。首先，医疗保健不允许无限制的试验和错误，因为诊断和治疗行为可能会伤害患者，因此需要专家、道德和机构的监督。其次，临床反馈通常是延迟的、异质的和混乱的，使得很难将患者的结果归因于特定的代理决策或更新。第三，临床改进取决于人群和机构，因此在一种环境中验证的更新如果不记录其来源、范围和不确定性就不能安全地继承。这些特征使医疗保健 RSI 成为安全反馈获取、可靠信用分配和受控能力继承的问题。因此，我们围绕可能发展的三个组成部分组织现有的工作：临床记忆和知识、临床推理策略以及医疗保健工具和工作流程。RSI for healthcare is mainly challenged by three characteristics. First, healthcare does not permit unrestricted trial and error, as diagnostic and treatment actions may harm patients and therefore require expert, ethical, and institutional oversight. Second, clinical feedback is often delayed, heterogeneous, and confounded, making it difficult to attribute patient outcomes to a particular agent decision or update. Third, clinical improvements are population- and institution-dependent, so an update validated in one setting cannot be safely inherited without recording its provenance, scope, and uncertainty. These characteristics make healthcare RSI a problem of safe feedback acquisition, reliable credit assignment, and governed capability inheritance. Accordingly, we organize existing work around three components that may evolve: clinical memory and knowledge, clinical reasoning strategies, and healthcare tools and workflows.

4.4.1 不断发展的临床记忆和知识Evolving Clinical Memory and Knowledge

医疗保健领域最常见的 RSI 形式会发展代理人的临床记忆，其中已完成病例的反馈会转化为持久的知识，从而影响后续患者的决策。 早期的系统主要保留案例级别的经验。 Agent 医院的 MedAgent-0The most common form of RSI in healthcare evolves the agent’s clinical memory, where the feedback from completed cases is converted into persistent knowledge that can influence decisions for subsequent patients. Early systems primarily retain case-level experience. MedAgent-Zero in Agent HospitalLi et al. [2025b]存储成功的治疗案例并反思失败的案例，以得出可重用的诊断规则，从而允许具有冻结模型权重的医生代理在以后的模拟遭遇中检索这些经验。 同样，特工心理诊所stores successful treatment cases and reflects on failed cases to derive reusable diagnostic rules, allowing a doctor agent with frozen model weights to retrieve these experiences in later simulated encounters. Similarly, Agent Mental ClinicLan et al. [2024]通过监控模块将精神科医生的诊断与标记结果进行比较，并将所得的诊断经验写入分层存储架构中。 医疗代理模拟器compares the psychiatrist agent’s diagnosis with labeled outcomes through a supervisor module and writes the resulting diagnostic experience into a tiered memory architecture. MedAgentSimAlmansoori et al. [2025]进一步将医疗记录与经验记录相结合，使诊断代理能够重用从早期模拟医患互动中积累的知识。 在这些系统中，一次遭遇的输出成为持久上下文的一部分，代理可以从中推断出未来的情况。further combines medical records with experience records, enabling diagnostic agents to reuse knowledge accumulated from earlier simulated doctor–patient interactions. In these systems, the output of one encounter becomes part of the persistent context from which the agent reasons about future cases.

最近的方法发展了记忆知识的结构和可靠性，而不是简单地积累原始轨迹。 DX进化More recent methods evolve the structure and reliability of remembered knowledge rather than simply accumulating raw trajectories. DxEvolveRen et al. [2026a]将诊断遭遇提炼成distills diagnostic encounters into诊断认知原语diagnostic cognition primitives，它编码用于信息获取和诊断推理的可重用模式，并且可以在新案例中检索。地质扫描电镜, which encode reusable patterns for information acquisition and diagnostic reasoning and can be retrieved in new cases. GSEMHan et al. [2026]将经验组织为双层图，并使用后续反馈来重新校准节点质量和经验间边缘权重，从而改变记住的内容以及哪些记忆被认为是适用的。 Evo-MedAgentorganizes experience as a dual-layer graph and uses subsequent feedback to recalibrate node quality and inter-experience edge weights, thereby changing both what is remembered and which memories are considered applicable. Evo-MedAgentShen et al. After each chest-radiography case, reflection updates these stores so that later cases inherit both clinical lessons and revised trust in diagnostic tools. Nevertheless, most evidence remains based on simulated or retrospective cases with externally supplied labels, and the validation of evolution in real-世界案例仍然缺乏。world cases is still lacking.

4.4.2 不断发展的临床推理策略Evolving Clinical Reasoning Strategies

除了不断发展的临床事实之外，医疗保健人员还可以发展确定如何获取、解释和整合证据的策略。埃沃临床医生Beyond evolving clinical facts, healthcare agents can evolve the strategies that determine how evidence is acquired, interpreted, and integrated. EvoClinicianHe et al. [2026b]通过实例化这个过程instantiates this process through a诊断-分级-进化Diagnose–Grade–Evolve循环中，Actor 依次提出问题并安排检查，Process Grader 根据临床产量和资源成本评估每个操作，Evolver 使用此反馈在下一个案例之前修改 Actor 的提示和记忆。因此，继承的进化对象是一种诊断策略，例如，要澄清哪些症状或优先考虑哪些检查。loop, where an Actor sequentially asks questions and orders examinations, a Process Grader evaluates each action according to its clinical yield and resource cost, and an Evolver uses this feedback to revise the Actor’s prompt and memory before the next case. The inherited evolution object is thus a diagnostic policy, for example, which symptom to clarify or which examination to prioritize.

推理进化也可以发生在多智能体协调的层面上。进化MDTReasoning evolution can also occur at the level of multi-agent coordination. EvoMDTLiu et al. [2026b]分解角色专门代理之间的肿瘤学决策，并使用专家评估和结果导向的信号来更新提示、共识权重和检索范围。因此，反馈不仅可以改变个体代理人的推理，还可以改变在以后的案例中专家意见的权衡和协调方式。在心理咨询方面，PsychAgentdecomposes oncology decision-making among role-specialized agents and uses expert assessments and outcome-oriented signals to update prompts, consensus weights, and retrieval scope. Consequently, feedback can change not only an individual agent’s reasoning but also how specialist opinions are weighted and reconciled in later cases. In psychological counseling, PsychAgentYang et al. [2026]从历史咨询轨迹中提取基于实践的技能，将其添加到不断发展的技能库中，并通过拒绝微调进一步内化所选技能。extracts practice-grounded skills from historical counseling trajectories, adds them to an evolving skill repertoire, and further internalizes selected skills through rejection fine-tuning.

4.4.3 不断发展的医疗保健工具和工作流程Evolving Healthcare Tools and Workflows

第三条工作线通过将成功的执行转化为可重用的工具、技能或临床工作流程来发展代理的行动库。宏观A third line of work evolves the agent’s action repertoire by turning successful executions into reusable tools, skills, or clinical workflows. MACROFan et al. [2026]从一组固定的医学成像工具开始，但在经过验证的执行轨迹中识别重复出现的多步骤模式，将它们合成为复合工具，并将这些复合材料注册为后续成像任务的新的高级操作。因此，生成的代理会更改它可以直接调用的内容，而不仅仅是检索早期的解决方案。斯克梅克斯begins with a fixed collection of medical-imaging tools but identifies recurring multi-step patterns in verified execution trajectories, synthesizes them into composite tools, and registers these composites as new high-level actions for subsequent imaging tasks. The resulting agent therefore changes what it can directly invoke, rather than merely retrieving an earlier solution. SkeMexSun et al. [2026b]在程序技能层面遵循相关方法：它将信息丰富的临床轨迹提炼为一般技能、特定任务技能和行动技能，根据环境反馈估计其与背景相关的效用，并通过follows a related approach at the level of procedural skills: it distills informative clinical trajectories into general, task-specific, and action-level skills, estimates their context-dependent utility from environmental feedback, and manages them through a读-写-评估-治理Read–Write–Assess–Govern可以提升、合并、更新或删除条目的生命周期。在这两种情况下，继承都是通过不断发展的动作空间来运作的，其组件是根据其在后续任务中所展示的效用来选择的。lifecycle that can promote, merge, update, or remove entries. In both cases, inheritance operates through an evolving action space whose components are selected according to their demonstrated utility in later tasks.

其他系统发展了更大的分析工作流程及其支持组件。组织实验室Other systems evolve larger analytical workflows and their supporting components. TissueLabLi et al. [2025c]允许领域专家检查中间医学成像结果并提供纠正，以指导主动学习、分类器细化以及跨病理学、放射学和空间组学任务的后续工作流程构建。健康流allows domain experts to inspect intermediate medical-imaging results and provide corrections that guide active learning, classifier refinement, and subsequent workflow construction across pathology, radiology, and spatial-omics tasks. HealthFlowZhu et al. [2026b]将完成的 EHR 分析转换为持久的保障措施、可重复使用的工作流程、数据集特定的锚点和代码片段；评估者首先识别执行或方法上的缺陷，然后反思者验证、更新或废弃经验，然后再检索经验以供以后分析。 这些系统将医疗保健 RSI 从选择预定义工具转变为构建可重复使用的程序。然而，由于技术成功或特定病例的临床医生反馈并不能保证患者群体的安全，因此在跨病例继承之前，必须对改进的工作流程进行验证和可逆。converts completed EHR analyses into persistent safeguards, reusable workflows, dataset-specific anchors, and code snippets; an evaluator first identifies execution or methodological defects, after which a reflector validates, updates, or retires experience before it is retrieved for later analyses. These systems move healthcare RSI from selecting predefined tools to constructing reusable procedures. However, because technical success or case-specific clinician feedback does not guarantee safety across patient populations, evolved workflows must be validated and reversible before being inherited across cases.

4.4.4 递归改进医疗保健代理Toward Recursively Improving Healthcare Agents

用于医疗保健的 RSI 的最终形式不仅是一个能够产生更好的诊断、建议或分析输出的系统，而且是一个能够逐渐更好地执行医疗保健任务，同时保持临床有效性和安全性的系统。每个情节都应该产生任务结果和对代理记忆、推理策略或动作库的经过验证的改进，以便可以在后续案例中安全地重用并进一步评估所产生的能力。The ultimate form of RSI for healthcare is not merely a system that produces better diagnoses, recommendations, or analytical outputs, but one that becomes progressively better at performing healthcare tasks while preserving clinical validity and safety. Each episode should produce both a task outcome and a validated improvement to the agent’s memory, reasoning strategy, or action repertoire, such that the resulting capability can be safely reused and further evaluated in subsequent cases.

B0 式的案例内反思和答案细化已经很普遍，但它们不会持续改变未来的行为。 L1 持续遗传已通过病例记忆、诊断规则和可重复使用的临床知识得到证明B0-style within-case reflection and answer refinement are already widespread, but they do not persistently alter future behavior. L1 persistent inheritance has been demonstrated through case memories, diagnostic rules, and reusable clinical knowledgeLan et al. [2024], Almansoori et al. [2025], Ren et al. [2026a]。 L2 代表当前最强大的前沿：系统可以诊断故障并自主选择或应用提示、记忆、推理策略、工具、工作流程和协调机制的更新，同时其目标、评估器和部署门保持外部固定. L2 represents the strongest current frontier: systems can diagnose failures and autonomously select or apply updates to prompts, memories, reasoning policies, tools, workflows, and coordination mechanisms while their objectives, evaluators, and deployment gates remain externally fixedHe et al. [2026b], Han et al. [2026], Shen et al. [2026b], Liu et al. [2026b], Fan et al. [2026], Sun et al. [2026b], Zhu et al. [2026b]。一些系统通过使用当前的不确定性或积累的经验来塑造后续的证据获取、模拟遭遇或专家注释，从而表现出类似 L3 的元素. A few systems exhibit L3-like elements by using current uncertainty or accumulated experience to shape subsequent evidence acquisition, simulated encounters, or expert annotationLi et al. [2025b], Li et al. [2025c];然而，他们的患者群体、任务分配和入院标准很大程度上仍然是外部规定的。 EvoPatient 通过共同进化模拟患者和医生进一步探索 L4 式适应; however, their patient populations, task distributions, and admission criteria remain largely externally specified. EvoPatient further explores L4-style adaptation by co-evolving simulated patients and doctorsDu et al. [2025]，但模拟器的临床真实性和评估标准仍然由外部确定。真实纵向结果的端到端 L4 适应和临床改进剂本身的 L5 进化在很大程度上仍未被探索。, but the simulator’s clinical realism and evaluation criteria remain externally determined. End-to-end L4 adaptation from real longitudinal outcomes and L5 evolution of the clinical improver itself remain largely unexplored.

5 行业格局及初步实践Industry Landscape and Preliminary Practices

5.1 Theseus：RSI 情报的环境-数据-模型协同进化Theseus: Environment–Data–Model Co-Evolution for RSI Intelligence

Theseus 将环境-数据-模型协同进化定位为通向下一代 RSI 智能的道路。其核心前提是环境使知识可获取、行动可验证、任务执行为学习提供证据、改进的模型扩大了可探索的问题范围。在这一愿景下，每一轮工作都应该为后续轮次提供可重用的能力，使现实世界的实践成为智力增长的持续源泉。Theseus positions environment–data–model co-evolution as a path toward next-generation RSI intelligence. Its central premise is that environments make knowledge accessible and actions verifiable, task execution produces evidence for learning, and improved models expand the range of problems that can be explored. Under this vision, each round of work should contribute reusable capabilities to subsequent rounds, making real-world practice a continuing source of intelligence growth.

如图As shown in Figure10，忒修斯分四步实现这一愿景。首先，将细化经验转化为环境细化任务来训练环境细化模型。其次，代理使用重建的环境来识别真正的任务解决困难并生成有针对性的训练数据。第三，这些数据训练任务模型以提高其能力。第四，更强的模型支持进一步的环境迭代和更多任务的生成。随后的几轮会产生新的任务训练数据和新的环境优化经验，将解决任务的进展与构建未来学习条件的进展联系起来。, Theseus realizes this vision in four steps. First, refinement experience is converted into environment-refinement tasks to train an environment-refinement model. Second, agents use reconstructed environments to identify genuine task-solving difficulties and generate targeted training data. Third, these data train the task model to improve its capabilities. Fourth, the stronger model supports further environment iteration and the generation of more tasks. Subsequent rounds yield both new task-training data and new environment-refinement experience, linking progress in solving tasks to progress in constructing the conditions for future learning.

早期结果为循环工作空间阶段的这一方向提供了初步的经验基础。试点项目采用 8 个前沿模型线束配置，可完成 30 个工作区任务，改编自 Workspace-BenchEarly results provide an initial empirical basis for this direction in the workspace stage of the loop. A pilot with eight frontier model–harness configurations on 30 workspace tasks adapted from Workspace-BenchTang and others [2026]，按 1,280 个评分标准进行评分，首先测量对工作空间质量的敏感性：相对于充满噪音的工作空间，干净的工作空间在所有八种配置中将通过率提高了 21.7–51.6 个百分点（表, scored by 1,280 rubrics, first measured sensitivity to workspace quality: relative to a noise-laden workspace, a clean workspace raised pass rates by 21.7–51.6 percentage points across all eight configurations (Table9a)，表明工作空间状态，而不是单独的模型能力，可以限制代理的性能。基于这一观察，一项后续生产力研究询问丰富环境是否可以提高任务性能，同时保持底层模型和线束固定：五个固定模型-线束配对在裸工作区和由集合映射和事件日志组成的重建环境下解决了总共 547 个评分标准的 30 项任务；重建的环境将所有测试配置的总评分提高了 18.65–39.67 个百分点（表a), suggesting that workspace state, rather than model capability alone, can bound agent performance. Building on this observation, a follow-up productivity study asked whether enriching the environment improves task performance while keeping the underlying model and harness fixed: five fixed model–harness pairings solved 30 tasks scored by 547 rubrics in total under a bare workspace and a reconstructed environment consisting of a Collection Map and an Event Log; the reconstructed environment raised aggregate rubric scores by 18.65–39.67 percentage points across all tested configurations (Table9b)，尽管一些任务显示了范围蠕变回归，其中代理产生了比任务所需更广泛的变化。该团队还完成了可重用文件验证模块的培训。这些早期结果标志着协同进化循环的第一步，后续的循环将把环境重建、数据生成和模型训练延伸到复合改进的持续循环中。b), although a few tasks showed scope-creep regressions, where agents produced more extensive changes than the task required. The team has also completed training a reusable file-verification module. These early results mark the first steps of the co-evolution loop, and successive rounds will extend environment reconstruction, data generation, and model training into a sustained cycle of compounding improvement.

5.2 Lark：为可靠的企业级 RSI 构建数据基础Lark: Building the Data Foundation for Reliable Enterprise-Level RSI

图Figure11总结了 Lark 的数据基础循环。 Lark 从一个经常被忽视的先决条件出发来处理 RSI：在智能体能够自我改进之前，它需要一个不断发展的数据基础，作为改进的基础。在企业协作中，文档、消息、会议和任务不断生成新信息，而代理则使用这些数据并产生新的交互轨迹。因此，Lark 将数据生产、质量评估和故障归因视为 RSI 管道的基础。关键目标不仅仅是积累更多数据，而是确保每次迭代都有新的经验可供学习、判断进度的可靠标准以及足够细粒度的诊断来确定应该更改的内容。summarizes Lark’s data-foundation loop. Lark approaches RSI from a prerequisite that is often overlooked: before an agent can improve itself, it needs a continuously evolving data substrate on which improvement can be grounded. In enterprise collaboration, documents, messages, meetings, and tasks continuously generate new information, while agents consume these data and produce new interaction traces. Lark therefore treats data production, quality evaluation, and failure attribution as the foundation of its RSI pipeline. The key objective is not merely to accumulate more data, but to ensure that each iteration has fresh experience to learn from, a reliable criterion for judging progress, and sufficiently fine-grained diagnostics to determine what should be changed.

企业知识图谱。Enterprise Knowledge Graph.一个代表性的例子是企业知识图谱的构建和不断完善。分散在文档、消息和会议记录中的信息被链接到实体、事件、人员和时间关系中，以便代理可以回答需要跨源推理的问题。由于图错误直接传播到下游答案，因此图构建本身被视为迭代数据质量问题。 Lark 通过批量图构建和委托授权检查来解决可扩展性，同时不断评估基于图的检索是否改善了下游问答。在内部评估中，它报告说，与基于 RAG 的基线相比，使用基于图形的管道时，人工评估任务可用性从 52% 增加到 65%，而自动评估可用性从 47% 增加到 56%。A representative example is the construction and continual refinement of an enterprise knowledge graph. Information scattered across documents, messages, and meeting records is linked into entities, events, people, and temporal relations so that agents can answer questions requiring cross-source reasoning. Because graph errors directly propagate into downstream answers, graph construction is itself treated as an iterative data-quality problem. Lark addresses scalability through batched graph construction and delegated authorization checks, while continuously evaluating whether graph-based retrieval improves downstream question answering. In internal evaluations, it reports that human-rated task usability increased from 52% to 65%, while automated-evaluation usability increased from 47% to 56% when using its graph-based pipeline compared with the RAG-based baseline.

自动数据质量评估。Automated Data-Quality Evaluation.另一个例子是自动化数据质量评估系统，作为后续改进的测量层。 Lark 并不完全依赖昂贵且不一致的人工审核，而是首先应用绝对判断来识别明显不可用的输出，然后使用比较 GSB 评估来确定是否应该推广新的系统变体。重要的是，评估与明确的失败归因相结合。不良案例被分类为问题（例如，时间不一致、查询扭曲或源质量差），以便每个故障都映射到具体的改进方向。例如，对时间敏感的问题受到查询时间过滤的限制，以避免使用未来的信息，并且在重新进入评估管道之前重写低质量的综合查询。最初的自动评估器与人类判断的一致性约为 84%，其中大多数分歧的出现是因为自动评估器比人类评审员更严格，为后续校准提供了具体信号。Another example is an automated data-quality evaluation system that serves as the measurement layer for subsequent improvement. Rather than relying entirely on expensive and inconsistent manual review, Lark first applies absolute judgments to identify clearly unusable outputs and then uses comparative GSB evaluation to determine whether a new system variant should be promoted. Importantly, evaluation is coupled with explicit failure attribution. Bad cases are categorized into issues (e.g., temporal inconsistency, distorted queries, or poor source quality), so that each failure maps to a concrete improvement direction. For example, time-sensitive questions are constrained by query-time filtering to avoid using future information, and low-quality synthetic queries are rewritten before re-entering the evaluation pipeline. The initial automated evaluator achieved approximately 84% agreement with human judgments, where most disagreements arose because the automated evaluator was stricter than human reviewers, providing a concrete signal for subsequent calibration.

从 RSI 的角度来看，这些试验的意义在于它们为未来代理改进创建的反馈结构。企业活动不断产生新的图形数据和交互跟踪，自动评估确定哪些输出和数据是可靠的，错误归因识别管道失败的位置，纠正后的数据和评估标准然后成为后续迭代的输入。由此产生的循环将生产数据从被动资源转变为不断发展的改进基础。与此同时，Lark 目前的做法仍然故意由人为控制：代理执行大部分重复性数据处理和评估，而人类则保留定义标准、审查关键样本和批准重要变更的责任。From an RSI perspective, the significance of these trials lies in the feedback structure they create for future agent improvement. Enterprise activity continuously produces new graph data and interaction traces, automated evaluation determines which outputs and data are reliable, error attribution identifies where the pipeline failed, and corrected data and evaluation standards then become inputs to later iterations. The resulting cycle turns production data from a passive resource into an evolving improvement substrate. At the same time, Lark’s current practice remains deliberately human-gated: agents perform much of the repetitive data processing and evaluation, while humans retain responsibility for defining standards, reviewing critical samples, and approving important changes.

5.3 Humanlaya：用于数据质量保证的交付驱动的 RSIHumanlaya: Delivery-Driven RSI for Data Quality Assurance

Humanlaya 为基础模型开发人员提供培训和评估数据，其生产工作流程以复杂的多文件任务包为中心，其中包括任务描述、输入附件、参考答案、评分标准以及可执行或程序验证要求。在此类设置中，质量故障通常很微妙，其中单个工件可能单独显示正确，但与任务规范、评分逻辑或下游评估协议不一致。随着任务类型和客户要求的发展，重复修复单个有缺陷的样品是不够的，质量控制系统本身必须从反复出现的故障中吸取教训。因此，Humanlaya 将其数据质量代理及其相关规则、提示、小样本和技能视为持续改进目标，包括内循环和外循环，如图所示Humanlaya provides training and evaluation data for foundation-model developers, with its production workflow centered on complex multi-file task packages consisting of task descriptions, input attachments, reference answers, scoring rubrics, and executable or procedural verification requirements. In such settings, quality failures are often subtle, where an individual artifact may appear correct in isolation while remaining inconsistent with the task specification, scoring logic, or downstream evaluation protocol. As task types and customer requirements evolve, repeatedly repairing individual defective samples is insufficient, and the quality-control system itself must learn from recurring failures. Humanlaya therefore treats its data-quality agents and their associated rules, prompts, few-shot examples, and skills as persistent improvement targets, including an inner loop and an outer loop, as shown in Figure12.

以数据为中心的内循环。The Data-Centric Inner Loop.内循环在当前交付批次内运行，并专注于修复正在生成的数据。每个任务包首先经过质量检查器，检查内容质量和跨组件一致性，然后经过精炼器，修复已确认的缺陷，最后经过交付检查器，验证格式、结构和交付约束。失败的检查会触发交付前的重复本地化、修订和重新验证。例如，如果多个可独立分级的结果被错误地合并到单个粗略的评分标准项目中，则检查者可能会将该评分标准识别为不够原子，并在接受包之前请求重组。该循环改进了当前的工件，但其本身并不构成持久的系统改进。The inner loop operates within the current delivery batch and focuses on repairing the data being produced. Each task package first passes through a Quality Checker that inspects content quality and cross-component consistency, followed by a Refiner that repairs confirmed defects, and finally a Delivery Checker that verifies formatting, structure, and delivery constraints. Failed checks trigger repeated localization, revision, and re-verification before delivery. For example, if several independently gradable results are incorrectly merged into a single coarse rubric item, the checker may identify the rubric as insufficiently atomic and request restructuring before the package is accepted. This loop improves the current artifact, but by itself does not constitute persistent system improvement.

以改进为中心的外循环。The Improvement-Centric Outer Loop.外循环跨交付批次运行，是中央 RSI 机制。交付后，系统会汇总内部审查、客户反馈和下游使用情况等证据。代理会分析这些案例中反复出现的原因，并对质量控制系统提出版本化修改建议，包括 Refiner 指令、提示、少量示例和可重用技能等组件。候选更新在不参与生成修改的任务包上进行评估，并在升级之前由人工进行额外审核。一旦获得批准，新的质量体系版本将取代之前的版本，并用于后续的生产批次。新的任务又产生新的证据，再次进入下一个改进周期。The outer loop operates across delivery batches and is the central RSI mechanism. After delivery, the system aggregates evidence like internal review, customer feedback, and downstream usage. An agent analyzes these cases for recurrent causes and proposes versioned modifications to the quality-control system, including components like Refiner instructions, prompts, few-shot examples, and reusable skills. Candidate updates are evaluated on task packages that are not involved in producing the modification and are additionally reviewed by humans before promotion. Once approved, the new quality-system version replaces the previous one and is used for subsequent production batches. New tasks then generate new evidence, which again enters the next improvement cycle.

一个代表性案例涉及提取工具无法解析的三页扫描 PDF，导致质量检查器将附件标记为不可用。手动检查显示扫描本身是清晰的，而错误则来自于将提取失败与文档质量差混为一谈。因此，系统会生成新的决策规则和少量示例来区分这两种情况。经过持续验证和人工审核后，更新将合并到下一个系统版本中，并在未来的任务中重复使用。 内循环修复当前任务包，而外循环更新用于检查和修复未来包的方法。因此，Humanlaya 代表了一种由生产反馈驱动的支架级 RSI 的实用形式。A representative case involved a three-page scanned PDF that the extraction tool failed to parse, causing the Quality Checker to mark the attachment as unusable. Manual review shows that the scan itself is clear, while the error comes from conflating extraction failure with poor document quality. The system therefore generates a new decision rule and few-shot examples to distinguish the two cases. After held-out validation and human review, the update is incorporated into the next system version and reused on future tasks. The inner loop repairs the current task package, whereas the outer loop updates the method used to inspect and repair future packages. Humanlaya therefore represents a practical form of scaffold-level RSI driven by production feedback.

测量到的改进。Measured Improvement.Humanlaya 报告了四次反馈驱动更新后 V0 和 V4 之间的内部比较。使用相同的基本模型、工具和处理预算，两个版本都在更新过程中排除的 600 个任务包上进行了评估。自动修复后包含关键缺陷的包裹率从 9.0% 下降到 3.7%，而每个任务的平均人工处理时间从 48 分钟下降到 27 分钟。Humanlaya reports an internal comparison between V0 and V4 after four feedback-driven updates. Using the same base model, tools, and processing budget, both versions were evaluated on 600 task packages excluded from the update process. The rate of packages containing key defects after automated repair decreased from 9.0% to 3.7%, while average human handling time fell from 48 to 27 minutes per task.

现阶段，模型能力还在快速推进，有些任务还无法完全由智能体自主完成。因此，Humanlaya 提供了一个将 RSI 与人类监督相结合的实际例子，其中代理执行大部分自我改进过程，而人类在关键阶段提供部分事实真相、审查和最终批准，而不是允许不受约束的自我改进循环。At the current stage, when model capabilities are still advancing rapidly, some tasks cannot yet be completed fully autonomously by agents. Humanlaya therefore provides a practical example of combining RSI with human oversight, where agents perform most of the self-improvement process, while humans provide partial ground truth, review, and final approval at critical stages, rather than allowing an unconstrained self-improvement loop.

5.4 ModelBest：零人类工业人工智能工程ModelBest: Zero-Human Industrial AI Engineering

ModelBest 旨在通过自动化 AI 工程来推进 RSI，其前提是ModelBest aims to advance RSI by automating AI engineering, based on the premise that人工智能工程可能会比开放式人工智能研究更早实现自主化AI engineering is likely to become autonomous earlier than open-ended AI research。工程任务（例如，实现训练框架、优化内核、配置并行性、运行基准测试）需要大量的人力，但通过执行提供相对便宜的客观反馈。为此，为了在无需人工干预的情况下实现生产就绪的实现，ModelBest 提出. Engineering tasks (e.g., implementing training frameworks, optimizing kernels, configuring parallelism, running benchmarks) require substantial human effort but offer comparatively inexpensive, objective feedback through execution. To this end, to produce a production-ready implementation without human intervention, ModelBest proposesForge Engineering，一种端到端范例，其中人工智能系统将目标模型、硬件平台和并行化要求作为输入，然后从最初的空代码库构建、测试和完善实现。图, an end-to-end paradigm in which an AI system takes a target model, hardware platform, and parallelization requirements as inputs, then builds, tests, and refines an implementation from an initially empty codebase. Figure13展示了其项目内优化和跨项目经验复用如何形成两级循环。shows how its within-project optimization and cross-project experience reuse form a two-level loop.

The Industrial RSI Loop.在目标场景中，系统将受限架构设计与自主低级优化相结合。人类和人工智能维护着一个包含规范、评估标准和积累的工程经验的知识库。代理首先使用这些知识来建立合理的高层架构并限制搜索空间。然后，自动研究循环会重复生成实现、测量正确性和性能、诊断故障并修复瓶颈。成功的优化，包括 GEMM 和 FlashAttention 等内核，已逐步集成到主执行路径中。这种设计保持全局架构约束稳定，同时允许在实现级别进行积极的自主优化。Within a target scenario, the system combines constrained architecture design with autonomous low-level optimization. Humans and AI maintain a knowledge base containing specifications, evaluation criteria, and accumulated engineering experience. The agent first uses this knowledge to establish a reasonable high-level architecture and constrain the search space. An AutoResearch loop then repeatedly generates implementations, measures correctness and performance, diagnoses failures, and repairs bottlenecks. Successful optimizations, including kernels such as GEMM and FlashAttention, are progressively integrated into the main execution path. This design keeps global architectural constraints stable while allowing aggressive autonomous optimization at the implementation level.

跨场景，成功和失败的工程经验被写回到共享知识库中。一个项目的性能测量、有效的优化策略、参考实施和失败规则成为后续项目的起始知识。因此，相同的工程过程可以在不同的模型、硬件平台和工作负载之间重复使用。 ModelBest 报告将该范式应用于多个硬件生态系统的预训练框架、算子库、强化学习基础设施、推理引擎、微调、压缩、量化和边缘部署。Across scenarios, successful and failed engineering experience is written back into the shared knowledge base. Performance measurements, effective optimization strategies, reference implementations, and failure rules from one project become starting knowledge for subsequent projects. The same engineering procedure can therefore be reused across different models, hardware platforms, and workloads. ModelBest reports applying the paradigm across pre-training frameworks, operator libraries, reinforcement-learning infrastructure, inference engines, fine-tuning, compression, quantization, and edge deployment on several hardware ecosystems.

测量到的改进。Measured Improvement.从空目录以及参考脚本和模型规范开始，ForgeTrainStarting from an empty directory together with reference scripts and model specifications, ForgeTrainZhu et al. [2026c]在大约 8 小时内生成了一个与 H100 上的 Megatron-LM v0.15 相匹配的预训练框架，据报道在 1.5-2.5 天内超越了它，相比之下，估计需要 3-5 名工程师花费 6-12 个月进行类似的手动开发。报告的 MiniCPM4-0.5B 模型 FLOP 利用率从 40.1% 增加到 44.1%，8B 模型从 47.0% 增加到 50.9%。 ForgeStencilgenerated a pre-training framework that matched Megatron-LM v0.15 on H100 within roughly 8 hours and reportedly surpassed it within 1.5–2.5 days, compared with an estimated 3–5 engineers working for 6–12 months for comparable manual development. Reported model FLOPs utilization increased from 40.1% to 44.1% for MiniCPM4-0.5B and from 47.0% to 50.9% for the 8B model. ForgeStencilThe ForgeStencil Authors [2026]将相同的方法扩展到科学计算内核，该公司报告比公共最先进的实现速度提高了 1.15-1.9 倍，端到端加速中位数为 1.41 倍。extends the same approach to scientific-computing kernels, with the company reporting 1.15–1.9× speedups over public state-of-the-art implementations and a median 1.41× end-to-end speedup.

5.5 腾讯混元：体验驱动自我提升Tencent Hunyuan: Experience-Driven Self-Improvement

腾讯混源的 Hyra（混源研究代理）在面向性能的研究和工程任务中探索 RSI。图Tencent Hunyuan’s Hyra (Hunyuan Research Agent) explores RSI in performance-oriented research and engineering tasks. Figure14概述了其体验驱动的搜索循环。它的设计遵循一种刻意的轻量级理念：Hyra 没有编码日益复杂的人工设计工作流程，而是为智能体提供了广阔的解决方案空间，并反复使用实验证据来指导后续搜索。给定一项任务，系统会继续探索，直到决定终止或耗尽其资源预算，并返回在此过程中发现的最佳解决方案。outlines its experience-driven search loop. Its design follows a deliberately lightweight philosophy: rather than encoding increasingly elaborate human-designed workflows, Hyra gives agents a broad solution space and repeatedly uses experimental evidence to guide subsequent search. Given a task, the system continues exploring until it decides to terminate or exhausts its resource budget, returning the best solution discovered during the process.

一个核心组件是体验库，它比传统的文本记忆保留了更丰富的状态（例如，以前的解决方案代码、生成的工件、执行日志、分数和评估者反馈）。上下文代理将这些证据重新组合到不同的灵感上下文中，而多个提案代理异步使用这些上下文，构建新的解决方案，并在新的隔离沙箱中执行它们。由此产生的工件和评估结果被写回到经验库中，允许后来的提案直接重用、组合或避免在早期尝试中发现的模式。A central component is the Experience Bank, which retains substantially richer state (e.g., previous solution code, generated artifacts, execution logs, scores, and evaluator feedback) than a conventional textual memory. A Context Agent recombines this evidence into diverse inspiration contexts, while multiple Proposal Agents asynchronously consume these contexts, construct new solutions, and execute them in fresh isolated sandboxes. The resulting artifacts and evaluation outcomes are written back into the Experience Bank, allowing later proposals to directly reuse, combine, or avoid patterns discovered in earlier attempts.

Hyra 进一步将这一想法延伸到评估本身。对于初始评估器不完整或可利用的开放式任务，可以利用积累的搜索经验来修改评估机制，例如增加其粒度、加强比较基线或关闭奖励黑客漏洞，然后在改进的标准下继续进行后续搜索。这与 RSI 特别相关，因为持久更新不再局限于更好的解决方案：确定哪些未来解决方案被视为改进的机制也可以改变。Hyra further extends this idea to evaluation itself. For open-ended tasks where the initial evaluator is incomplete or becomes exploitable, accumulated search experience can be used to revise the evaluation mechanism—for example, by increasing its granularity, strengthening comparison baselines, or closing reward-hacking loopholes—before subsequent search continues under the improved criterion. This is particularly relevant to RSI because the persistent update is no longer limited to a better solution: the mechanism that determines which future solutions are considered improvements can also change.

测量到的改进。Measured Improvement.如表所示As shown in Table10，发布的配套工件报告了 AI-for-AI 和 AI-for-Science 任务的改进。例如，Hyra 在 nanochat AutoResearch 上报告验证 BPB 为 0.9015, the released companion artifacts report improvements across both AI-for-AI and AI-for-Science tasks. For example, Hyra reports validation BPB of 0.9015 on nanochat AutoResearchKarpathy [2026b]与之前提到的 nanoGPT Speedrun 最佳成绩 0.9109 相比，为 76.4 秒compared with a cited previous best of 0.9109, 76.4 s on nanoGPT SpeedrunJordan et al. [2024]与 SOL-ExecBench 上的 77.5 s 和 0.771 相比compared with 77.5 s, and 0.771 on SOL-ExecBenchLin et al. [2026a]与 0.754 相比。作为工业 RSI 实践，Hyra 强调保留可执行经验的价值，而不仅仅是最终答案。compared with 0.754. As an industrial RSI practice, Hyra highlights the value of retaining executable experience rather than only final answers.

5.6 Agent-Native 研究实验室：RSI 可验证的研究基础设施Agent-Native Research Lab: Verifiable Research Infrastructure for RSI

实现持续的递归自我完善需要的不仅仅是日益自主的研究代理，同时还需要一个基础设施，通过该基础设施可以可靠地记录、验证、继承和跨代重复使用研究经验。 Agent-Native 研究实验室专注于这一基础设施层，如图所示Achieving sustained recursive self-improvement requires more than increasingly autonomous research agents, while it also requires an infrastructure through which research experience can be reliably recorded, verified, inherited, and reused across generations. Agent-Native Research Lab focuses on this infrastructural layer, summarized in Figure15.

∙\bullet (1) 以人为中心与以代理为中心的研究工件。(1) Human-Centric vs. Agent-Native Research Artifact.传统的科学论文是为人类交流而设计的，并且会丢弃自主代理继续之前的工作所需的大部分操作状态（例如，失败的实验、中间证据、可执行规范和实现细节）。对于RSI来说，这种信息丢失直接削弱了跨代知识积累。Conventional scientific papers are designed for human communication and would discard much of the operational state that autonomous agents need to continue previous work (e.g., failed experiments, intermediate evidence, executable specifications, and implementation details). For RSI, such information loss directly weakens cross-generation knowledge accumulation.

为了解决这个问题，他们提出了 Agent-Native Research Artifact (ARA) 作为传统科学文档的可执行替代方案。 ARA 共同保留了正式的科学逻辑、可执行代码和规范、成功和废弃分支的探索图以及原始经验证据。因此，继任者可以检查结果是如何获得的、哪些替代方案失败了以及实际使用了哪些假设或参数，而不是仅继承经过修饰的最终叙述。报告的评估显示，使用 ARA 的先前工作的问答准确率为 93.7%，而使用传统论文的问答准确率为 72.4%，而 RE-Bench 再现成功率从 57.4% 提高到 64.4%。因此，RSI 的重要贡献不仅是更好的记录，而且是为以后的研究周期提供更丰富的继承基础。To address this, they propose Agent-Native Research Artifact (ARA) as an executable alternative to conventional scientific documentation. ARA jointly preserves formal scientific logic, executable code and specifications, the exploration graph of both successful and abandoned branches, and raw empirical evidence. Rather than inheriting only a polished final narrative, a successor agent can therefore inspect how a result was obtained, which alternatives failed, and which assumptions or parameters were actually used. The reported evaluation shows 93.7% question-answering accuracy over prior work using ARA compared with 72.4% using conventional papers, while RE-Bench reproduction success increases from 57.4% to 64.4%. The important RSI contribution is thus not merely better documentation, but a richer inheritance substrate for later research cycles.

∙\bullet (2) 研究主张的确定性验证。(2) Deterministic Verification for Research Claims.此外，由于自主代理以机器速度生成实验和声明，Additionally, as autonomous agents generate experiments and claims at machine speed,验证而不是生成成为主要瓶颈verification rather than generation becomes the main bottleneck。其 rit 协议将经验声明直接锚定到执行跟踪，从日志中重新提取报告的结果，而分析声明可以通过正式验证系统（例如 Lean 4）进行检查。只有通过这些机器可验证的门的声明才会被允许进入共享研究状态。这可以防止幻觉或错误报告的结果被后代递归继承和放大。它们还通过认知进展指导和源自人类科学推理的结构化先验来增强基于结果的稀疏优化。鼓励智能体选择能够减少不确定性并揭示问题中有用结构的实验，而不是仅奖励最终基准分数。这是为了提高大型假设空间中的研究效率，在这种空间中，简单的爬山可以重复利用熟悉的参数，而不会产生更深入的理解。. Its rit protocol anchors empirical claims directly to execution traces, re-extracting reported results from logs, while analytical claims can be checked through formal verification systems such as Lean 4. Only claims that pass these machine-verifiable gates are admitted into the shared research state. This prevents hallucinated or incorrectly reported results from being recursively inherited and amplified by later generations. They also augment sparse outcome-based optimization with epistemic-progress guidance and structured priors derived from human scientific reasoning. Instead of rewarding only the final benchmark score, agents are encouraged to prefer experiments that reduce uncertainty and reveal useful structure in the problem. This is intended to improve research efficiency in large hypothesis spaces, where naive hill climbing can repeatedly exploit familiar parameters without producing deeper understanding.

测量到的改进。Measured Improvement.这些想法在硅设计中得到体现，其中反馈循环异常快速且具有确定性。自主代理生成可综合的 SystemVerilog、构建测试平台并提出微架构修改；然后使用工业 EDA 工具进行综合、布局布线、时序分析和形式等效来评估候选者。无效的设计会被自动过滤，而经过验证的实现、执行轨迹、失败的分支和卓越的功率性能区域轨迹将被保留作为后代的培训和研究证据。在 Chip-Bench 上，他们报告的 3 级 CPU 优化得分为 5.8416，与相同模型基础上的标准代理基线相比，该设计速度快 2.7%，面积小 21.5%，同时通过了所有 97 个定向测试和 350 个随机差分程序。These ideas are instantiated in silicon design, where the feedback loop is unusually fast and deterministic. Autonomous agents generate synthesizable SystemVerilog, construct testbenches, and propose microarchitectural modifications; candidates are then evaluated using industrial EDA tools for synthesis, place-and-route, timing analysis, and formal equivalence. Invalid designs are filtered automatically, while verified implementations, execution traces, failed branches, and superior power-performance-area trajectories are retained as training and research evidence for subsequent generations. On Chip-Bench, they report a Level-3 CPU optimization score of 5.8416, with a design that is 2.7% faster and 21.5% smaller in area than standard-agent baselines on the same model foundation while passing all 97 directed tests and 350 random differential programs.

6 挑战和未来方向Challenges and Future Directions

前面的章节展示了自动化改进执行、策略选择、经验获取、部署适应和改进机制修订方面的进展。他们还指出，更大的自主权、持久的能力增益和更有效的改进过程是不同的属性。因此，推动这项调查的三个瓶颈仍然只得到部分解决：基础模型开发需要大量资源和协调；可扩展的学习取决于有用的经验和可靠的验证；和已部署的系统需要持续努力诊断、验证和发布更新。基于自主层次结构、四种应用机制和上面回顾的工业实践，我们确定了八个研究方向，将这些部分进展与持续的递归改进联系起来。The preceding chapters show progress in automating improvement execution, strategy selection, experience acquisition, deployment adaptation, and the revision of improvement mechanisms. They also establish that greater autonomy, durable capability gains, and a more effective improvement process are distinct properties. The three bottlenecks motivating this survey therefore remain only partially resolved: foundation-model development requires substantial resources and coordination; scalable learning depends on useful experience and reliable verification; and deployed systems require continuing effort to diagnose, validate, and release updates. Building on the autonomy hierarchy, the four application regimes, and the industrial practices reviewed above, we identify eight research directions for connecting these partial advances into sustained recursive improvement.

跨组件诊断和协调改进。Cross-Component Diagnosis and Coordinated Improvement.从 L1 到 L2 的转换暴露了一个诊断问题：观察到的故障很少能识别出应该更改的组件。错误答案可能源于有缺陷的源数据、缺少上下文、工具界面、模型或评估器。章节中的 Humanlaya 案例The transition from L1 to L2 exposes a diagnostic problem: an observed failure rarely identifies the component that should change. An incorrect answer may originate in defective source data, missing context, a tool interface, the model, or the evaluator. The Humanlaya case in Section5.3使这种模糊性具体化：提取失败最初被视为文档质量差的证据，而适当的干预则涉及质量检查员的决策规则。在科学和具身智能中，同样的问题延伸到实验协议、感知、控制和环境条件。随着多个组件的适应，改变一个组件也会使另一个组件所依赖的假设失效。makes this ambiguity concrete: a failed extraction was initially treated as evidence of poor document quality, while the appropriate intervention concerned the quality checker’s decision rule. In science and embodied intelligence, the same problem extends to experimental protocols, perception, control, and environmental conditions. As several components adapt, changing one can also invalidate assumptions on which another relies.

未来的系统应该将诊断转化为可测试的干预假设，并使用受控比较来估计个体效应和相互作用。选择性组件冻结、有针对性的消融和明确的依赖性记录可以帮助区分有用的修复和上游缺陷的补偿。随着约束的变化，协调搜索应该在数据、模型、线束和环境之间分配工作量。忒修斯的工作空间研究部分Future systems should turn diagnoses into testable intervention hypotheses and use controlled comparisons to estimate individual effects and interactions. Selective component freezing, targeted ablations, and explicit records of dependencies could help distinguish a useful repair from compensation for an upstream defect. Coordinated search should then allocate effort across data, models, harnesses, and environments as constraints shift. Theseus’s workspace studies in Section5.1说明将环境改进与任务模型更改分开的重要性；所报告的组成部分层面的成果使得完整的学习周期有待确定。研究目标是确定哪种干预措施可以在什么条件下改善整个系统，以及由此产生的知识是否可以指导以后的改进决策。illustrate the importance of separating environment improvements from changes to the task model; the reported component-level gains leave the full learning cycle to be established. The research goal is to identify which intervention improves the overall system, under what conditions, and whether the resulting knowledge guides later improvement decisions.

以学习者为条件的经验获取和可靠的学习信号。Learner-Conditioned Experience Acquisition and Reliable Learning Signals.L3 分析区分了经验的三个属性：它是否有效、对于当前学习者来说有多困难以及从中学习是否会产生持久的好处。 AZR 使用可执行检查以及依赖于学习者的任务建议，而 R-Zero 使用求解器一致性作为难度的代理The L3 analysis distinguishes three properties of experience: whether it is valid, how difficult it is for the current learner, and whether learning from it produces a durable benefit. AZR uses executable checks alongside learner-dependent task proposal, whereas R-Zero uses solver consistency as a proxy for difficultyZhao et al. [2025], Huang et al. [2026a]。正确性和估计难度本身都不能确定学习价值。适应性课程可能会重复选择不明确的任务，强化评估者的错误，或者集中在易于衡量进展的狭窄区域。此类错误可能会进入学习者和决定其下一次经历的状态。. Neither correctness nor estimated difficulty alone establishes learning value. An adaptive curriculum may repeatedly select ambiguous tasks, reinforce evaluator errors, or concentrate on a narrow region where progress is easy to measure. Such errors can enter both the learner and the state that determines its next experiences.

未来的获取机制应该评估多轮学习的价值，同时保留先前获取的能力的有效性、多样性和覆盖范围。这包括从现有数据中进行选择、生成新任务、寻求交互以及在内部判断不足时请求更强的外部反馈。一个核心挑战是决定昂贵的验证何时值得其成本，以及不确定的经验应如何影响后续培训。评估应允许所获取的分布有所不同，同时匹配数据源访问以及总获取和学习预算。冻结习得机制的学习者状态输入，或用独立于学习者的时间表替换自适应选择，可以测试学习者条件反射是否能改善迁移，使其超出额外训练的效果。Future acquisition mechanisms should estimate learning value across multiple rounds while preserving validity, diversity, and coverage of previously acquired capabilities. This includes selecting from existing data, generating new tasks, seeking interactions, and requesting stronger external feedback when internal judgments are insufficient. A central challenge is deciding when expensive verification is worth its cost and how uncertain experience should influence subsequent training. Evaluation should allow the acquired distributions to differ while matching data-source access and total acquisition and learning budgets. Freezing the learner-state input to the acquisition mechanism, or replacing adaptive selection with a learner-independent schedule, can test whether learner conditioning improves transfer beyond the effects of additional training.

持久状态管理和可靠重用。Persistent-State Management and Reliable Reuse.L4 系统继承参数、记忆、技能、工具和控制代码，但保留工件并不意味着以后的代理可以从中受益。 L4 分析识别激活和执行中的失败：相关技能可能永远不会被检索到，或者代理可能会在没有正确遵循的情况下检索它。积累会带来额外的困难。库漂移表明，不断扩大的技能库可能会降低检索速度并阻碍改进，而过度激进的退休也可能是有害的L4 systems inherit parameters, memories, skills, tools, and harness code, but retaining an artifact does not establish that later agents benefit from it. The L4 analysis identifies failures in both activation and execution: a relevant skill may never be retrieved, or an agent may retrieve it without following it correctly. Accumulation creates an additional difficulty. Library Drift shows that an expanding skill library can degrade retrieval and stall improvement, while overly aggressive retirement can also be harmfulZhang et al. [2026f]。因此，持久性需要管理保留更改的持续适用性和交互。. Persistence therefore requires managing the continuing applicability and interaction of retained changes.

未来的工作应该将继承的工件与其支持证据、适用性条件、依赖性以及观察到的对后续任务的影响联系起来。 HDSO 配对评估等入学考试提供了一个起点Future work should associate inherited artifacts with their supporting evidence, applicability conditions, dependencies, and observed effects on later tasks. Admission tests such as HDSO’s paired evaluations provide a starting pointShang and Yang [2026]，但随着任务分配、执行器和周围系统的变化，验证必须继续。研究应单独衡量更新质量、激活、忠实使用和下游效益，然后调查何时合并、修改、退役或重新验证工件。跨模型重用引入了另一个问题：对其作者有用的技能可能不适合不同的执行者。解决这些问题将把成功的更新生成与跨会话和后继者的可靠能力传输联系起来。, but validation must continue as the task distribution, executor, and surrounding system change. Studies should separately measure update quality, activation, faithful use, and downstream benefit, then investigate when to merge, revise, retire, or revalidate artifacts. Cross-model reuse introduces a further question: a skill useful to its author may be unsuitable for a different executor. Resolving these issues would connect successful update generation to reliable capability transfer across sessions and successors.

特定领域反馈下的受控适应。Governed Adaptation under Domain-Specific Feedback.这四种应用机制说明了为什么常见的改进循环需要不同的验证策略。在科学中，一个不成功的实验可能反映了假设、方案或仪器，而证据必须保留其假设和不确定性。在具身智能中，当前的策略决定了观察哪些状态，而物理试验会消耗资源并可能产生不可逆转的后果。软件提供可执行的反馈，但通过测试仍然取决于规范和测试覆盖范围。在医疗保健领域，结果会被延迟和混淆，并且在一个人群或机构中验证的更新可能不会转移到另一个人群或机构。这些差异限制了系统可以自主学习的内容以及支持部署的证据。The four application regimes show why a common improvement loop requires different validation strategies. In science, an unsuccessful experiment may reflect the hypothesis, protocol, or instrument, and evidence must retain its assumptions and uncertainty. In embodied intelligence, the current policy determines which states are observed, while physical trials consume resources and can have irreversible consequences. Software offers executable feedback, but passing tests remains conditional on the specification and test coverage. In healthcare, outcomes are delayed and confounded, and an update validated in one population or institution may not transfer to another. These differences constrain both what a system can learn autonomously and what evidence supports deployment.

未来的研究应该制定更新策略，区分暂时性故障和反复出现的限制，并选择适合拟议变更的验证过程。模拟、回顾性重放和沙盒执行可以支持初步筛选，然后在预期操作条件下进行监督或分阶段评估。监控应测试随着需求、人群、工具和环境的变化，收益是否持续存在。恢复软件检查点无法消除物理或临床后果，因此在这些设置中预发布验证至关重要。人类对后续发布、访问权限和安全限制的权力应保持明确。悬而未决的问题是如何增加有用的适应，同时控制未来交互中错误的传播。Future research should develop update policies that distinguish transient failures from recurring limitations and select a validation process appropriate to the proposed change. Simulation, retrospective replay, and sandboxed execution can support initial screening, followed by supervised or staged evaluation under the intended operating conditions. Monitoring should test whether benefits persist as requirements, populations, tools, and environments change. Restoring a software checkpoint cannot undo physical or clinical consequences, making pre-release validation essential in those settings. Human authority over consequential releases, access permissions, and safety constraints should remain explicit. The open problem is how to increase useful adaptation while controlling the propagation of errors across future interactions.

改进机制的值得信赖的演变。Trustworthy Evolution of Improvement Mechanisms.在 L5，改进者、评估者或研究政策的变化会改变后续继任者的产生和接受方式。这就产生了一个耦合验证问题：更强大的求解器可以暴露其评估器的弱点，但改变评估器也可能使分数无法比较或奖励剥削。 RQGM 通过在一个时期内冻结其评估器、根据独立锚点验证替换以及重新访问受替换影响的分数来部分解决此问题At L5, changes to the improver, evaluator, or research policy alter how subsequent successors are produced and accepted. This creates a coupled validation problem: a stronger solver can expose weaknesses in its evaluator, but changing the evaluator can also make scores incomparable or reward exploitation. RQGM addresses part of this problem by freezing its evaluator within an epoch, validating replacements against an independent anchor, and revisiting scores affected by replacementIacob et al. [2026]。 Hyra 中描述的评估器改进提出了同样更广泛的问题：随着搜索的进展，自适应测量如何保持可信。. The evaluator refinement described in Hyra raises the same broader question of how adaptive measurement can remain credible as search progresses.

未来的系统应该将可编辑的内部反馈机制与独立维护的验收标准区分开来，并保留将每个机制修订与后续决策联系起来的证据。受控比较应分别评估候选生成和评估的变化，然后再将收益归因于联合进化。 A-Evolve-Training 提供了固定高级目标内策略继承的示例Future systems should distinguish editable internal feedback mechanisms from independently maintained acceptance criteria and preserve evidence linking each mechanism revision to later decisions. Controlled comparisons should assess changes to candidate generation and evaluation separately before attributing gains to their joint evolution. A-Evolve-Training provides an example of policy inheritance within a fixed high-level objectiveShi et al. [2026b];这些政策是否会超越其发展的研究环境仍有待检验。悬而未决的问题包括如何在重复的自适应访问下保持独立评估，检测协调的提议者-评估者错误，以及在不损失有用经验的情况下扭转有害的机制变化。修改运筹学优先事项不需要转移对系统整体任务的权力。; whether such policies transfer beyond the research setting in which they evolved remains to be tested. Open questions include how to maintain independent assessment under repeated adaptive access, detect coordinated proposer–evaluator errors, and reverse harmful mechanism changes without losing useful experience. Revising operational research priorities need not transfer authority over the system’s overall mission.

遗传改进能力的长期评估。Long-Horizon Evaluation of Inherited Improvement Capacity.结构性 L5 和有效 L5 之间的区别应指导评估。结构性证据表明修订后的机制得到继承和调用；有效性要求表明它产生或选择了更好的后续改进。这仍然是一个实质性的经验差距。例如，AIDEThe distinction between structural and effective L5 should guide evaluation. Structural evidence establishes that a revised mechanism is inherited and invoked; effectiveness requires showing that it produces or selects better subsequent improvements. This remains a substantive empirical gap. For example, the AIDE2当安装进化安全带作为外部改进器时，本次调查中审查的实验并未建立统计上显着的效率优势experiment reviewed in this survey did not establish a statistically significant efficiency advantage when an evolved harness was installed as the outer improverWeco Team [2026]。软件谱系研究进一步推动将当前任务性能与产生有用后代的能力分开，因为暂时较弱的变体可能会促进以后的进展。. Software lineage studies further motivate separating current task performance from the ability to produce useful descendants, since temporarily weaker variants may enable later progress.

未来的基准应比较来自可比初始系统的原始机制和修订后的机制以及匹配总预算下的证据，包括开发和评估机制的成本。将进化机制固定在新任务上可以测试其改进策略是否转移，如 HyperAgents 所示Future benchmarks should compare original and revised mechanisms from comparable initial systems and evidence under matched total budgets, including the cost of developing and evaluating the mechanisms. Holding an evolved mechanism fixed on fresh tasks can test whether its improvement strategy transfers, as illustrated by HyperAgentsZhang et al. [2026c]。较长的研究应报告重复运行的完整轨迹，包括拒绝的更新、回归、恢复、保留的功能和资源使用。受保护的参考任务可以保持可比性，而新任务和不熟悉的约束则可以测试转移和发现。这些协议应确定继承的变化是否会改变后续的改进能力，当增益达到稳定水平时，以及明显的加速是否能够在额外的搜索和评估工作的情况下继续存在。. Longer studies should report complete trajectories across repeated runs, including rejected updates, regressions, recovery, retained capabilities, and resource use. Protected reference tasks can preserve comparability, while fresh tasks and unfamiliar constraints test transfer and discovery. These protocols should establish whether inherited changes alter subsequent improvement capacity, when gains plateau, and whether apparent acceleration survives accounting for additional search and evaluation effort.

资源感知改进和人类协作。Resource-Aware Improvement and Human Collaboration.激励 RSI 的效率目标需要考虑整个改进过程。更快的内核、更好的训练配方或更长的无人值守运行可能仍然需要大量的候选生成、评估、基础设施维护和人工审查。 Meta 的回归分析工作流程保留了对拟议变更的工程审查The efficiency objective motivating RSI requires accounting for the entire improvement process. A faster kernel, a better training recipe, or a longer unattended run may still require substantial candidate generation, evaluation, infrastructure maintenance, and human review. Meta’s regression-analysis workflow retains engineering review of proposed changesMeta Engineering [2026]; Humanlaya 还保留人工验证并报告处理时间和质量。这些实践说明了为什么应该将自主性与所需人力的数量和类型一起评估。更强的基础模型和更多的并行试验可能会进一步混淆改进策略之间的比较。; Humanlaya also retains human validation and reports handling time alongside quality. These practices show why autonomy should be assessed together with the amount and type of human effort required. Stronger base models and more parallel trials can further confound comparisons between improvement strategies.

未来的工作应该研究如何在诊断、经验获取、候选人搜索、验证和部署监控之间分配总预算。廉价的筛查可以减少昂贵的试验，只要其预测仍然根据独立的结果进行校准。重复使用经过验证的工具和以前的故障可能会减少重复工作，但其维护成本也必须计算在内。评估应报告已验证的能力目标的时间和总成本，以及审查工作和返工。自适应停止是另一个研究重点：系统应该通过其预期的学习价值和不确定性来证明继续实验的合理性，并具有暂停、升级到人类或终止无效搜索的明确条件。Future work should study how to allocate a total budget among diagnosis, experience acquisition, candidate search, verification, and deployment monitoring. Cheap screening can reduce expensive trials, provided its predictions remain calibrated against independent outcomes. Reusing validated tools and prior failures may reduce repeated work, but its maintenance cost must also be counted. Evaluations should report time and total cost to a validated capability target, alongside review effort and rework. Adaptive stopping is another research priority: systems should justify continued experimentation by its expected learning value and uncertainty, with explicit conditions for pausing, escalating to a human, or terminating an unproductive search.

用于跨轮继承的可复制基础设施。Reproducible Infrastructure for Cross-Round Inheritance.后续系统需要了解如何获得改进，包括不成功的替代方案及其证据成立的条件。行业案例暴露出互补的要求：Lark 强调数据的时间性和故障归因； Humanlaya 保留版本质量系统更新； Hyra存储可执行的经验； Agent-Native 研究实验室提出了保留代码、规范、探索历史和经验痕迹的研究工件。这些做法激发了共享基础设施来跨轮传输研究证据，而这种继承的全部纵向效益仍有待确定。Successor systems need access to how an improvement was obtained, including unsuccessful alternatives and the conditions under which its evidence holds. The industrial cases expose complementary requirements: Lark emphasizes temporally grounded data and failure attribution; Humanlaya retains versioned quality-system updates; Hyra stores executable experience; and Agent-Native Research Lab proposes research artifacts that preserve code, specifications, exploration history, and empirical traces. These practices motivate a shared infrastructure for carrying research evidence across rounds, while the full longitudinal benefit of such inheritance remains to be established.

可重用的工件格式应连接父状态、提议的更改、激励证据、评估配置、接受决策和后续使用。版本化的数据、环境和评估器将使结果更容易重放，并阐明哪些比较在更新后仍然有效。确定性重新提取可以检查报告的测量结果，形式验证可以建立与规范相关的属性；两者都不能单独证明实验或规范捕获了预期的功能。因此，公共评估应将可检查的工件与重放研究配对，并分别报告结果来源、工件可用性和独立复制。在数据保密的情况下，可共享的评估子集和受控重放接口可以支持部分验证，同时保留可检查内容的限制。A reusable artifact format should connect the parent state, proposed change, motivating evidence, evaluation configuration, acceptance decision, and subsequent use. Versioned data, environments, and evaluators would make results easier to replay and clarify which comparisons remain valid after an update. Deterministic re-extraction can check reported measurements, and formal verification can establish properties relative to a specification; neither alone establishes that the experiment or specification captures the intended capability. Public evaluation should therefore pair inspectable artifacts with replay studies and report result provenance, artifact availability, and independent replication separately. Where data are confidential, shareable evaluation subsets and controlled replay interfaces could support partial verification while preserving the limits of what can be checked.

在这些方向上，真正的 RSI 的进展应该通过改进能力的重复、可归因和可转移的改进来证明。决定性的证据是，继承的变革有助于后来的几轮获得更多有用的经验，发现更好的干预措施，或者在明确的资源和权威约束下更有效地验证继任者。Across these directions, progress toward genuine RSI should be demonstrated through repeated, attributable, and transferable improvements in the capacity to improve. The decisive evidence is that inherited changes help later rounds acquire more useful experience, discover better interventions, or validate successors more effectively under explicit resource and authority constraints.

7 结论Conclusion

在本报告中，我们提出了一个以自治为中心的递归自我改进路线图，跨越五个阶段：改进执行、策略选择、经验获取、环境适应和递归元改进。以改进循环为分析单位，我们阐明哪些系统发生了变化，哪些继任者继承了哪些内容，以及哪些决策仍然由人类控制。我们将此路线图与科学发现、具体智能、软件工程和医疗保健联系起来，展示反馈可用性、验证成本和部署限制如何影响每个领域的 RSI 进展。行业实践和初步实证研究结果进一步奠定了已证明能力和当前局限性的路线图。需要进行长期评估，以确定这些机制是否在明确的资源限制和人力监督下提供可转让的收益。最终，RSI 的承诺在于使每一代人工智能都能使未来的改进更加可靠、高效，并有利于新的发现。In this report, we present an autonomy-centered roadmap for recursive self-improvement, spanning five stages: improvement execution, strategy selection, experience acquisition, environmental adaptation, and recursive meta-improvement. Taking the improvement loop as the unit of analysis, we clarify what systems change, what successors inherit, and which decisions remain human-controlled. We connect this roadmap to scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering, and healthcare, showing how feedback availability, verification costs, and deployment constraints shape progress toward RSI in each domain. Industry practices and preliminary empirical findings further ground the roadmap in demonstrated capabilities and current limitations. Long-horizon evaluation is needed to establish whether these mechanisms deliver transferable gains under explicit resource constraints and human oversight. Ultimately, the promise of RSI lies in enabling each generation of AI to make future improvement more reliable, efficient, and conducive to novel discoveries.

组织原则：公司原型，而非地域。 RSI 标签是 B0-L5 方案的紧凑映射，并不表明公司本身使用该标签。Organization principle: company archetype, not geography. The RSI tag is a compact mapping to the B0–L5 scheme and is not a claim that the company itself uses that label. = 可点击的主要来源。= clickable primary source.

阅读指南。Reading guide.B0 仅表示任务本地自治。 L1-L5 遵循审查不断增加的自主权规模。 “形容词。”标记与 RSI 相邻的基础设施或行为； “坎。”标志着一个看似合理但未充分证明的水平； “目标”标志着明确的未来目标，而不是已证明的当前能力。 星号表示其公司身份或公共技术边界仍需要更强验证的条目。B0 denotes task-local autonomy only. L1–L5 follow the review’s increasing autonomy scale. “adj.” marks RSI-adjacent infrastructure or behavior; “cand.” marks a plausible but not fully demonstrated level; “target” marks an explicit future objective rather than a demonstrated current capability. Asterisks indicate entries whose company identity or public technical boundary still requires stronger verification.
